fdroid:org.qownnotes.mobile.name: QOwnNotes
fdroid:org.qownnotes.mobile.summary: Offline Markdown notes synchronized safely with Nextcloud
fdroid:org.qownnotes.mobile.description:
QOwnNotes is an offline-capable Markdown notes app for Android that synchronizes with your own
Nextcloud server.
The Nextcloud Files Android app and a server with Nextcloud Notes API 1.2 or newer, provided by
Nextcloud Notes or QOwnNotes for Nextcloud, are required for Nextcloud accounts. Nextcloud Files manages
your login credentials. Its Single Sign-On library stores an account access token in QOwnNotes'
private preferences, not in the notes database.
Without Nextcloud, you can also use a folder on the device, laid out like a QOwnNotes desktop note
folder, for example one synchronized with Syncthing. No storage permission is needed.
Features include:
* Read, search, create, rename, edit, and delete notes while offline
* Conflict-safe synchronization using ETags and durable pending changes
* Local note folders without Nextcloud, with conflict detection and a restorable trash
* CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown rendering and source editing
* QOwnNotes wiki links, task states, note naming, subfolders, and favorites
* Move or copy notes between subfolders and duplicate notes
* Share notes through public Nextcloud links with password protection and optional editing
* Reorder checklist blocks by dragging; long-press a checkbox to copy its block or delete it
* Note tags shared with QOwnNotes desktop, with tag filtering in the note list
* Create, browse, search, edit, and archive Nextcloud Deck cards and insert card links
* Safe remote images and authenticated Nextcloud note attachments
* View images full screen with zoom, copy them, or annotate a new copy without overwriting originals
* Home-screen widgets for note lists and selected notes
* Browse, edit, and delete bookmarks offline, and insert images while editing notes
* Take photos while editing notes, with configurable photo resolution
* Record audio notes from the app or widget and play audio attachments in the app
* Light and dark themes on Android 9 and newer
* Browse and restore note versions and remote trash through QOwnNotes for Nextcloud or QOwnNotesAPI
* Search across note versions with match counts, highlighted excerpts, and preview match navigation
QOwnNotes contains no advertising, analytics, or developer-operated telemetry. Notes are stored on
the device and synchronized only with the Nextcloud server or local folder selected by the user.
Images load automatically when a note is opened. Remote HTTPS images contact the hosts referenced
in the note, which can see your IP address and request metadata. The note menu's "Load images"
toggle can disable image loading for the current view; it resets to enabled when the note is
reopened. Nextcloud note attachments are loaded from your selected server through Single Sign-On.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Choose your board language — English, Español, or 中文 (Mandarin Chinese). Every built-in board shows and speaks in the language you pick, so a bilingual home or classroom finally has a board that fits.

 – Customize — add your own panels with your own pictures and recorded voice

• Keep the screen on while your child is choosing — 1, 5, or 10 minutes, or "until I leave the app" for kids who study the picture board for a long time.
• Set it up once, use it everywhere. Your panels, PIN, voice choice, and settings travel with you between iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Parents, therapists, special-education teachers, and speech-language pathologists working with emerging communicators. Designed with — and used by — families of children with autism, apraxia, Down syndrome, and other communication needs.
PRIVACY
No data collection. No tracking. No accounts. Your panels, pictures, and voice recordings stay on your device and (if you opt in) in your private iCloud account. Apple sees CloudKit data as encrypted blobs they cannot open.

flathub:com.voxdsp.VoxelPaintPro.name: Voxel Paint Pro
flathub:com.voxdsp.VoxelPaintPro.description:
Mouse locks when you click on the game window, press ESCAPE to unlock the mouse.
 W,A,S,D = Move around based on relative orientation to X and Y.
 SPACE + L-SHIFT = Move up and down relative Z.
 Left Click / R-SHIFT = Place node.
 Right Click / R-CTRL = Delete node.
 Tab = Teleports you from colour palette to last position and vice-versa.
 Q / Middle Click / Mouse4 = Clone texture of pointed node.
 E / Mouse5 = Replace pointed node.
 R = Places node at your current position.
 F = Toggle player fast speed on and off.
 1-7 = Change move speed for selected fast state.
 X + C / Slash + Quote = Change texture of pointed node.
 G = Gravity on/off.
 P = Toggle pitch lock.
 F1 = Resets environment state back to default.
 F3 = Save. (auto saves on exit or idle for more than 3 minutes)
 F8 = Load. (will erase what you have done since the last save)
 F10 = Export the VoxelPaint data to a zip file in $HOME/EXPORTS.
 Middle Mouse Click and Drag or Mouse4 and Drag (or Q and drag) to select area.
 V = Copies the selected nodes to the currently pointed position, the point you started the selection from is the point you will copy from at the new pointed location.
 T = Copies the selected nodes to the currently pointed position, but each time you press T it will iterate one of 24 rotations.
 Y = Shoots an array of the selected nodes in the direction you are facing in 24 different rotations. Pick the one you want.
 B = Fill selected nodes with selected color.
 N = Delete selected nodes.
 Arrow Keys can be used to move the view around.
 Your state is automatically saved on exit.
 Sensitivity as the 1st command line parameter default is 0.003 `./voxelpaintpro 0.003`.

fedora-packages:boomaga/boomaga.name: boomaga
fedora-packages:boomaga/boomaga.summary: A virtual printer for viewing a document before printing
fedora-packages:boomaga/boomaga.description: Boomaga (BOOklet MAnager) is a virtual printer for viewing a document before printing it out using the physical printer. The program is very simple to work with. Running any program, click "print" and select "Boomaga" to see in several seconds (CUPS takes some time to respond) the Boomaga window open. If you print out one more document, it gets added to the previous one, and you can also print them out as one. Regardless of whether your printer supports duplex printing or not, you would be able to easily print on both sides of the sheet. If your printer does not support duplex printing, point this out in the settings, and Booklet would ask you to turn over the pages half way through printing your document. The program can also help you get your documents prepared a bit before printing. At this stage Boomaga makes it possible to: * Paste several documents together. * Print several pages on one sheet. * 1, 2, 4, 8 pages per sheet * Booklet. Folding the sheets in two, you'll get a book.

fedora-packages:chibicc/chibicc.name: chibicc
fedora-packages:chibicc/chibicc.description: chibicc is yet another small C compiler that implements most C11 features. Even though it still probably falls into the "toy compilers" category just like other small compilers do, chibicc can compile several real-world programs, including Git, SQLite, libpng and chibicc itself, without making modifications to the compiled programs. Generated executables of these programs pass their corresponding test suites. So, chibicc actually supports a wide variety of C11 features and is able to compile hundreds of thousands of lines of real-world C code correctly. If you like this project, please consider purchasing a copy of the book when it becomes available! I publish the source code here to give people early access to it, because I was planing to do that anyway with a permissive open-source license after publishing the book. If I don't charge for the source code, it doesn't make much sense to me to keep it private.

fedora-packages:dicomanonymizer/dicomano.summary: A multi-threaded anonymizer for DICOM files
fedora-packages:dicomanonymizer/dicomano.description: A multi-threaded anonymizer for DICOM files implementing most of DICOM PS 3.15 AnnexE. Entries such as uid entries are replaced with hash values. This ensures that partial runs of a studies DICOM files can be merged afterwards. This project is written in C++ using the gdcm library and multiple threads to accelerate processing. Warning: The operation performed by this tool is a 'soft' de-identification. Instead of a white list of allowed tags the tool keeps a list of tags known to frequently contain personal identifying information (PII) and replaces only those. On the command line you specify a patient identifier (PatientID/PatientName). Only if you do not keep a mapping of the new and the old identifier this is considered an anonymization. If such a list exists the operation performed is a de-identification (permits a later re-identification).

fedora-packages:fmt-ptrn/fmt-ptrn.description: New is a template system, especially useful in conjunction with a simple text editor such as vi. The user maintains templates which may contain format strings. At run time, nf replaces the format strings in a template with appropriate values to create a new file. For example, given the following template: // FILE: %(FILE) // AUTHOR: %(FULLNAME) // DATE: %(DATE) // Copyright (C) 1999 %(FULLNAME) %(EMAIL) // All rights reserved. nf will create: // FILE: foo.cpp // AUTHOR: W. Michael Petullo // DATE: 11 September 1999 // Copyright (C) 1999 W. Michael Petullo new@flyn.org // All rights reserved. on my computer. The program understands plaintext or gziped template files. The fmt-ptrn system also provides a shared library which allows a programmer access to nf's functionality. The system was developed to be light and fast. Its only external dependencies are the C library, glib2 and zlib.

fedora-packages:ghc-free/ghc-free.name: ghc-free
fedora-packages:ghc-free/ghc-free.description: Free monads are useful for many tree-like structures and domain specific languages. If 'f' is a 'Functor' then the free 'Monad' on 'f' is the type of trees whose nodes are labeled with the constructors of 'f'. The word "free" is used in the sense of "unrestricted" rather than "zero-cost": 'Free f' makes no constraining assumptions beyond those given by 'f' and the definition of 'Monad'. As used here it is a standard term from the mathematical theory of adjoint functors. Cofree comonads are dual to free monads. They provide convenient ways to talk about branching streams and rose-trees, and can be used to annotate syntax trees. The cofree comonad can be seen as a stream parameterized by a 'Functor' that controls its branching factor. More information on free monads, including examples, can be found in the following blog posts: <https://ekmett.github.io/reader/2008/monads-for-free/> <https://ekmett.github.io/reader/2011/free-monads-for-less/>.

fedora-packages:golang-github-tdewolff-m.description: Minify is a minifier package written in Go. It provides HTML5, CSS3, JS, JSON, SVG and XML minifiers and an interface to implement any other minifier. Minification is the process of removing bytes from a file (such as whitespace) without changing its output and therefore shrinking its size and speeding up transmission over the internet and possibly parsing. The implemented minifiers are designed for high performance. The core functionality associates mimetypes with minification functions, allowing embedded resources (like CSS or JS within HTML files) to be minified as well. Users can add new implementations that are triggered based on a mimetype (or pattern), or redirect to an external command (like ClosureCompiler, UglifyCSS, ...).

fedora-packages:libdivide/libdivide-deve.name: libdivide-devel
fedora-packages:libdivide/libdivide-deve.description: This package contains a header-only C/C++ library for optimizing integer division. Integer division is one of the slowest instructions on most CPUs, e.g. on current x64 CPUs a 64-bit integer division has a latency of up to 90 clock cycles whereas a multiplication has a latency of only 3 clock cycles. libdivide allows you to replace expensive integer division instructions by a sequence of shift, add and multiply instructions that will calculate the integer division much faster. On current CPUs you can get a speedup of up to 10x for 64-bit integer division and a speedup of up to 5x for 32-bit integer division when using libdivide. libdivide also supports SSE2, AVX2, AVX512, NEON, and SVE vector division, which can provide an even larger speedup.

firefox-addons:3027372.name: WO2WEE Privacy Guard
firefox-addons:3027372.summary: Bereinigt Cookies, Cache, History & andere Browser Daten - Cookie Whitelist schützt Logins - Per-Domain Tracking-Schutz"
firefox-addons:3027372.description:
🧹 WO2WEE Privacy Guard
 Version 1.0 – browser extension
📌 Overview
WO2WEE Privacy Guard is a browser extension that deletes cookies, cache, history, local storage and other browser data in a targeted way – without losing important logins. 
A whitelist protects selected domains from deletion. Additionally, tracking protection can be activated per domain: only login‑relevant cookies are kept, all others (tracking cookies) are deleted.
✨ Main Features
 🧹 Cleaning of cookies, cache, history, IndexedDB, LocalStorage, service workers, form data, download list and passwords (the latter only after confirmation).
 🛡️ Whitelist – domains that will never be deleted (cookies and other data remain).
 🔒 Per‑domain tracking protection – on whitelisted domains you can choose: 
 "Keep only login cookies" → all other cookies are deleted. 
 "Keep all cookies" → tracking is allowed.
 🌍 Two languages – German and English (browser language is auto‑detected).
 🔁 Automatic cleaning – on browser start, on browser shutdown or when a tab is closed (optional).
 💾 Backup & restore – export/import of all settings (whitelist, tracking settings, data types) as a JSON file.
 📝 Bulk editor – edit the whitelist as plain text and apply with one click.
 🍪 Cookie inspector – view and copy all cookies of the current domain.
 ❄️ Freeze / Unfreeze cookies – temporary freeze individual cookies (backup + remove) and restore them later.
 📧 Anonymous cookie report – send metadata (no values) to the developer to improve tracking detection; you receive a personal link.
 🐛 Developer mode (hidden) – accessible via devtools.html , disables automatic tab closing and enables debug logs.
🚀 First Steps
⭐ Setup in 4 steps
 🌍 Global Tracking Control 
 Decide whether tracking cookies should be deleted globally and whether tracking protection is enabled for all whitelist domains.
 📋 Edit Whitelist 
 Add at least one domain (otherwise the security lock will block cleaning). For each domain, choose whether tracking protection is active (green = keep only login cookies, red = allow all cookies).
 🗂️ Select Data Types 
 Choose which additional data (cache, history, local storage, etc.) should be deleted.
 ⚙️ More Options 
 Here you can set up automatic cleaning, view the cleaning log, import/export settings, and reset all settings.
⚙️ Options in Detail
| Section | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Whitelist | Table of all protected domains. Tracking protection can be set per domain. |
| Bulk editor | Edit the whitelist as plain text (one domain per line) and apply. |
| Data types | Selection of browser data to be deleted (cache, history, IndexedDB, LocalStorage, …). |
| More options | Confirmation before cleaning, automatic cleaning on start/shutdown/tab close, backup & restore, reset settings. |
| Info | Background information on why certain features are not implemented. |
| Cookie inspector (popup) | Displays all cookies of the current domain, including details (Secure, Session, Domain). |
| All Cookies (Beta) | Complete list of all browser cookies. Freeze/Unfreeze cookies, export/import frozen cookies, sortable table. |
🛠️ Developer Tools (hidden)
The page devtools.html (reachable directly via the extension’s URL) offers:
 Developer mode : Prevents automatic closing of options/privacy pages when the popup is opened.
 Debug mode : Writes detailed logs (shown in the console and stored in storage).
 Debug logs : Displays the last log entries.
 Statistics : Reset cleaning counter and total deleted cookies.
 Complete storage reset : Button to erase all settings (useful for testing).
 This page is for developers only and is not shown in normal menus. 
📂 Backup & Restore
 Export : Click "📤 Export (JSON)" in the options. A file named wo2wee-privacy-guard-backup-YYYY-MM-DDTHH_MM_SS.json will be created.
 Import : Click "📥 Import (JSON)" and select a previously exported file. After confirmation the page reloads.
 Reset : The "Reset all settings" button resets all options to their default values (the whitelist remains).
🔐 Security & Privacy
 The extension needs the permissions cookies , browsingData , storage and tabs .
 No data is sent to third parties. All settings and logs remain in the browser’s local storage.
 The whitelist and tracking settings are stored in the extension’s storage.local area.
 A security lock prevents cleaning when the whitelist is empty – this avoids accidental loss of all cookies.
❓ Frequently Asked Questions
 Why is my domain not recognised on the whitelist? 
The domain must be entered exactly (e.g. example.com ). Subdomains are automatically covered if the main domain is on the whitelist.
 What happens when I enable tracking protection? 
On the whitelisted domain, only cookies that have httpOnly , secure or session are kept. All other cookies (e.g. tracking cookies) are deleted.
 Can I delete all cookies without a whitelist? 
No – the security lock blocks cleaning when the whitelist is empty. This prevents accidental loss of all logins.
💬 Support
For questions, suggestions or problems, please contact:
📧 wo2wee-privacy-guard@wo2wee.de 
---
🧹 WO2WEE Privacy Guard
 Version 1.0 – Browser Erweiterung
📌 Überblick
WO2WEE Privacy Guard ist eine Browser‑Erweiterung, die Cookies, Cache, Verlauf, Local Storage und andere Browser‑Daten gezielt löscht – ohne wichtige Logins zu verlieren. 
Eine Whitelist schützt ausgewählte Domains vor dem Löschen. Zusätzlich kann für jede Domain der Tracking‑Schutz einzeln aktiviert werden.
✨ Hauptfunktionen
 🧹 Reinigung von Cookies, Cache, Verlauf, IndexedDB, LocalStorage, Service Workern, Formulardaten, Download‑Liste und Passwörtern (letztere nur nach Bestätigung).
 🛡️ Whitelist – Domains, die nie gelöscht werden.
 🔒 Tracking‑Schutz pro Domain – Auf whitelisteten Domains: „Nur Login‑Cookies behalten“ oder „Alle Cookies behalten“.
 🌍 Zwei‑Sprachen – Deutsch und Englisch (Browser‑Sprache wird automatisch erkannt).
 🔁 Automatische Reinigung – beim Browserstart, beim Schließen des Browsers oder beim Schließen eines Tabs (optional).
 💾 Backup & Restore – Export/Import aller Einstellungen als JSON‑Datei.
 📝 Bulk‑Editor – Whitelist als Text bearbeiten und übernehmen.
 🍪 Cookie‑Inspektor – Alle Cookies der aktuellen Domain anzeigen und kopieren.
 ❄️ Freeze / Unfreeze – Einzelne Cookies vorübergehend einfrieren (sichern + entfernen) und später wiederherstellen.
 📧 Anonymer Cookie‑Report – Senden Sie Metadaten (keine Werte) an den Entwickler, um die Tracking‑Erkennung zu verbessern; Sie erhalten einen persönlichen Link.
 🐛 Entwickler‑Modus (versteckt) – über devtools.html erreichbar.
🚀 Erste Schritte
⭐ Einrichtung in 4 Schritten
 🌍 Globale Tracking‑Kontrolle 
 Legt fest, ob Tracking-Cookies global gelöscht werden und ob der Tracking‑Schutz für alle Whitelist‑Domains ein‑ oder ausgeschaltet ist.
 📋 Whitelist bearbeiten 
 Fügen Sie mindestens eine Domain hinzu (sonst blockiert die Sicherheitssperre die Reinigung). Bestimmen Sie pro Domain, ob der Tracking‑Schutz aktiv sein soll (grün = nur Login‑Cookies behalten, rot = alle Cookies erlauben).
 🗂️ Daten‑Typen auswählen 
 Wählen Sie aus, welche zusätzlichen Daten (Cache, Verlauf, Local Storage usw.) gelöscht werden sollen.
 ⚙️ Weitere Optionen 
 Hier finden Sie automatische Reinigungen, das Reinigungs‑Protokoll, Import/Export und die Möglichkeit, alle Einstellungen zurückzusetzen.
⚙️ Optionen im Detail
| Bereich | Beschreibung |
|---------|--------------|
| Whitelist | Tabelle aller geschützten Domains, Tracking‑Schutz pro Domain einstellbar. |
| Bulk‑Editor | Whitelist als Text bearbeiten und speichern. |
| Daten‑Typen | Auswahl der zu löschenden Browser‑Daten (Cache, Verlauf, LocalStorage, …). |
| Weitere Optionen | Bestätigung vor Reinigung, automatische Reinigung, Backup & Restore, Einstellungen zurücksetzen. |
| Info | Hintergrundinformationen zu fehlenden Features. |
| Cookie‑Inspektor (Popup) | Zeigt alle Cookies der aktuellen Domain an. |
| Alle Cookies (Beta) | Vollständige Liste aller Browser‑Cookies. Freeze/Unfreeze, Export/Import gefrorener Cookies, sortierbare Tabelle. |
🛠️ Entwickler‑Tools (versteckt)
Die Seite devtools.html (direkt über die Adressleiste erreichbar) bietet:
 Entwickler‑Modus : Verhindert automatisches Schließen von Options‑/Privacy‑Seiten.
 Debug‑Modus : Schreibt detaillierte Logs.
 Debug‑Logs : Anzeige der letzten Log‑Einträge.
 Statistiken : Reinigungszähler und gelöschte Cookies zurücksetzen.
 Storage‑Reset : Löscht alle gespeicherten Einstellungen (wie Neuinstallation).
 Diese Seite ist nur für Entwickler gedacht. 
📂 Datensicherung
 Export : Klicke in den Optionen auf „📤 Export (JSON)“. Es wird eine Datei mit dem Namen wo2wee-privacy-guard-backup-YYYY-MM-DDTHH_MM_SS.json erstellt.
 Import : Klicke auf „📥 Import (JSON)“ und wähle eine zuvor exportierte Datei.
 Zurücksetzen : Mit dem Button „Alle Einstellungen zurücksetzen“ werden alle Optionen auf die Standardwerte zurückgesetzt (die Whitelist bleibt erhalten).
🔐 Sicherheit & Datenschutz
 Die Erweiterung benötigt die Berechtigungen cookies , browsingData , storage und tabs .
 Es werden keine Daten an Dritte gesendet. Alle Einstellungen und Logs bleiben lokal im Browser‑Storage.
 Die Sicherheitssperre verhindert die Reinigung, wenn die Whitelist leer ist – so wird der Verlust aller Cookies vermieden.
❓ Häufige Fragen
 Warum wird meine Domain nicht auf der Whitelist erkannt? 
Die Domain muss exakt eingegeben werden (z.B. example.com ). Subdomains werden automatisch erkannt, wenn die Hauptdomain auf der Whitelist steht.
 Was passiert, wenn ich den Tracking‑Schutz aktiviere? 
Auf der Whitelist‑Domain werden nur Cookies mit httpOnly , secure oder session behalten. Alle anderen Cookies (z.B. Tracking‑Cookies) werden gelöscht.
 Kann ich auch alle Cookies löschen, ohne Whitelist? 
Nein – die Sicherheitssperre blockiert die Reinigung, wenn die Whitelist leer ist.
💬 Support
Bei Fragen, Anregungen oder Problemen wenden Sie sich bitte an:
📧 wo2wee-privacy-guard@wo2wee.de

firefox-addons:2592263.name: Always Open Privately
firefox-addons:2592263.summary: Always opens certain websites (configurable list of websites) in a private window. Needs the permission to run in private windows.
firefox-addons:2592263.description:
Firefox add-on to always open specific websites in private windows.
This Firefox add-on provides the functionality to configure a whitelist of domain names. If while browsing a domain name matches a domain on the whitelist, this add-on will try to prevent Firefox from loading the website in a non-private window, open a new private window and load the website there.
Because of how webextension add-ons work, it is not always possible to prevent Firefox from loading a website . However, this add-on will always open a new private window and load the website there.
 Usage 
Always Open Privately needs the permission to run in private windows . This setting may be set manually in the add-on manager in Firefox.
In the settings panel, add one domain per line.
 Permissions 
The add-on requires several permissions. It just asks for the absolutely required permissions.
 webNavigation : to get notified about new URLs (new site visits)
 tabs : to get the URL to be opened
 activeTab : to stop loading a website
 http://, https:// : to be able to intercept requests to every possible domain
 storage : to save add-on settings

firefox-addons:839767.name: ClearURLs
firefox-addons:839767.summary: Automatically removes tracking parameters from URLs
firefox-addons:839767.description:
Automatically remove tracking parameters from URLs and browse with cleaner links. 
ClearURLs automatically removes known tracking parameters from URLs while you browse, helping prevent unnecessary tracking and making links cleaner and easier to share.
 Automatically removes known tracking parameters
 Skips known tracking redirects when possible
 Open source and built with privacy in mind
 Does not collect your browsing or usage data
 How does it work? 
Websites often add tracking parameters to URLs to measure clicks, identify where visitors came from, or associate browsing activity with advertising and analytics campaigns.
For example:
 https://example.com/?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=sale
ClearURLs removes the known tracking parameters:
 https://example.com/
The destination remains the same, while unnecessary tracking information is removed.
 Features 
 Automatically removes known tracking elements from URLs
 Skips known tracking redirects and takes you directly to the destination when possible
 Adds a context menu option for copying cleaned links
 Includes a built in tool for cleaning multiple URLs at once
 Blocks hyperlink auditing, also known as ping tracking
 Prevents tracking parameters from being injected through the History API
 Prevents Google and Yandex from rewriting search result links to include tracking elements
 Optionally blocks some common advertising domains
 Privacy 
ClearURLs is designed to protect your privacy.
 We do not collect your browsing or usage data. 
ClearURLs is completely open source. Anyone can inspect the source code, see how the extension works, report problems, or contribute to the project.
 View the source code on GitHub 
 Permissions 
ClearURLs requires certain browser permissions to detect and clean URLs while you browse.
 Learn why ClearURLs needs these permissions 
 Support and feedback 
If you encounter a problem, find a bug, or have a suggestion, please let us know on GitHub.
 Report an issue or suggest an improvement 
For additional information, visit the ClearURLs documentation .
 You can also view the complete changelog on GitHub .

firefox-addons:3026511.name: privacy-shield-for-whatsappweb
firefox-addons:3026511.summary:
Hide or blur chats, message previews, messages, avatars, and media on WhatsApp Web until you 
 explicitly reveal them.
firefox-addons:3026511.description:
WhatsApp Privacy Shield adds a privacy layer to WhatsApp Web. 
It helps prevent shoulder-surfing by hiding or blurring sensitive content until the user 
 intentionally reveals it. 
### Features 
 Hide or blur WhatsApp Web content by default 
 Keep sidebar contact and group names visible while hiding the message preview 
 Blur message text instead of replacing it with black boxes 
 Blur media while preserving original colors, with a centered extension logo 
 Reveal individual items temporarily 
 Auto-hide revealed content after a configurable timer 
 Panic button to instantly re-hide all revealed content in open WhatsApp Web tabs 
 Supports WhatsApp Web’s dynamic single-page-app updates 
### Privacy modes 
 Hide Everything : chats, messages, media, avatars 
 Hide Media Only : images, videos, grouped media, documents 
 Hide Chats Only : sidebar previews and related chat-list privacy elements 
 Disabled : temporarily turn privacy protection off 
### Privacy 
This extension runs only on https://web.whatsapp.com/* . 
It does not collect personal data, does not send data to external servers, does not load remote 
 code, and stores only local user preferences such as privacy mode and reveal timer settings.

firefox-addons:2915292.name: Read Frog - AI Translation & Flashcards
firefox-addons:2915292.summary: Read any website, YouTube or Netflix video, or X post in two languages with AI translation. Save the words you don't know and review them as flashcards with spaced repetition. Free to use and open source.
firefox-addons:2915292.description:
Read any website, YouTube or Netflix video, or X post in two languages. Select the words you don't know, save them, and review them later as flashcards. Read Frog is an open-source AI translation and language learning extension. Looking for an open-source alternative to Immersive Translate? Read Frog translates pages and subtitles side by side too, and turns the words you save into flashcards.
BILINGUAL WEB PAGES
• Show each translated paragraph right below the original, or show the translation only.
• AI translation reads the whole article for context, so terms and tone stay consistent.
• Shape the wording with custom prompts and your own glossary.
• Translate a page in one click, or have the sites you choose translate automatically.
SELECT TO TRANSLATE
• Select any text for an instant translation, free.
• Run AI actions on the selection: a dictionary entry with example sentences and memory tips, a teacher-style breakdown of long sentences, feedback on your writing, or actions you create yourself.
• Hear any selection read aloud in 70+ languages, at 0.25x to 4x speed.
DUAL SUBTITLES FOR VIDEOS
• Bilingual subtitles on YouTube (including Shorts and embedded players), Netflix and X.
• Hover over the subtitles to pause the video, then click any word: an AI dictionary explains it in the context of that line. You can switch it to an AI action of your own.
• No captions on a YouTube video? AI can transcribe the audio and show it as bilingual subtitles.
• On YouTube, the Learning panel lists the full transcript with translations and sums up the video with AI.
• Choose original, translation or both, and adjust the font, size, colors and position.
SAVE AND REVIEW
• Save new words and sentences to Notebase, your personal word bank.
• Review them as flashcards, Anki-style but without making cards by hand: every note you save gets its cards automatically. The FSRS spaced-repetition algorithm schedules each card for just before you would forget it.
YOUR CHOICE OF TRANSLATION SERVICE
• 30+ translation services: free machine translation, AI models with your own API key, or a local model running on your own computer.
• Batched requests keep API costs down.
• Video subtitles can use a different service and prompt from page translation.
FREE AND PAID
Read Frog is free to use with the free translation services or your own API keys. The Pro and Ultra plans add built-in AI and AI-generated subtitles for videos without captions.
OPEN SOURCE
Read Frog is open source under the GPL-3.0 license.
Website: https://readfrog.app 
GitHub: https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog 
Discord: https://discord.gg/ej45e3PezJ

firefox-addons:774791.name: Password Hasher Plus - Password Generator
firefox-addons:774791.summary: Password Hasher Plus automatically enhances password strength (length and difficulty) to protect your accounts.
firefox-addons:774791.description:
This extension allows you to choose different passwords for each website which requires an account without having to remember all of them. The extension achieves this by taking your master password and hashing it based on the website's domain (e.g. the google in www.google.com ) to create a password that is unique to that website.
Quickstart Guide:
0a) First time only: check that site settings are correct and that you have enabled compatibility mode if you're coming from the old Firefox plugin.
0b) First time only: check the global settings in the options page of the extension to choose your password length.
1) Input your master password in the password field
2) Press the '#' button near the password field or use Ctrl+# to hash the password in place
3) Optional: Use the '*' button or press Ctrl+* to check either your master password or the hash word (depending on whether you've hashed your master password already or not).
4) Login
Password Hasher Plus is a replacement for the Password Hasher extension which unfortunately is not developed anymore and does not work correctly with multi-process Firefox and not at all with Firefox Quantum.
 To generate hash words which are identical to the old version, you have to enable compatibility mode! 
If you were using custom settings for the hash word you can use password strength "Custom" to select the options you were using. Note that "digits only" is present as strength "Numeric".
Optionally, you can also use your Firefox account to synchronize/share settings between different Firefox installations. See this Mozilla support article for details on how to setup Sync. Note that for synchronizing addon settings you have to enable synchronizing Addons in your browser's Firefox Account settings .
A quick explanation of the sync-related options:
1. Choose whether to use local or sync storage (the first dropdown menu).
2. Choose how to switch storage. You can select to use whatever settings exist in the storage you selected in step 1 ("Use existing settings"), alternatively you can choose to overwrite whatever is in the storage selected in step 1 with your current settings ("Overwrite existing settings"), third you can choose to merge your current settings with the settings which exist in the storage selected in step 1, giving preference to either the settings available locally or in Sync.
Because there is no WebExtensions API for accessing the browser's credential storage -- yet? see this Firefox bug -- you will have to migrate site tags and settings manually.

bluejetty:00044280:ios.description:
Photo Recovery is the all-in-one photo management tool designed for iPhone users. It helps you effortlessly recover lost photos, clean up unnecessary files, free up storage space, protect your privacy, and enhance your photos with AI-powered tools.
Key Features:
1. Photo Recovery
-One-Click Recovery: Accidentally deleted important photos or videos? Don’t worry! With just one tap, Photo Recovery can restore your recently deleted photos and videos. Whether it’s a mistaken deletion or a system glitch, your precious memories are never truly lost.
-Smart Search: Use the powerful search feature to quickly find and recover the photos or videos you need, even if they’re buried deep in your album.
2. AI Photo Cleanup & Storage Optimization
-Clean Duplicates & Similar Photos
Instantly find and remove duplicate/similar photos, videos, screenshots and burst shots. Free up space on iPhone and iCloud with one tap!
-Smart Video Compression
Shrink video sizes by 50-80% without quality loss. Save space while keeping your HD memories.
-Merge Duplicate Contacts
Automatically find and merge duplicate contacts by name, number or email. Includes one-click backup to never lose contacts.
-Large File Management: Sort videos and photos by size, making it easy to delete large files that are taking up too much space. Free up significant storage in seconds.
-Smart Recommendations: Among similar photos, the app intelligently suggests the best one (e.g., high clarity, natural expression, good focus) to help you make better decisions.
3. AI Photo Toolbox
-Colorize B&W Photos: Bring old black-and-white photos back to life with vibrant colors.
-Restore Old Photos: Repair scratches, fading, and damage in aged photographs.
-Sharpen Blurry Photos: Enhance clarity and details in out-of-focus images.
-Enhance Photo Quality: Automatically improve resolution and overall image quality.
4. Private Photo Vault
-Privacy Protection: Lock sensitive photos and videos with a password or fingerprint, storing them in a secure private vault. Your private moments stay hidden and protected.
-Secure Storage: All files stored in the vault are encrypted, ensuring your private data remains safe even if your phone is lost or stolen.
Why Choose Photo Recovery: Phone Cleanup?
• Easy to Use: No technical skills needed. With a simple and intuitive interface, you can recover, clean, and protect your photos in just a few steps.
• Smart & Efficient: Powered by AI technology, the app intelligently identifies duplicate photos, similar images, and large files, helping you free up storage space quickly.
• Privacy First: Your data is always secure. All operations are encrypted, and your photos are never uploaded or shared.
• All-in-One Solution: Photo recovery, cleanup, and privacy protection—all in one app. It’s everything you need to manage your photos effortlessly.
Subscription Plans & Pricing:
Photo Recovery offers Basic ($5.99/week or $18.99/year) and Premium ($6.99/week or $20.99/year) plans. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
Auto-Renewal & Cancellation:
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Privacy & Security:
Your privacy is our top priority. All operations are encrypted, and your photos and data are never uploaded or shared. With Photo Recovery: Phone Cleanup, you can enjoy a secure and seamless photo management experience.

Custom Color
Change the color of your audio system.
- Voice Playback
Record your voice through the microphone on this device. After the recording, you can preset your voice and play over and over again.

Emits light from the smartphones of party participants in sync with the music.

- Voice Control via Fiestable

Compatible products added. For details, please refer to the list of devices which support Music Center.

listings.name: Fiestable
listings.description:
Fiestable is an app which controls the party features of Sony’s Home Audio System with intuitive and fancy user interface.

To operate compatible Sony speakers, "Sony | Music Center" is required. Prepare the compatible device, be sure to install the latest "Sony | Music Center" app, and use Fiestable from Music Center.
Download the "Sony | Music Center" app (free) here.
http://sony.net/smcapp/


Main Feature:*
- DJ Control
Control DJ Effect (Isolator/Flanger/Wah/Pan), Sampler (Drums, Voice, etc.) and EQ of your audio system.
- Illumination
Custom Flash
Change the color and flashing speed of your audio system.
Custom Color
Change the color of your audio system.
- Voice Playback
Record your voice through the microphone on this device. After the recording, you can preset your voice and play over and over again.
- Party Light via Fiestable
Emits light from the smartphones of party participants in sync with the music.
- Party Playlist
Continuously plays songs favorited by participants on their smartphone
- Voice Control via Fiestable
Operations including playback, volume adjustment, and lighting can be performed by voice.
- KARAOKE/TAIKO Game Ranking
You can save your KARAOKE/TAIKO GAME score and check your rank.
* Limited to compatible devices.


Compatible Sony products:
Compatible products added. For details, please refer to the list of devices which support Music Center.


Note:
* Starting with version 5.7 of this app, it is only available on iOS 15.0 or later.
To control functions of Sony speakers with this app, Bluetooth connection and Sony | Music Center are required.
Depending on specification of smartphones, Motion Control cannot be used. Please refer to below URL for further information.
http://www.sony.eu/support
Motion Control is not available on tablet devices.

bluejetty:00120488:ios.description:
There's never been a better time to get into Astronomy! Start off easy with an app that will guide you around the night sky.
"The app works beautifully, making astronomy a bit less mysterious—but no less remarkable", MacWorld
 "It’s truly an impressive marvel. 5 Mice out of 5", MacWorld.
 "..one of the prettiest and easiest to use. And at three bucks, it’s a steal", Cult of Mac.
Apple App Store Staff Favorite
Voted Best Educational iPhone Application by AppAdvice
---
Pocket Universe 2 turns your iPhone or iPad into an intuitive guide to the night sky. Just point your device upward to instantly identify what’s overhead—planets, constellations, comets, satellites, and deep-sky wonders.
Designed for clarity and ease of use, Pocket Universe 2 helps you learn the sky naturally, whether you’re stepping outside for a quick look or exploring in detail from your couch.
Key features
 • Live sky view: Aim your device to identify stars, planets, the ISS, satellites, comets, and bright deep-sky objects in real time.
 • Time travel: Scrub hours or days forward and back, jump to sunrise, sunset, golden hour, moonrise, or moonset - and return to “now” instantly.
 • Explore mode: Discover what’s worth looking for tonight, with summaries of upcoming events, solar activity, Moon phases and maps, Jupiter and Saturn’s moons and rings, a full Solar System orrery, and dedicated ISS and satellite views.
 • Find anything fast: Search by name, browse curated “cool things” lists, or jump straight to planets and other Solar System bodies.
 • Rich object details: Learn about thousands of objects, including planets, stars, galaxies, nebulae, and more.
 • Widgets: Add Sun and Moon times and Moon phase to your Home Screen or desktop.
 • Deep customization: Night vision mode, labels, grids, constellation lines, satellites, comets, and more. Save presets to switch instantly between your favorite viewing modes.
Pocket Universe 2 is the sequel to Pocket Universe, one of the first astronomy apps on the App Store. It has been completely rewritten using modern frameworks and tools to deliver a faster, cleaner, and more immersive stargazing experience. 
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00033997:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a Dumb Phone.
Dumb Phone™ lets you create your very own minimalist-style phone on iOS.
Replace colorful app icons, pesky notification badges, and anything that might give you a dopamine hit when you unlock your phone, with simple buttons to open your essential apps - and nothing more.
Key features:
• Break out of your existing habits
Every time you unlock your phone, all you will see is apps that you need, without being coerced into easy distractions from colorful apps on your Home Screen or the App Library.
• Create a Minimalist Launcher
Select apps and add Dumb Phone widgets to your Home Screen to blend everything together.
• Choose your essential apps
Select apps that you frequently use, so they are a single tap away.
• Style your Home Screen
Choose from a Dark or Light minimalist style, by adjusting your wallpaper, background, text, and more, with themes.
• Adapt to Liquid Glass changes
Reduce the addictive elements of the Liquid Glass Home Screen style, applied in the latest version of iOS.
• Create multiple app launchers
Create launchers for leisure, work, night time, so you see the most important apps in context to your day.
• Detox Mode
Create an immersive dumb phone experience by choosing which non-essential apps to block and/or hide on your device, with the powerful capabilities of Screen Time.
• Control Center widgets 
Quickly switch between app launchers from the Control Center with new control center widgets that instantly change your Home Screen.
Download the Dumb Phone app today and embrace the full benefits of minimalism, and turn your iPhone into a powerful utility once more.
Visit the Dumb Phone app website for more info:
https://dumbphone.so/
View our Privacy & Terms at:
https://dumbphone.so/privacy

bluejetty:00021484:ios.description:
Since our inception as Army Times in 1940, U.S. military members have turned to us for independent, rigorous coverage of issues affecting their careers and personal lives.
Our award-winning journalism has had a strong heritage and tradition of meeting the highest standards of independence. Over the years, we've expanded with publications serving all branches of the U.S. military, the global defense community, the U.S. federal government, and several special interest, defense-oriented industry sectors.
Our Military Times app provides you with unbiased, timely reporting on:
• Military news (global conflicts, deployments, defense budgets and more)
• Pay and benefits
• Pentagon & Congress
• Military families
• Financial services
• Health care and access
• Education and training
• Transitioning from military to civilian life
• Veterans
• Off-duty humor and culture
You’ll also get:
• Provocative commentary & opinion
• Engaging video segments
• Special reports
APP FEATURES:
• Easily share articles with friends, colleagues or on social media with the tap of a button.
• Browse through a copy of our print publication.
• Select and save important articles so you can revisit them later. Easily access your saved articles in a special tab curated by you.

TERMS OF SERVICE: https://www.militarytimes.com/m/terms-of-services/

bluejetty:00019368:ios.summary: The Real Drum provides all the tools necessary to master the art of playing drums on your smartphone or tablet. Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Experience the sensation of your fingers transforming into drumsticks and feel like
bluejetty:00019368:ios.description:
The Real Drum provides all the tools necessary to master the art of playing drums on your smartphone or tablet. Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Experience the sensation of your fingers transforming into drumsticks and feel like part of a real band!
What is a drum set?
A drum set is a collection of drums, cymbals, and sometimes other percussion musical instruments arranged for one person to play. 
Why haven't you started learning to play the drums yet?
The Real Drum offers various video lessons to assist you, along with a variety of loops to play along with.
Don't have access to an acoustic drum set or electronic drums?
No problem! The Real Drum offers a diverse range of percussion musical instruments with high-quality sounds, allowing you to play any music you desire!
You don't need an acoustic drum set or electronic drums to learn to play!
The Real Drum is an excellent choice for practicing or playing drums quietly, without causing disruptions or requiring much space. Enjoy the freedom to play drums wherever you like!
You can customize the drum set to your liking!
With complete customization freedom, you can choose the number of drum pads and cymbals, their size, and their placement on the screen. This allows for a personalized drumming experience tailored to your preferences!
Show your friends how good you are at playing drums!
Share your drum kits and videos of your performances with friends and on social media!
The Real Drum app allows children and adults to learn drumming while having fun, enhancing their cognitive and motor skills. This drum game will stimulate your musical talent, making it easy to learn drum beats as if using a real drum kit.
So what are you waiting for to become a drummer?
Explore Real Drum features:
- Over 100 drum lessons to learn drumming
- Various drum kits, including realistic 3D drums
- Customize your drum set: upload your images and sounds and create your own drum set
- Wide variety of drums, cymbals, and other musical percussion instruments
- Loops for playing along
- Studio-quality audio
- Export your recordings to MP3 format
- Share your recordings and custom drum sets on social media
- New drum sets, drum lessons, and loops introduced weekly
- Compatible with all screen resolutions – Phones and Tablets (HD images)
- MIDI support
- Free app
The app contains the following subscription:
- Premium Version (Remove ads; Unlock all loops; Unlock all lessons and Unlock Metronome)
- Monthly payment ($3,90).
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal.
- The subsequent monthly subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the next renewal (considering the day of the effective monthly subscription).
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use and Privacy Policy:
http://www.kolbapps.com/privacy_policy_and_terms.pdf
Designed for drummers, percussionists, professional musicians, enthusiasts, and beginners!
Download the Real Drum app and turn your fingers into drumsticks right now!
Follow us on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube for tips on using the app: @kolbapps

bluejetty:00167856:ios.description:
Stay on top of your classes with the all-in-one homework tracker, study planner, and class schedule app.
Assignment Tracker: Timetable is the ultimate homework tracker and school planner designed to help every student take control of their academic life. Whether you’re in college, high school, or university, this app makes it easy to manage your assignments, build your study timetable, and stay on top of your class schedule.
Built for real student needs, Assignment Tracker: Timetable helps you track assignments, plan for exams, organize your courses, and stay ahead with smart reminders and a powerful task manager. It’s more than just a planner, it’s your daily companion through school, college, and everything in between.
Key Features:
Smart class schedule app with visual timetable
Powerful homework planner with due date tracking
Manage multiple courses, subjects, and assignments
Create a personalized study planner and routine
Never miss a deadline with built-in exam countdown and reminders
Add detailed notes to your tasks, classes, and exams
Perfect for all levels: high school, university, and college students
Whether you're juggling lectures, upcoming exams, or daily homework tasks, Assignment Tracker: Timetable helps you stay organized and stress-free. Plan your week with a full study timetable, add your class schedule, set goals for every assignment, and get notified when it’s time to focus.
This app combines the power of a course planner, task manager, and exam countdown timer into one beautifully designed student planner.
Make your academic life easier. Plan smarter. Study better.
 Download Assignment Tracker: Timetable today, your all-in-one homework tracker, study planner, and class schedule organizer.

bluejetty:00040704:ios.summary:
Power Inc is an idle simulation tycoon game where you start in 1890 with one turbine, two stiff arms, and zero customers — and end up rewiring civilization itself.
Crank. Automate. Electrify. Build a power empire across the eras in this ja
bluejetty:00040704:ios.description:
Power Inc is an idle simulation tycoon game where you start in 1890 with one turbine, two stiff arms, and zero customers — and end up rewiring civilization itself.
Crank. Automate. Electrify. Build a power empire across the eras in this jazzy idle tycoon game with historical ambitions.
It's a city builder, a business tycoon, an incremental idle game, and a love letter to the people who hand-cranked the modern world. Tap to play, idle to win.
GENERATE POWER
 - Spin a crank like it's 1890 (because it is)
 - Hire muscle so your wrists can retire
 - Unlock bigger, better, slightly less embarrassing turbines
BUILD AND GROW A CITY
 - More watts → more houses → more customers
 - Construct commercial and industrial districts with juicy perks
 - Upgrade homes with tech your great-great-grandparents wouldn't recognize
 - Watch a sleepy hamlet sprawl into a glittering metropolis
RESEARCH & AUTOMATE
 - Hire scientists. They invent things. You get rich. The system works.
 - Climb a skill tree and automate the daily grind
 - Invent products your citizens didn't know they needed
 - Manage a fleet of researchers across multiple cities
A SOUNDTRACK WITH SWING
 - An original jazzy score with custom-composed tracks
 - High-production music that turns turbine-spinning into a smoky little jam session
 - Headphones strongly encouraged
WHY YOU'LL KEEP COMING BACK:
 - Classic idle tycoon mechanics with a fresh historical hook
 - Deep simulation systems — power, economy, research, all entangled
 - Easy to learn, satisfying to optimize
 - Cozy art, cheeky writing, zero pressure
 - No forced ads — watch one if you want a boost, never because we made you
 - No forced tutorials — poke around, break things, learn at your own pace

Relaxing Yet Rewarding
 No stress, no timers – just soothing gameplay and beautiful visuals for a mindful experience.
Boost Your Vocabulary
 Learn new words and expand your language skills as you play through artistic worlds.
Ready to Swipe Through Words and Art?
 Start your journey through a relaxing word adventure filled with creativity, discovery, and classic masterpieces.

bluejetty:00070749:ios.summary: Group Text is an easy, user-friendly, time-saving and well-designed app enabling individual text messages to a group of contacts at once. Easily create & change your groups. Quickly search your groups/contacts. Possibility to select multip
bluejetty:00070749:ios.description:
Group Text is an easy, user-friendly, time-saving and well-designed app enabling individual text messages to a group of contacts at once. Easily create & change your groups. Quickly search your groups/contacts. Possibility to select multiple numbers per contact. Use “template” feature to instantly send recurrent content to your groups. When using Group Text you should abide by local regulations on sending out mass text messages. Please ensure that all recipients have provided prior consent. 
There is no advertising in the App!
GROUPS FEATURES
• Import your existing iCloud groups at first use
• Create your own groups: Family, Friends, Colleagues…
• Change your groups by assigning/removing contacts
• Already assigned contacts/numbers are always marked
• Use “Select All” feature to assign all your contacts at once 
• Enabling multiple numbers selection per contact
• The total number of contacts is always shown for each group
• Easily find your groups or contacts to be assigned/removed
• Display order of contacts in line with your device settings
• Newly created groups are always highlighted for easy access 
TEXT MESSAGING
• Instantly send text message to your groups
• Quickly add/remove contacts before sending
TEMPLATES
• Create predefined templates for your recurrent contents
• Instantly send text message by selecting a template
• Edit the selected template before sending if needed
AVAILABLE IN 15 DIFFERENT LANGUAGES
English, Nederlands, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Português , 中文 (Simplified), 中文 (Traditional), 日本語, 한국어, , Русский, Türkçe, العربية, עברית
UPGRADE TO PREMIUM VERSION THROUGH IN-APP PURCHASE
• Create unlimited groups
• Split big groups
• Personalize your text messages with tags (firstname, lastname, company)
• Send to more than 5 contacts at once
• Send using templates
• Create your own templates
SUPPORT
• Integrated support functionality & FAQ
• Submit bugs and issues directly from the App
• 24/7 availability
COMING SOON
• Smart filters for contacts
• Reminders for planned sendings
• Update contact details directly from the App
• Share groups
• iCloud sync through all your devices
• 3D Touch options
• And much more...
Feel free to propose awesome functionalities! 
NOTES
* If you have iMessage turned on, the App will use it to send out group texts.
You can find our Terms of Service here: 
https://masstextapp.s3.amazonaws.com/TOS.txt

bluejetty:00035169:ios.summary: Step into the eerie world of Backrooms Union Multiplayer, a unique multiplayer horror game that immerses you in the spine-chilling, maze-like dimensions of the Backrooms. As part of the Union, you and your team are tasked with exploring the
bluejetty:00035169:ios.description:
Step into the eerie world of Backrooms Union Multiplayer, a unique multiplayer horror game that immerses you in the spine-chilling, maze-like dimensions of the Backrooms. As part of the Union, you and your team are tasked with exploring these endless, shifting corridors, scavenging for critical scraps, and surviving the lurking horrors. Whether you choose to go solo or collaborate with friends, every decision matters as you delve deeper into the unknown.
Each level of the Backrooms presents a fresh challenge. Maze-like environments keep you disoriented, while deadly traps and relentless monsters test your courage and strategy. The Backrooms are unpredictable, with surprises hiding around every corner, ensuring no two experiences are alike. Every level is a new test of survival, with sinister entities and hidden mysteries waiting to be uncovered.
In Backrooms Union Multiplayer, your mission goes beyond mere survival. The Union’s true purpose remains shrouded in mystery. Why are you sent into these terrifying realms? What secrets is the Union hiding? As you gather scraps and uncover fragments of information, you’ll piece together the chilling truth behind the organization and their connection to the Backrooms.
This game combines the heart-pounding tension of survival horror with co-op multiplayer. Whether you're working with your team to evade monsters or navigating solo through the darkness, Backrooms Union Multiplayer promises a thrilling and unpredictable experience. Inspired by the mysteries of the Backrooms and creepypasta lore, it offers a rich, suspenseful adventure for horror fans.
Surprises and challenges await at every turn. Will you and your team uncover the truth and make it out alive, or will the Backrooms claim you? Test your courage, wit, and teamwork in Backrooms Union Multiplayer—a horror experience like no other

NYC Restaurant Inspection Grades
Before you eat, inspect the restaurant! All New York City restaurants on a map, color-coded to reveal the grade provided by the health department. (Green is good; red is bad.) Use your current location to s
bluejetty:00041941:ios.description:
NYC Restaurant Inspection Grades
Before you eat, inspect the restaurant! All New York City restaurants on a map, color-coded to reveal the grade provided by the health department. (Green is good; red is bad.) Use your current location to see a map of the immediate area or search for your favorite place. Click through to read a history of its inspections and health violations, then decide to skip dinner, maybe.
Fastest restaurant inspection, all info on your device, no Internet access needed.
Features:
* Search by restaurant name, street name, or cuisine type
* Works even when you don't have Internet access (but doesn't show maps): you can look for restaurants when you're in the subway!
* Restaurants can be shown on a map or as a list
* Locator button on bottom right sets the map to your present location
* Color coding of locator dots reveals level of restaurant violations, on a sliding scale from green (best) to red (worst)
* If a restaurant is Grade Pending, color dot indicates whether it would be a B or a C by the inspection score
* Mark favorite restaurants
* Links to walking directions, phone the restaurant
All restaurant information provided by the New York Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. Restaurants close, things change, and maps are not always accurate. Regular updates will attempt to fix any problems.

bluejetty:00157726:ios.description:
Introducing our Portrait Retouch App -- Perfect Me, designed to make photo editing easier and more enjoyable for everyone! We know that portrait editing can get complicated, but we believe it doesn't have to be. With Perfect Me, you can simply let AI automatically analyzes your photos and suggests perfect presets tailored to your needs.
Each preset combines various features like facial reshaping, blemish removal, skin smoothing, and makeup enhancement. This means you can achieve a stunning look with just one tap! Whether you want to enhance your natural beauty or try something new, our app has you covered!
 Here’s what makes our app a must-have:
[AI Analysis & Presets] All our editing features come with one-click presets. No matter what kind of edits you want to make, you can achieve perfect results quickly. Say goodbye to spending half an hour switching between multiple tools for detailed retouching!
[Face Retouch & Tune] Enjoy detailed facial beautification features, including face shape and feature adjustments, skin smoothing, blemish and wrinkle removal, trendy makeup effects, hair coloring and smoothing, teeth whitening and more. Whatever facial enhancement you desire, we’ve got you covered!
[Body Reshape & Slim] Our app provides body adjustment features for all areas, allowing you to not only slim down and get taller, but also enhance curves, optimize body proportions, slim arms, flatten your belly, and even add abs!
[AI 3D Relight] Experience studio-quality lighting effects through our advanced 3D modeling technology. This feature helps you create portraits with a captivating atmosphere, just like in a professional photo studio!
[Latest AI Features] Let AI unlock even more editing possibilities for you! Fix awkward expressions, try out various fashionable outfits, enhance image quality, and convert photos into cartoon effects. Plus, we’ll keep updating with new AI features and effects regularly!
[Multi Format Support] Whether it’s photos, videos, or live photos, our app supports multiple formats, making it easy for you to beautify your portraits in any way you choose.
Download Perfect Me today and experience the magic of easy, beautiful editing! Transform your photos effortlessly and let your true beauty shine through!

bluejetty:00043892:ios.description:
You shouldn't have to choose between getting stronger and feeling supported by your pelvic floor. Leakage, prolapse, diastasis recti, and core dysfunction aren't just inconveniences, they're signals. Connect teaches you to train with your pelvic floor, not against it, so you can build real, lasting strength from the inside out. This truly is the pelvic floor fitness program your body has been asking for.
Developed by Caroline Packard, DPT - pelvic floor physical therapist and mom of three, Connect is a complete training platform that treats the pelvic floor as the foundation of total body strength. No guesswork. No generic fitness. A clear, structured path forward at every stage.
WHAT'S INSIDE
A growing library of strength training, HIIT, advanced core, yoga, mobility, and more with every workout designed specifically for women and built to progress with you. New workouts added every month.
PELVIC FLOOR FOUNDATIONS — 19 Weeks 
Our signature program. Five progressive phases that take you from foundational awareness to advanced athletic strength with built-in self-assessments at every stage to confirm mastery before you move forward.
- Prep Week (1 week) — Release tension and learn to breathe
- Reset (4 weeks) — Breath control and pressure management
- Integrate (4 weeks) — Strength training with pelvic floor integration
- Strength Fundamentals (4 weeks) — Progressive loading and strength
- Elevated Strength (6 weeks) — Advanced athletic movement
ADVANCED PROGRAMS — 10+ Specialized Tracks, 9–12 Weeks Each
For Foundations graduates ready to keep building. Choose from 10+ specialized training programs all designed through a pelvic floor and core-informed lens including return to running, core-focused training, progressive strength, full-body performance tracks and dedicated 30-minute programs for when life is full but your training doesn't stop. New programs are continually added. 
SPECIALTY LIBRARY - Specialized instruction on proper form, mobility, symptom relief, and movement troubleshooting.
MEMBERSHIP FEATURES
- Every workout includes expert instruction on form, breathing, and modifications
- Self-assessments throughout to track progress and guide your next step
- Monthly live Q&A sessions with Caroline
- Private members-only community for connection, encouragement, and expert guidance from our coaches
- Pelvic floor educational resources to understand the root causes of dysfunction and how to overcome them

Mobile · Tablet · Web · Apple TV · Amazon Fire TV · Roku

bluejetty:00115782:ios.description:
A pointy-clicky comedy corporate thriller. Solve puzzles, get to know your colleagues, and unravel a sinister global conspiracy. All in a day's work.
The Biggleboss Incident is a fun, funny point and click adventure that somehow merges Monkey Island, Office Space, and a smidge of Metal Gear Solid.
It’s just like those adventure games you remember, only without the insane moon logic.
— INTRIGUING STORY! —
There is NOTHING sinister happening at Biggleboss Inc.
Or at least that’s what the company motto says. Tom doesn’t have time to debate semantics, though; he’s dangerously late for work – and he hasn’t even started his big Project AGER pitch.
Sneaking up to his desk won’t be easy. In his way stands a boatload of bureaucracy, a furlong of fetch quests, and a pretty ominous set of warnings from a mysterious voice in the air vents.
* Just what is going on at Biggleboss Inc.? 
* What does it have to do with Tom? 
* And why does it suddenly feel like his day is only set to get weirder?
— FULL VOICE ACTING! —
This game is fully voiced by real human beings who all got paid.
That's 13 actors playing some 18 characters. Why not see if you can guess which ones double up? I bet you can't.
— ABOUT 4 HOURS OF ADVENTURING! —
That sounds pretty reasonable in this day and age, right? You’re busy, after all.

bluejetty:00047004:ios.description:
Winmail File Viewer & Opener lets you open winmail.dat files on iPhone, iPad, and Mac - and extract the real attachments inside.
Some emails from Microsoft Outlook / Exchange arrive as a winmail.dat file (also called TNEF), which can hide the attachments you actually need. This app decodes the file so you can view its contents and save the attachments in seconds.
Private by design: everything is processed on-device, works offline, and requires no account.
How it works
1. Import a winmail.dat file from Mail, Files, or the Share Sheet
2. View the message contents and attachment list
3. Extract and save attachments to the Files app, or share them anywhere
Key features
- Open winmail.dat / TNEF quickly
- Preview and extract common attachments (PDF, DOCX, images, and more)
- One-tap Save, Share, or Copy
- Works across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
- Lightweight interface designed for fast access
If you regularly receive emails with missing Outlook attachments, this is the easiest way to open winmail.dat and get your files back.

bluejetty:00061502:ios.description:
CarbonFin Outliner allows you to organize your thoughts, tasks, and projects. Easily create a todo list for today, or track an entire project anywhere you are. Share your outlines, edit them online, and collaborate with other Outliner users.
Highlights
• Create outlines full of notes, structured lists, tasks, or detailed projects
• Sync your outlines automatically to Outliner Online, OneDrive, or Dropbox for web or desktop editing
• Get a quick view of project progress - tasks with subtasks show a pie-chart indicating percent completed
Organize
• Search through all your outlines or an individual outline
• Tag your outlines, and filter based on tag
• Archive old outlines to hide them from view without deleting
Easy-to-use Editor
• Drag and drop to move items within an outline
• Copy, paste
• Undo, redo
• Expand all, collapse all
• Optional outline numbering
• Zoom in to focus on a single subtree
Outliner Online
• Securely synchronize your outlines with Outliner Online
• View and edit your outlines in any web browser
• Import and export outlines as plain text or OPML
• Keep all your devices synchronized
• Share an outline with other Outliner users to collaborate
OneDrive and Dropbox
• Sync your outlines with OneDrive or Dropbox to allow quick import/export
• Seamlessly access and edit across your iOS devices and PCs

→ Conquer diverse worlds, each bringing unique challenges and opportunities to develop your strategic talents.

bluejetty:00126183:ios.description:
Blood Pressure Companion is a blood pressure, heart rate and weight tracker.
Keeping track of blood pressure is a good habit to keep healthy. High blood pressure (HBP) is one of most common and frequently-occurring diseases; heredity, unbalanced diet, fat, lack of exercise, and drink etc may cause high blood pressure.
Using Blood Pressure Companion to track your blood pressure, you can monitor your blood pressure closely and visual by words, chart and histogram. When you find it abnormal, you can take quick actions to find the reason and keep it from growing high. Also you can share measurements conveniently with your doctors by this app.
Main features:
⁃ Easily add and edit blood pressure, heart rate, weight and test date.
⁃ Add note to the readings.
⁃ Track systolic, diastolic, heart rate and weight by chart.
⁃ Analyze times and percentage of each blood pressure range.
⁃ Calculate Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) of each reading.
⁃ Create a reminder for measuring BP, doctor visiting or anything else.
⁃ Show MAX, MIN and AVG number of readings by number and histogram.
⁃ Show statistics of measurement by day, week, month or year.
⁃ Create a reminder to measure your blood pressure, doctor visit or others.
⁃ Save snapshots to Photos. 
⁃ Export (Email) readings in format of CSV, HTML or PDF.
⁃ Custom date range of readings to be exported.
⁃ Migrate Data to full version.
⁃ Custom your own color range.
⁃ Passcode function to protect your info.
⁃ Supports Touch ID as passcode.
⁃ Support lbs and kgs.
⁃ Clean and humanized interface.
⁃ Supports printing data in app. 
⁃ Supports transferring data to Health app.
⁃ Support WiFi backup and restore.
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Supports 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports both iPhone and iPad.
If you have any questions or suggestion, please kindly mail to maxwellapp@tom.com.

bluejetty:00061559:ios.description:
With the POSTIDENT app, you can verify your identity conveniently and simply by means of your smartphone.
Depending on which of our partner companies you carry out this identification process, you can verify your identity either via POSTIDENT by videochat, POSTIDENT by eID (with your national identity card or the electronic residence title), or fully automatically by creating images of your ID document and profile. With the eID function or the automated verification of your ID document you can verify your identity quickly and securely at any time. Your data will be checked by call center employees of Deutsche Post AG in all further identification procedures. Our employees are available to you from Mondays to Sundays in the hours from 8 AM to 10 PM. In addition, you can retrieve the POSTIDENT coupon for identification in your post office directly via the POSTIDENT app and therefore do not need to print it out anymore.
The identification procedures are compliant with the law, secure and completed in just a few steps. Simply enter the transaction number that you have received from either our partner company or us. The POSTIDENT app will then execute the procedure. At POSTIDENT by videochat, a Deutsche Post employee will explain additionally in detail how the procedure works.
The POSTIDENT app is optimized for iPads and iPhones with iOS 17 or higher.

bluejetty:00080381:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00080381:ios.description:
Protect your connection, check your internet speed, and manage your virtual location - all in one app.
Connect with one tap and choose from available VPN server locations. The app helps protect your internet traffic while giving you useful tools to check your connection, IP address, location, and network information.
KEY FEATURES
- Connect to a VPN with one tap
- Choose from multiple VPN server locations
- Help protect your internet traffic
- Hide your IP address while connected
- Choose a virtual VPN location
- Check your current IP address and location
- Test your internet connection speed
- View connection and network information, including netmask
- Use your VPN connection on public Wi-Fi and everyday networks
FAST, SIMPLE VPN CONNECTION
Get connected without complicated setup. Choose a server location and start a VPN connection in just a few taps. Essential connection controls are easy to access whenever you need them.
CONTROL YOUR VIRTUAL LOCATION
Choose from available VPN locations when you want to change the virtual location associated with your connection. You can also check the IP address and location currently detected by the app.
INTERNET SPEED & NETWORK TOOLS
Check your connection directly in the app. Run an internet speed test and view useful network details to better understand the connection you are using.
PRIVACY FOR EVERYDAY CONNECTIONS
A VPN can help add a layer of protection to your internet traffic when you connect online. Turn protection on when you need it and keep your VPN, speed test, IP, location, and network tools in one place.
More information about subscriptions
- The app has three types of subscriptions: weekly, monthly and annual.
- Subscriptions have a 3-day trial period. At the end of the 3-day trial period, the subscription will be automatically renewed according to the tariff unless canceled before the end of the 3-day trial period.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You will be billed for the subscription renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period with the renewal fee.
- You can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal after purchase by going to your App Store account settings.
- Subscriptions can be canceled at any time in your Apple ID settings. All prices include applicable local sales taxes.
- The unused portion of the free trial, if offered, will be canceled upon subscription purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://polbudapp.com/policy.html
Terms of Use: https://polbudapp.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00029164:ios.description:
The game of Charades based on the Bible is here!
Give hints, act out, sing songs, and have fun trying to get your partner to guess the correct words or short phrases. Have fun with family and friends while testing, and training your Bible knowledge. Keep track of high scores and record video of the game for entertainment later!
How To Play:
Simply select difficulty, timer duration, recording options, and then tap the pack to get started. Hold the device up to your forehead so that your friends can see the word but you can't. Be sure to hold the device as level as you can. They will try to get you to guess the word or phrase without saying the actual word or phrase on the screen. They may use descriptions, stories, acting, singing, or whatever else it takes! If you get the word CORRECT, tilt the device DOWNWARD to move to the next word. If you need to PASS, tilt the device UPWARD to move on to the next word. Play until the timer expires!
You can also customize the game with your friends. For example you could agree to only use acting, with no words, for a classic Charades game!
Over 2400 words/phrases, with more on the way. New packs added regularly, so be sure to check back for updates!
Auto Renewable Subscriptions:
Yearly Pass subscriptions allow for ad free play, access to all charade packs, ability to record video/audio of the game. You will be charged through your App Store account. Subscriptions help support the app team, and allow us to continue to provide new content, updates, fixes, and additional features.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless cancelled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime within your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial (if applicable) will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Terms and Conditions (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
