bluejetty:00065629:ios.name: MealSnap: Photo Food Diary
bluejetty:00065629:ios.summary:
The food diary you'll actually keep.
A photo is enough. MealSnap turns it into a meal entry: what's on the plate, each item with its own calorie estimate, useful tags, and an honest total shown as a range. Rename an item, change its portio
bluejetty:00065629:ios.description:
The food diary you'll actually keep.
A photo is enough. MealSnap turns it into a meal entry: what's on the plate, each item with its own calorie estimate, useful tags, and an honest total shown as a range. Rename an item, change its portions, or choose the dressing or milk you added, and the estimate updates by itself. You get a useful record without searching a database, weighing food, or typing every ingredient.
ASK CHATGPT OR CLAUDE ABOUT YOUR WEEK
If you already ask an AI assistant about your eating, MealSnap gives it something real to read. With Pro, connect ChatGPT or Claude to your diary once. Then ask how this month compares to last, or anything else about the meals you logged. It can read your diary, not change it. It sees your meal, drink and activity photos unless you turn them off for that connection, and you can disconnect any time. What it reads becomes part of your chat there, under the AI company's terms.
SEE WHAT YOUR MEALS ARE MADE OF
Each meal shows its protein and plants as a little, some or plenty. Your day, week and month show the balance of plants, protein and starch, a quick read on how you eat.
WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
Log your meals. Apple Health adds the rest. Connect it once, and the workouts and weigh-ins you already record show up next to the day's meals, with no extra typing. You choose what goes back to Health: your weight and body measurements, water, and the estimated energy of your meals and drinks. If you allow it, your weekly and monthly reviews can take your workouts and measurements into account. That setting stays off until you turn it on.
SEE WHAT YOUR DIARY IS TELLING YOU
Weekly and monthly AI reviews look for patterns in your meals, including protein and plants, alongside timing, hunger, fullness, drinks, and activity. Each review focuses on one pattern worth noticing, with an optional idea to try when your diary supports it. The guidance stays calm and optional.
FIT TRACKING AROUND YOUR DAY
Start a meal from a Home Screen widget, Control Center, or Siri. Add photos from your library or send them from any app with the Share Sheet. A photo of a coffee or a smoothie becomes a drink entry. Eating the same thing again? Long-press an entry to log it again, already filled in. On iOS 27, point Visual Intelligence at a plate to find similar meals from your diary.
KEEP THE CONTEXT THAT MAKES FOOD MAKE SENSE
Note hunger and fullness. Keep drinks, activity, body measurements, body photos, and day ratings beside your meals. With Pro, see how your meal timing, calorie estimates, balance, weight, drinks, and activity change over time.
SHARE THE FULL PICTURE
Send any date range as a link or print-quality PDF to a nutritionist, coach, or someone you trust. Both show what was in each meal.
YOUR DIARY STAYS YOURS
• No ads
• MealSnap never trains AI on your meal photos
• Delete your account and associated data in the app
• Sign in with Apple
FREE TO START
The free version includes unlimited manual entries and automatic recognition for five meal or drink photos over any seven days. Protein, plants and your daily balance are free, and so is connecting Apple Health. Your first five weekly AI reviews and first monthly AI review are included as a preview. MealSnap Pro adds unlimited photo recognition and AI reviews, a read-only connection to ChatGPT or Claude, more estimate corrections, stats and trends, reminders, share links, PDF export, and sending your past entries to Apple Health.
MealSnap is not a medical device and does not provide medical or nutritional advice. Calorie ranges are estimates.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

It's the game The New York Times called a "Sensation!" and Cosmopolitan raved “Your existence is dull and meaningless without this life-changing app!”
Get ready for endless fun with Heads Up!, the exhilarating charades-style party game that's taking the world by storm. Guess the words on the screen as your friends and family shout out clues.

bluejetty:00063726:ios.name: Minesweeper Classic: Retro
bluejetty:00063726:ios.summary:
*Now with GUESS FREE MODE and MORE THAN 50+ THEMES* :) Your free theme is waiting!
Play Minesweeper with its all retro classic graphics! Customize your game with tons of settings and make the game your own. Earn coins and unlock gorgeous t
bluejetty:00063726:ios.description:
*Now with GUESS FREE MODE and MORE THAN 50+ THEMES* :) Your free theme is waiting!
Play Minesweeper with its all retro classic graphics! Customize your game with tons of settings and make the game your own. Earn coins and unlock gorgeous themes. Get lost in the world of classic Minesweeper!
Key Features:
• Starting point: You will always encounter an open area with your first tap 
• 5 game modes to choose from: Easy, Medium, Hard, Extreme and Custom
• 50+ gorgeous retro themes: Unlock these themes by earning coins. Earn coins for flagging mines and winning rounds
• Guess free Mode (Beta): Play guess-free boards to eliminate 50/50 situations. Enable guess free mode from the Settings menu
• Quick Flag: Turn this mode on to tap and quickly flag cells
• Zoom & Pan: Pinch to zoom and drag to pan around. Use the Overview button to reset your zoom
• Tons of Settings: Customize your game with tons of settings. Change your zoom sensitivity, set the functionality of the New Game button, customize the top bar to quickly access your favorite buttons, turn off the 'hold to flag' option or set your desired Minesweeper theme along with many other settings
• Daily Challenges: Play a guess-free challenge every day. Earn medals by completing challenges under a time limit. Earn trophies by completing a month's worth of challenges
• Stats: Keep track of your high scores, win percentage and total play time
• Hints: Are you stuck? Press the hint button to highlight the area you should focus on. The hint button only shows you areas where you are certain to progress. It won't show areas where the outcome is unknown
• Save/Load: The game will automatically continue where you left off from upon being launched
• Continue: If you hit a mine you can continue from where you left off for 50 coins or by watching a video ad
• Leaderboards: Keep track of worldwide player scores
Functions:
• Flags: Press and hold on a cell to deploy a flag. Press and hold again to remove the flag. A cell will never open if you click on a flag
• Question marks: (Disabled by default) Press on a flag to turn it into a question mark. Press on it again to turn it back into a flag
• Hints: The hint button will highlight the surrounding of a cell which is already opened, and from which it is guaranteed to make progress
• Tap number: Press on an open cell to reveal the cells surrounding it. This will only work if the amount of flags placed around the open cell is equal to the number on that cell
Coins:
• Earn 1 coin for 1 correct mine flag
• Earn bonus coins for completing a game
Save your profile to the cloud with iCloud:
• You can save your themes and stats with iCloud and restore them later if you happen to switch to a different device. Make sure you are logged into your iCloud account on your device. Also make sure that iCloud Drive is enabled in your iCloud settings on your device otherwise your themes and stats will not be saved.
Make sure you are logged into Game Center (if you are not automatically logged in):
• Click on the leaderboards button located in the Stats window
• If the game doesn't log you in or prompt a login window after a few seconds close the app
• Go to your device's settings and login to Game Center from there
• Open Minesweeper Classic: Retro and click on the leaderboards button again and it should log you in
Enjoy!

bluejetty:00015506:ios.summary:
Dogs, cats, hamsters and rabbits - all their favourite pets await them in our new game. They'll love them!
"Find Them All: My Pets" is the latest addition to our collection of educational games for children aged 2-8.
With "My Pets", your
bluejetty:00015506:ios.description:
Dogs, cats, hamsters and rabbits - all their favourite pets await them in our new game. They'll love them!
"Find Them All: My Pets" is the latest addition to our collection of educational games for children aged 2-8.
With "My Pets", your children will discover all about cats and dogs of all breeds and also hamsters, rabbits and other members of the family. 
This multi-lingual, entirely spoken game offers numerous fun things to do:
- Find the animals on the screen 
- Take their photos 
- Solve puzzles 
- And for the older ones, quizzes and videos!
Your children will learn all about pets and have fun doing so!
THEY'RE TALKING ABOUT US
"A really nice game, very complete and very varied that children love from the age of two!! It means they can spend a little quiet time while still learning something and having fun."
"It is, without doubt, one of the best early learner apps that I've tested up to now. It is really worth trying out. Children can spend hours without getting bored and it's not for nothing because they learn lots of facts while exercising their grey cells."
NEW
Even more fun with the "mic" enabling kids to record themselves replacing the animals' name!
HERE'S A THOUGHT!
Make the game last longer by printing out game albums: cut, fold, collect!
FEATURES
- Contents: 96 animals to discover.
- Entirely spoken: children are autonomous, even the youngest ones.
- Multi-lingual: the names of the animals are available in several languages. You can choose to change the language in which the game is played.
- Educational: discover animals through photos, sound, videos and audio commentary.
- Adapted to each age group: numerous activities during short games with difficulty levels adapted to the child.
- Safe: No adverts, no external links and a special parents' zone.
- Multi-user: each child can have their games with their settings.
- Printable booklet: albums can be printed and assembled through folding.
HOW TO PLAY THE GAME
- The child looks for the animals on the scene on the screen. He or she then unlocks an animated card for that animal and can listen to its name in several languages or record his or her voice.
- They then win a camera which means they can explore the scene creating their own photo album.
- Night falls: they must find the animals in the night, with the help of a torch…
- And win the chance to convert their photos into a jigsaw puzzle (4 to à 42 pieces)!
- Then comes the PhotoQuiz; they have to take a photo and answer a series of questions to win a picture of the animal.
- And finally, they have to find the cameraman to discover videos of the animals.
ABOUT OUR "FIND THEM ALL" COLLECTION
Our collection comprises four games with different themes: Looking for Animals, Dinosaur World, Fairy Tales and Legends and Pets. Various versions exists (with in-app purchases, as a complete version or in a bundle). 
HELP AND SUPPORT
Please feel free to contact us through the game's "Settings" menu or on our website www.find-them-all.com or our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/FindThemAll!

Welcome to Flippin’ Pizza.
To create the quality product that you crave, each one of our pies goes through a very involved, artisan process. It starts with the dough; made fresh daily with no added oil or sugar and no high fructose corn syrup!
Skilled pie makers hand-toss the dough to create a crust that’s unique, thin and airy. We use only high quality ingredients like whole milk mozzarella and fresh all-natural toppings, and bake each pie to perfection in our deck ovens to delight our customers slice by slice and serve a better pizza.
You will be prompted to opt-in or opt-out of push notifications upon the first app start up after download from Apple App Store to an iOS device. Once a selection has been made, any changes to push notifications preferences have to come from your device operating system settings.

bluejetty:00142088:ios.name: Turbo Tornado: Open World Race
bluejetty:00142088:ios.summary: Rule the streets of San Lurito! Turbo Tornado delivers a massive open world car racing experience that shatters the limits for speed enthusiasts. Climb to the top in an underground world where night street racing, neon lights, and relentles
bluejetty:00142088:ios.description:
Rule the streets of San Lurito! Turbo Tornado delivers a massive open world car racing experience that shatters the limits for speed enthusiasts. Climb to the top in an underground world where night street racing, neon lights, and relentless police chases take your breath away. Forget classic tuning; embrace modern street art culture by expressing your unique style on the asphalt with animated video wraps, glowing strip LEDs, and animated wheels.
Don't just settle for legendary drift and drag racing! Fly a helicopter, drive massive trucks, or go undercover in the police force to shake up the underground city. With a constantly expanding map driven by player votes, this living open world guarantees a fresh adventure every time you hit the road.
Never let the action slow down. Thanks to 100% offline gameplay, you can hit the gas anywhere without needing an internet connection. Plus, with the new Cloud Save feature, your legendary garage and race progress are always safe. Play offline, sync your data to the cloud, and keep your title as the king of the streets at full throttle, even if you switch devices!

bluejetty:00088868:ios.name: Manga Reader King
bluejetty:00088868:ios.summary:
Read Manga, Manhwa, Manhua and Comics Free! Manga Reader King is the perfect app for manga lovers — enjoy endless stories online and offline in one powerful, easy-to-use reader.
New chapters weekly, with brand new series added regularly! EV
bluejetty:00088868:ios.description:
Read Manga, Manhwa, Manhua and Comics Free! Manga Reader King is the perfect app for manga lovers — enjoy endless stories online and offline in one powerful, easy-to-use reader.
New chapters weekly, with brand new series added regularly! EVERY CHAPTER, ALWAYS FREE!
Discover and read every genre you love: action, romance, fantasy, adventure, drama, manga, manhwa, manhua, webtoon, horror, school life, comedy, sci-fi, comics and more.
Experience faster loading, smoother reading, and amazing features crafted for every manga fan.
Amazing Key Features
• Free and Unlimited Access
Enjoy thousands of manga, manhwa, manhua and comics anytime, anywhere — completely free.
• Smart Discovery
Easily find your next favorite series by genre, title, or what's trending in the community.
• Offline Reading
Download chapters to read seamlessly even when you're offline.
• Fresh Content Weekly
Stay up to date with new stories and chapters added every week.
• New Chapter Notifications
Receive instant alerts when your favorite series releases a new chapter.
• Dark and Light Mode
Switch between light and dark themes for the most comfortable reading experience, day or night.
• Personal Library
Save and organize your favorite series in one place for quick access.
• Cloud Reading Data Sync
Keep your reading progress and data backed up across all your devices without needing an account.
• Landscape Reading Support
Enjoy a wider and more comfortable reading experience with horizontal (landscape) mode.
• Smooth and Intuitive Design
Navigate effortlessly through a clean and modern interface built for readers.
• Multi-Language Reading Support
Enjoy reading manga in multiple supported languages for a more global experience.
• Auto Save Last Reading Position
Your last reading position is always saved — continue where you left off instantly.
• Stunning Wallpaper Art
Download and save high-quality artwork directly from your favorite series.
Why Choose Manga King?
• Read Manga, Manhwa, Manhua and Comics Free!
• Over 50 popular genres to explore.
• High-resolution images with stunning detail.
• Download and read offline anytime, anywhere.
• Sync your reading data easily across devices.
• 24/7 support for all your questions and issues.
ALWAYS LISTENING
Manga King is always listening to your feedback and suggestions to make the app better every day.
You deserve the best manga reading experience — and we’re here to deliver it!
You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through a Manga King Premium Pass.
• Auto-renewable subscription: 1-month, 6-month, and 1-year durations.
• Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew for the selected duration unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase
Privacy Policy & Terms of Use
• Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/mangaking-privacy 
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://sites.google.com/view/mangaking-terms
DMCA Disclaimer
All content available on Manga Reader King is aggregated from public sources and user submissions. We do not host or store any content on our servers. If you are a copyright owner and believe your work is being used improperly, please contact us via our DMCA page for prompt removal.
Manga King — Where Every Story Begins.

bluejetty:00082637:ios.summary: The Hypori app provides secure access to your organization’s apps and data from your personal device. With Hypori, you have the freedom to work securely without risk of leaking corporate data. Hypori provides 100% separation of personal and
bluejetty:00082637:ios.description:
The Hypori app provides secure access to your organization’s apps and data from your personal device. With Hypori, you have the freedom to work securely without risk of leaking corporate data. Hypori provides 100% separation of personal and corporate data and activities.
Hypori achieves this by providing a secure and compliant virtual mobile device that runs in the cloud (you must have a Hypori account, see https://hypori.com for details). It functions just like a physical smartphone, except the operating system, data, and apps reside and run in the cloud instead of on your physical device. The Hypori app sends sensor information, such as touch commands and screen orientation, to the Hypori virtual device over a secure network connection. The display of the Hypori virtual device is streamed as pixels and drawn on your device screen, without storing any corporate data your personal device.
Feature Highlights
- One-touch access to your organization’s apps and data from your personal device
- Optimized experience over an encrypted network connection
- Secure access from anywhere to your Hypori virtual device in the cloud
- 100% separation of personal and corporate data
- Theft of your personal device does not expose your corporate data
Hypori provides your organization with a secure and compliant mobility solution through a multi-layered protected virtual workspace in the cloud. Organizational needs for mobility no longer need to come at the expense of usability and user privacy.

Boost Your Brain: Regular play can improve your linguistic skills and creative thinking.
Easy to Use: Simple, intuitive interface makes playing a breeze.
Join the Portmanteau community today and start blending words in the most entertaining way!

bluejetty:00069996:ios.summary: Learning games for kids by Bimi Boo is a comprehensive educational app for preschool development. Learning Academy features over 1500 entertaining games and activities that are suitable for both boys and girls from 2 to 6 years old. The app
bluejetty:00069996:ios.description:
Learning games for kids by Bimi Boo is a comprehensive educational app for preschool development. Learning Academy features over 1500 entertaining games and activities that are suitable for both boys and girls from 2 to 6 years old. The app covers the essential curriculum for preschool: letter and number recognition, reading, tracing, spelling, phonics, addition, subtraction, shapes, colors, patterns and much more.
Trusted by the largest teacher community in the USA: "We Are Teachers"!
There are two ways to enjoy the Learning Academy – kids can go step by step on the learning path, or alternatively they can choose which game to play. Games on the learning path are accompanied with a narrative story that gets child acquainted with the world of Bimi Boo.
The Learning games for kids is perfect for kindergarten and preschool kids. It has everything: learning games, short stories, entertaining puzzles, interactive books and educational videos. All the activities were designed in collaboration with child psychologists and experts in child education. Learning games for kids supports up to 3 profiles for a single account. Parents can track kids’ progress in a special section of the app. There are no ads in Learning games for kids. The app requires internet connection for synchronization of game progress.
Learning games for kids features:
- 1500+ educational activities for kids and toddlers.
- Dozens of activities to boost a child’s cognitive development: various puzzles, coloring pages, tracing, drawing, sorting games, flashcards, videos, songs, musical instruments, books and much more.
- Progress tracking for parents.
- Up to 3 profiles on a single account.
- Specially designed for kindergarten and preschool kids under 6 years old.
- Develops creativity, logical thinking, fine-motor skills, problem solving ability and imagination.
- Professional voice-over by over 15 voice actors.
- Over 50 topics covered including letters, numbers, animals, plants, shapes, colors, professions, weather, food, dinosaurs, transportation, directions etc.
- Safe experience for children – no ads or external links.
Bimi Boo Learning games for kids is a subscription-based app. We will regularly add new content for kids to enjoy.
Some important information about subscriptions:
- There are two types of subscription: Monthly and Yearly. 
- Monthly subscription has a trial period of 3 days 
- Yearly subscription has a trial period of 7 days. 
- You can opt out any time during the trial period.
- All of our subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
- You can cancel the auto-renewal at any time in your Account Settings, however no refunds are available within the active subscription period.
- Unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you decide to purchase a subscription.
We are always glad to receive your feedback and suggestions.
Our Privacy Policy: https://bimiboo.net/privacy-policy/
Our Terms of Use: https://bimiboo.net/terms-of-use/

WHAT TWIN AI DOES

● Creator feed — see what others generated, then recreate any result on yourself
COMMON QUESTIONS
Need an app to generate AI images? Type a prompt, pick a style, get a photorealistic image in seconds — no design skills and no desktop software.
Need an app that generates AI photos of yourself? Twin AI keeps your face. One reference selfie is enough, and every photoshoot and effect renders with your likeness.

Looking for a free AI image generator app? Twin AI is free to download and gives you a free preview before any purchase.
Want AI photos of two people? Add photos of you and your partner or a friend and generate a couple shot in any style.
WHO USES TWIN AI
● Professionals who need a headshot for LinkedIn, a CV or a company page
● Social-media creators who want to post the current AI trend the day it appears
● Couples and friends making AI photos together
● People refreshing a dating profile

Gang Battle Party is the ultimate physics-based fighting experience for players who want to test their skills in chaotic, action-packed arenas. Customize your fighter, choose your battleground, and face off against rivals in intense battles to become the champion!
The game features a wide variety of quirky street brawlers, wild creatures, fun arena challengers, and classic human fighters — each with their own fighting style and unique moves. Find the perfect match for your playstyle and build a character that truly stands out.
Personalize your fighter’s appearance, outfits, and special abilities to create a one-of-a-kind combatant. Whether you prefer fast strikes, heavy blows, or unpredictable attacks, the choice is yours.
What truly sets Gang Battle Party apart is its dynamic physics-driven combat system. Every punch, kick, and special move delivers satisfying impact, making each fight feel intense and unpredictable. Watch your opponents stumble, lose balance, and crash to the ground as you dominate the arena.
Play solo against AI opponents or jump into multiplayer mode to challenge real players online. Earn experience and in-game rewards as you progress through increasingly difficult battles, unlocking new fighters, arenas, and customization options.
Each arena offers unique environmental hazards and interactive elements that can turn the tide of battle. Fight in dramatic castles, neon-lit city rooftops, industrial zones, and more — every location presents new tactical opportunities.
With intuitive controls, fast-paced combat, and deep customization, Gang Battle Party delivers endless fun for both casual players and competitive fighters. Step into the arena, master the chaos, and prove you have what it takes to rule the fight!

bluejetty:00087801:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00087801:ios.description:
Welcome to Journable, the AI calorie counter that makes tracking your diet and exercise as easy as having a conversation.
Powered by advanced AI, Journable lets you log meals and exercise through a simple chat interface with text or photos. It is designed for speed and simplicity, and adds a personal touch to your health journey.
Download Journable today and chat your way to health & fitness.
Why choose Journable?
• Chat to Track: Say goodbye to traditional calorie counter apps. Just text our AI about your meals and exercise, and it will count the calories and macros for you. 
• Photo Tracking: Simply snap a photo of your meal — our AI instantly estimates portion size, calories, and macros, for each ingredient. 
• Complete Nutrition: Track not just calories and macros, but also micronutrients — including fiber, sugar, net carbs, and vitamins — for a truly complete view of your diet. 
• AI-Powered Insights: Get smart nutritional insights and guidance about your entries in addition to calories, macros, and exercise data. 
• Favorite Foods: Quickly log your most frequent meals or exercise entries with a single tap. 
• Water Tracker: Stay hydrated by setting goals and tracking your water intake. 
• Smart Reminders: Set custom alerts to ensure you never miss logging a meal or workout. 
• Weekly Reports: Track your weight, calories, and macros weekly, and easily share your progress with your Personal Trainer, Nutritionist, Dietitian, friends or family. 
• Simple, Easy, Straightforward: Stay consistent with the intuitive user-friendly design, giving you the easiest calorie & macro tracking experience — as simple as chatting with ChatGPT. 
• Achieve Your Goals: Whether your aim is weight loss, muscle gain, or maintaining fitness, Journable has what you need.
Features
• AI-powered chat interface for effortless calorie & macro tracking 
• Instant photo calorie analysis 
• All macronutrients and micronutrients included 
• All local & international foods supported 
• Weight goal progress graph 
• Favorite foods and recent entries 
• Customizable tracking reminders 
• Calorie & macro calculator 
• Shareable weekly progress reports 
• Water tracker 
• Food journal/diary 
• Intuitive, user-friendly chat experience 
Journable includes a free trial. A subscription is required afterward to continue logging food and exercise, and it unlocks unlimited entries, full features, and an ad-free experience.
Privacy and Security
Your data is private and secure. We adhere to strict privacy standards to protect your health information.
Privacy: https://www.journable.com/privacy 
Terms: https://www.journable.com/terms

bluejetty:00067601:ios.description:
ARTA is an all-in-one, AI photo generator and picture editor, focused on trendy filters, videos, and visual content. Created for anyone, ready for everything.
ARTA empowers you to make eye-catching visuals and share them without limits. Want a viral selfie, a professional photoshoot, or a ready-to-post video? ARTA gets it done, no design skills or equipment needed. Just pick what you’d like to see, and let the app bring it to life.
Loved by 10+ million active users worldwide. Over 600 million artworks dreamed up and counting. 
With ARTA, you can: 
— Stay on-trend with regularly updated filters, styles, and content formats
— Create visuals that get shared, from any text prompt or reference photo in seconds 
— Transform a single selfie into a full professional photoshoot 
— Produce high-quality videos using leading AI models
— Add, remove, or replace any element in any image 
— Preview new outfits, hairstyles, and makeup looks instantly 
— Generate images, videos, and selfies from one powerful platform 
Here’s how it works:
• MAKE YOUR SELFIES GO VIRAL
New filters land in ARTA every week, inspired by what’s going viral on Instagram and TikTok. Try them on, pick your favorite, and post a selfie that’s built to get attention.
• EDIT YOUR IMAGES EASILY
Swap backgrounds, change outfits, remove objects, or sharpen details—on any image. Select what you want to adjust, and ARTA handles the rest. Works on photos you made in the app or anything from your camera roll.
• TURN PHOTOS INTO PHOTOSHOOTS
One pic is all it takes. Generate realistic portraits, professional headshots, or full digital photoshoots with different styles, outfits, and environments. All done on your phone, zero equipment or post-production required.
• BUILD LIFE-LIKE VIDEOS FROM SCRATCH 
Turn photos or a text prompt into dynamic videos with fluid, realistic motion. Powered by top-tier AI models, ARTA takes the work out of producing standout clips with Hollywood-grade quality. Epic scenes, animated moments, custom content—yours in minutes.
• TRY ON STYLES, OUTFITS, AND MAKEUP

With GayFriendly you can:
• Chat with community members
• Start conversations with helpful icebreakers
• Send virtual gifts and reactions
• Participate in discussions and community activities
• Stay connected through messaging features
DISCOVER THE COMMUNITY
Explore an active community built around communication and shared interests.
GayFriendly lets you:
• Browse community content
• Connect with people who share similar interests and values

• Join community discussions
• Explore new topics and perspectives

• Share your interests
• Personalize your profile
• Tell others more about yourself

• Community discussions
• Interactive polls
• Conversation starters
• Social engagement tools
• Meaningful community interactions

Your comfort and privacy are important.

• Account verification
• Privacy controls
• Visibility settings

Use GayFriendly to:
• Join conversations
• Stay connected with the community
• Participate in discussions
• Build lasting social connections
• Discover new interests and experiences

• Community features
• Interactive conversations

Embark on an epic journey into the heart of battle with Tower Archer, the ultimate tower defense experience that puts your archery skills to the test! As the master archer standing sentinel atop the towering fortress walls, you hold the fate of the realm in your hands. Waves of relentless enemies, from sword-wielding foot soldiers to mighty spear throwers, assail your stronghold, and it's up to you to repel them with precision and skill.

With each level, the challenge intensifies, requiring strategic thinking and quick reflexes to emerge victorious. Utilize cunning tricks and masterful aim to thwart the enemy onslaught and secure your place as the hero of the realm.
Upgrade your arsenal with the latest in archery technology to become the ultimate tower defense god. Increase the number of arrows per shot to rain devastation upon your foes, extend your range to reach distant targets, and amplify your damage to ensure no enemy survives your onslaught. With each upgrade, you inch closer to becoming the best archer the realm has ever known.
Tower Archer combines the thrill of classic tower defense gameplay with the precision of archery mechanics, creating an immersive experience unlike any other. Whether you're a seasoned master of the bow or a newcomer looking to hone your skills, Tower Archer offers endless hours of excitement and challenge.
So, grab your bow, take aim, and unleash hell upon the approaching waves of enemies. Will you rise to the challenge and become the hero the realm needs?

bluejetty:00084048:ios.summary:
Classic Solitaire, Thoughtfully Reimagined
Rediscover the timeless joy of a true patience card game, designed with comfort, clarity and personalisation at its core. This is more than a traditional cardgame solitaire. It is a carefully craf
bluejetty:00084048:ios.description:
Classic Solitaire, Thoughtfully Reimagined
Rediscover the timeless joy of a true patience card game, designed with comfort, clarity and personalisation at its core. This is more than a traditional cardgame solitaire. It is a carefully crafted experience that feels familiar, relaxing and truly your own.
To complete this Solitaire card puzzle, move all cards across the four suits to the Foundations. The game uses a single deck of 52 cards, staying true to the classic experience you know and love.
Cards must be arranged by suit in ascending order, from Ace through to King. Within the playing area, you can move cards between columns, building sequences in descending order while alternating between red and black suits. For example, a black 10 can only be placed on a red 9. Empty columns can only be filled with a King, and entire stacks can be moved together, adding depth and strategy to every move.
Designed for Comfort
Enjoy larger, easy-to-read cards that reduce strain and make every move effortless. A clean layout and gentle visuals create a calm and distraction-free experience.
Effortless Gameplay
With simple single-tap controls, you can move cards instantly without dragging, making gameplay smooth and intuitive.
Make It Personal
Customise your experience to make each game your own:
 • Use personal photos for card backs or backgrounds
 • Choose from a range of elegant themes
 • Personalise card fronts and designs
This Solitaire card game is an engaging experience from the Classic Solitaire collection, inspired by a wide range of popular solitaire games such as Cube, FreeCell, Spider, TriPeaks, Pyramid, Golf, Mahjong and Yukon. Classic Solitaire never loses its appeal. It remains one of the most enjoyable ways to relax and pass the time. Play anytime, anywhere, and enjoy a calming patience card game that rewards focus and consistency. If you appreciate a well-crafted cardgame solitaire, you will find this experience both familiar and deeply satisfying.
Whether you enjoy Spider Solitaire, FreeCell, or a traditional patience card game, this cardgame solitaire is designed to feel comfortable, personal and one of a kind. Perfect for quiet moments, daily routines or simply unwinding at your own pace.
Privacy Policy : https://felicitygames.com/privacy
Contact Us : support@felicitygames.com

bluejetty:00022356:ios.description:
The Weather Forecast App is the most accurate weather app you need to navigate any weather conditions such as floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, snow, extreme wind, sun and rain. 
Get accurate hyper-local weather forecasts whenever and wherever you need them: 
 - Up to 48 hours of detailed hourly data 
 - Up to 16 day forecasts 
 - Severe weather alerts for your current location 
 - Daily notifications that keep you up-to-date with weather changes 
 - Ability to choose the weather app text size according to your preferences and needs 
The Weather Forecast app has multiple detailed metrics like temperature, humidity, pressure, snow, clouds, rain and wind. It's all present on our main screen, alongside precise real-time 30+ radar layers to choose from. 
More weather info? No problem! 
The app also provides atmospheric information about the moon and sun which include sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset and moon phases to help with waves, tides and windstorms. 
Photographers want something more? 
We have a special feature for photographers so they know when the blue and golden hours start for shooting beautiful photos. 
All the weather info you need, packaged in a delightfully designed app.

bluejetty:00088406:ios.description:
Store, share and discover your memories with Ente Photos. With end-to-end encryption, only you — and those you share with — can see your photos and videos. Ente Photos has lovingly protected over 165 million memories for people who trust us across all major platforms. Get started with 10 GB free.
Why Ente Photos?
Ente Photos is designed for those who truly value their memories. With end-to-end encryption and secure backups in three locations, your photos stay truly private and safe. Powerful on-device AI helps you find faces and objects instantly, while curated stories bring cherished memories to the present. Share encrypted albums with loved ones, invite family at no extra cost, and lock sensitive images with a password. Available on mobile, desktop, and web, Ente preserves every pixel of your photos and videos.
Features:
END-TO-END ENCRYPTED STORAGE: Your photos and videos are encrypted on your device, and then automatically backed up to the cloud.
SHARE AND COLLABORATE: Let your family or friends add photos and videos to your albums. Everything, end-to-end encrypted.
RELIVE YOUR MEMORIES: Through the stories Ente curates for you, relive your memories from previous years. Easily spread the cheer by sharing them with your loved ones or friends.
SEARCH FOR ANYONE AND ANYTHING: Using on-device AI, Ente helps you find faces and key elements in a photo, so you can search through your entire library using natural language search.
INVITE YOUR FAMILY: Invite up to 5 family members to any paid plan at no extra cost. Only your storage space is shared, not your data. Each member will receive their own private space.
AVAILABLE EVERYWHERE: Ente Photos is available on every platform, so you can access your photos and videos from any device you have.
NEVER LOSE YOUR PHOTOS: Ente stores your encrypted backups in 3 secure locations—including an underground facility—so your photos stay safe, no matter what.
EASY IMPORT: Use our powerful desktop app to import data from other providers. If you need any help moving, reach out, and we'll be there.
ORIGINAL QUALITY BACKUPS: All photos and videos are stored in their original quality, including the metadata, without any compression or loss in quality.
APP LOCK: Make sure no one else can see your photos and videos using the built in App Lock. You can set a pin, or use biometrics to lock the app only for yourself.
HIDDEN PHOTOS: Hide your most private photos and videos to the Hidden folder, which is password protected by default.
FREE DEVICE SPACE: Free up your device's space by clearing files that have already been backed, in a single click.
COLLECT PHOTOS: Went to a party and want to collect all the photos in one place? Just share a link with your friends and ask them to upload.
PARTNER SHARING: Share your camera album with your partner so they can automatically see your photos on their device.
LEGACY: Allow trusted contacts to access your account in your absence.
DARK & LIGHT THEMES: Choose the mode that will make your photos pop.
ADDITIONAL SECURITY: Turn on two-factor authentication or set a lock-screen for the app.
OPEN-SOURCE AND AUDITED: Ente Photos’s code is open-source, and has been audited by third-party security experts.
HUMAN SUPPORT: We take pride in providing real human support. If you need help, reach out to support@ente.io, and one of us will be there to assist you.
Keep your memories safe and private, with Ente Photos. Get started with 10 GB free.

bluejetty:00084905:ios.description:
Wordsmarty is a relaxing crossword style word puzzle game where you connect letters to build words and complete easy crosswords. Enjoy calm, stress-free gameplay with beautiful scenery and soothing music, perfect for daily play and relaxing your mind.
Each puzzle starts with a few letters and guides you step by step through the level. Connect letters to form words, uncover hidden combinations, and collect them to complete the final crossword style puzzle. Levels begin easy and gradually become more challenging, keeping the gameplay engaging and rewarding.
Wordsmarty Features:
► Meditative, beautiful design that helps improve memory, logic, and vocabulary.
► Familiar crossword style gameplay: connect letters to form words as levels start easy and gradually become more challenging.
► Enjoy fresh daily crossword puzzles for calm, consistent brain training.
► Peaceful visuals and soothing background music create a relaxing atmosphere.
► Play offline anytime - perfect for travel, commuting, or quiet moments.
► Over 5,000 levels with thoughtfully designed word and crossword style challenges.
► Earn free in-game coins and daily rewards to unlock helpful hints.
► Designed for adults and casual players who enjoy relaxing word puzzles at their own pace.
Try it now and see how many strikes and combos you can make.
Enjoy everyday entertainment that helps improve vocabulary, spelling, and cognitive skills. For fans of brain teasers, Wordsmarty offers a modern, relaxing take on classic crossword puzzles. It blends crossword style gameplay with word connect mechanics and light anagram challenges for a smooth, satisfying experience.
Unwind with a calm, stress free word puzzle designed to help you relax and focus. Wordsmarty is perfect for evening play, short breaks, or quiet moments when you want to clear your mind. Solve relaxing crossword style puzzles, boost your vocabulary, and enjoy a mindful brain workout at your own pace.
Each level starts as a simple set of letters and gradually turns into a satisfying word challenge. Swipe to connect letters, complete the final crossword, earn rewards, and unlock new levels. Explore beautiful world locations filled with hundreds of relaxing word puzzles.
Start your relaxing word puzzle journey and enjoy thoughtful challenges at your own pace.

bluejetty:00065939:ios.description:
*Dice With Buddies™*
Dice With Buddies is a fun, new spin on your favorite classic dice game! Enjoyed by millions of players, you can play free multiplayer board games with family, friends, or new buddies! Share the fun playing free games wherever your opponent is sitting, either next to you or thousands of miles away! Roll the dice with all your friends in a fun, new social board game experience!  
Dice board games are easy and exciting to play! Take on opponents with brand new custom dice, easy-to-use interface, new game modes, and exciting daily tournaments! Play this exhilarating board game from the same account on any iPad or iPhone!
How to Play Dice With Buddies:
In Dice With Buddies, the objective of the game is to score the most points by rolling different combinations. Your 5 dice can be rolled up to 3 times per turn to score in a category. Once a category has been used in the game, it cannot be used again. The game consists of thirteen turns. Feeling lucky? Roll a five-of-a-kind and score 50 points! Score more points than your opponent to win the game and earn rewards!
This dice game has also called Poker Dice because there are fun combinations like Full House, Three-of-a-Kind, Four-of-a-Kind, Small Straight, Large Straight – all that resemble poker.
If you love Yahtzee, Yatzy and Farkle, then you will love Dice With Buddies! Play this classic dice game anywhere with your friends and family, and prepare to have fun!
===Dice With Buddies Features===
Dice Game Bonuses:
• Finish Dice games to win in-game scratchers with a chance to win tons of bonus dice rolls.
• Activate a bonus dice roll to get an extra dice roll right when you need it.
Defeat the Dice Masters:
• Dice Masters play back instantly in Dice With Buddies reinvented solo adventure - take down the Dice Masters and earn amazing custom dice along the way!
• Conquer dozens of new levels with brand new boosts and obstacles like ice blocks, flying multipliers and more!
• Join the Race for the ultimate head to head competition and earn great new rewards!
Take part in multiplayer tournaments:
• Dice tournaments are a new, thrilling challenge! Dice Solitaire, Dice Bingo, and Dice Stars are completely new ways to play this classic game! Tournaments are running daily!
• Play through 10+ leagues to win exciting prizes!
Social Games with Friends
• Play with friends and family. Create your own family in game to group chat and share rewards! 
• Multiplayer games with random opponents – play dice games with players around the world.
• Chat, challenge, and favorite your friends with the new social buddies system!
Personalize your dice rolling experience:
• LOADS OF CUSTOM DICE! 
• LOTS OF SPECIAL PORTRAIT FRAMES!
• TONS OF THEMED GAME BOARDS!
Subscriptions
A Dice with Buddies Prize Pass trial will convert to a recurring subscription after 7 days. A payment will be charged to your iTunes account when the subscription begins, and it will auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of a subscription period. Renewal payments will be charged within 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, with the same price and payment schedule for the subscription you selected. Unused portions of a trial will be forfeited upon purchase of a subscription. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewals in your device account settings.
Fans of card games and fun social experiences will LOVE Dice With Buddies! Entertaining games with friends await in Dice With Buddies! Download today and roll the dice!
Please contact us at dicesupport@scopely.com with questions, concerns or suggestions!
Privacy Policy:
https://scopely.com/privacy/
Terms of Service:
http://scopely.com/tos/
Additional Information, Rights, and Choices Available to California Players: https://scopely.com/privacy/#additionalinfo-california
By installing this game you agree to the terms of the license agreements.

bluejetty:00138318:android.description:
Create your own fighter in this game that mixes Collectible Cards, RPG & fighting games!
■ Harness the power of the Arcana Cards, a powerful tarot-like cards that let you re-write your fate. 
■ In-depth Character Customization Build different decks to create your OC (original character), the cards you include in your Battle Deck will determine your stats, weapons, skills, and powers at your disposal. You’ll be able to look like the most awesome anime fighters inspired by anime fighting games
Enjoy the thrill and inspiration of anime battle games and the strategy of CCG and anime card games
Express yourself with your Style Deck, the cards you include on it customize every detail about your looks, with tons of style cards to find you’ll be able to create the OC of your dreams and even look like awesome anime fighters ! 
■ An anime fighting game inspired by RPG, anime battle games, and CCG. Engage in a fighting path at frenetic battles against other Fateless, building combos of collectible cards to Knock them out cold!
■ Competitive mode Be the most powerful Fighter of Fate ! compete for glory and ascend into the hall of fame while creating your fighting path and collecting new cards as rewards with the action of anime fighting games.
■ Alchemy mode level up your cards with alchemy to create the most powerful deck to enjoy this unique mix of CCG and anime battle games while showing off your OC style.
■ Live PvP Arena join other Anime Fighters of Fate at the brawling bar to chat, make friends, and compete in real-time PVP in the style of anime battle games.
■ Adventure mode go on your fighting path to collect cards, materials, and components to strengthen your CCG deck.
■ Defeat everybody! Compete for Arcana Cards in this crazy mix of CCG, RPG & anime battle games, grow the collection of your OC, and use them to become the ultimate Fighter of Fate! 
Do you enjoy the epic action of anime fighting games ? Do you enjoy creating original characters ( OC )? Do you want to feel the thrill of anime battle games combined with CCG while creating the fighting path for your anime fighters ? Then this is the game for you! 
Test your CCG and trading card games skills, you’ll be able to collect cards and test your power in the live PVP arena! Be more powerful, test different deck options, and enjoy the thrill of the anime fighting games while putting the best of the trading card games strategies.
We greatly appreciate your support! Please share any suggestions to take Fighters of Fate to the next level! And remember that we have an awesome community of other OC anime fighters that can help you grow and perfect your strategies while you make friends

bluejetty:00129226:ios.description:
Football Manager 26 Touch out now – download today
New foundations set the stage for you to define your footballing destiny. Powered by Unity, FM26 Touch places you at the heart of the beautiful game. 
Delivering effortless control and swift navigation across Apple devices, an ultra-modern UI combines with our most immersive matchday experience* to bring you closer to the moments that matter.
Explore global football in unrivalled ways with the debut of Women’s Football and a fully-licensed Premier League, using new transfer tools to build your dream squad and bring your footballing vision to life.
If you’ve been dominating the game in FM24 Touch, you can carry your existing career forward and make the most of this season’s game-changing additions by simply updating your game.
CHASE FIFA WORLD CUP 2026™ GLORY
Victory in football’s biggest international tournament is at your fingertips. Explore a competition-specific start date for FIFA World Cup 2026™ and new tools for managing national teams, alongside authentic, licensed broadcast graphics, tournament branding, match balls and kits.
OUR RICHEST MATCHDAY EXPERIENCE 
Powered by the Unity graphics engine, matchdays feel more dramatic than ever thanks to enhanced player movement and greater on-pitch detail. 
Experience the theatre of dynamic dribbles, picture-perfect passes and last-gasp winners through volumetric animations from real football matches and fresh motion capture that gives every attack more personality.
TOTAL FOOTBALL, TOTAL CONTROL  
A game-changing user interface overhaul primes you for smooth, intuitive navigation through squad building and match preparation. 
Explore a gateway to your wider game world with the newly-integrated Portal and significant optimisations to our iPhone UI, surfacing key information when you need it and empowering you to dive deeper into the data for the extra edge on your rivals.
PREMIER LEAGUE. FULLY LICENSED
Compete for glory in the Premier League, now vividly brought to life with official kits, club logos and player images. 
Manage from the best seat in the house as the full broadcast experience immerses you in action from the world’s most-watched league like never before. 
INTRODUCING: WOMEN’S FOOTBALL   
Break new ground as women’s football makes its long-awaited debut, seamlessly integrated into the FM ecosystem, as one footballing world.
Explore new horizons with 14 playable leagues across 11 nations, including world-leading competitions like the WSL and NWSL, and discover new stars with the biggest women’s football database in games. 
ADVANCED TACTICAL INNOVATION
The cutting edge of football tactics has arrived - make your mark on the pitch with the introduction of distinct in and out-of-possession formations. 
Level up your gameplans with new and redefined player roles supported by a dynamic pitch visualiser that shows how your side moves and adapts through every phase of play.
TRANSFORMATIVE TRANSFER TOOLS
Harness new transfer tools, powered by football’s transfer marketplace TransferRoom, to smartly shape your title-winning squads.
Broadcast your recruitment priorities to worldwide clubs with Adverts and gain direct insight into your rivals’ needs with new Pitch Opportunities, giving you more control over every signing and sale.
YOUR MANAGER, YOUR WAY
Express more of your personality and style in every career with a revamped manager creation experience. 
Craft your look with an enhanced character creator and a wider range of apparel before developing a career backstory that’s unique to you and uniquely influential on your life in the dugout.
In FM26 Touch, football belongs to you and your vision. Change the Game. 
*Visuals may vary depending on user hardware.
*Due to ongoing licensing approvals, not all FIFA World Cup 2026™ team kits will be available at launch of the feature and some may be added at a later date.

Ski Tracks is the essential GPS companion for skiing, snowboarding, and winter mountain adventures. Record your runs with precision, explore your routes on the map, and understand your performance through detailed speed, distance, and altitude stats.

- Accurate GPS Tracking: Automatically track your speed, distance, altitude, and vertical movement throughout every run
- Maps & Saved Routes: View your recorded paths directly on the map. Revisit the slopes, trails, and mountain lines that shaped your day
- Performance Insights: Compare your stats across days and monitor your long-term progression throughout the season
- Music While Skiing: Play your favorite tracks without leaving the app. Ski Tracks keeps recording seamlessly in the background

bluejetty:00062713:ios.description:
Find the right Japanese phrase. Hear it spoken. Keep it ready offline.
SpeakEasy Japanese is a phrasebook for English speakers, with recorded native-speaker audio, pronunciation guides, and flashcards. Prepare for Japan, from train stations and hotels to restaurants and shops with useful words and phrases for eating out, getting around, checking in, and meeting people.
HEAR HOW TO SAY IT
Every phrasebook entry pairs the Japanese text with an easy-to-read pronunciation guide and a native-speaker recording. Tap to listen, or press and hold to hear the recording more slowly.
KEEP YOUR PHRASEBOOK WITH YOU
The bundled phrases and their recordings work offline. Browse by category, search for a word or phrase, and save useful entries to Favorites for quick access.
PRACTICE WITH FLASHCARDS
Review phrases by category, or practice your Favorites. Read the English, flip the card to see the Japanese and pronunciation guide, and tap to hear the recording.
TRANSLATE SOMETHING NEW
Use the built-in text translator for words and sentences outside the phrasebook. Translation depends on language support and may require an internet connection to download language data. Phrasebook recordings remain available offline.
START FREE, UNLOCK MORE
Try six free phrasebook categories: Greetings, Basic Phrases, Railway Trains, Travel Essentials, Days, and Numbers. The Complete Edition unlocks all phrasebook categories, all flashcard categories, and unlimited use of the built-in translator. The full phrasebook contains over 1,800 words and phrases. Additional content and unlimited translation require an in-app purchase.
MADE FOR EVERYDAY USE
• Native-speaker recordings and slow playback
• English-friendly pronunciation guides
• Category browsing, search, and Favorites
• Flashcards for self-paced practice
• Built-in text translation with a free daily allowance
• Light and dark appearance
• US, UK, and Canadian English spelling
• Works on iPhone and iPad

bluejetty:00161505:ios.description:
في السعودية، كثير من الشباب يفكروا بالزواج… بس واقفين في النص. مو لأنهم ما لقوا، لكن لأن الخيارات اللي حولهم ما تطمّن: يا تعرّضهم لضغط اجتماعي، يا تشتتهم، يا تسحبهم لعلاقات ولخبطة. نسب الزواج تنخفض، والطلاق يرتفع، والمشكلة ضخمة. عشان كذا بنينا نصفك. 
حفاظا على جدية التجربة، الوصول لخدمة السعي وقياس التوافق الأساسية يتطلب شراء اشتراك رمزي داخل التطبيق.
هدفنا نبني مجموعة حلول تساعدك بكامل رحلة الزواج. من أول سؤال في بالك: "هل أنا جاهز؟"، إلى التوافق، التواصل مع الأهل، وحتى الخدمات اللي تحتاجها بعد الارتباط.
خلال أكثر من سنة ونص، تكلمنا مع آلاف المستخدمين، و بنينا كل تفصيلة مع مختصين في العلاقات وعلم النفس، عشان نوفر أفضل تجربة جادة ممكنة.
لو ما ببالك أحد، تبدأ باختبار يعكس شخصيتك وقيمك، وبعدها تنتظر خوارزميتنا تبحث عن شخص مناسب وترشحه (شخص واحد بكل مرة). ما في صور، ما في تصفح عشوائي. كل شيء مصمم يحمي خصوصيتك، يحفظ كرامتك، ويقلل التشتت.
لو تم القبول، تبدأون بعدها برحلة قياس توافق مصممة لكشف توافقكم بشكل أعمق. وإذا حسيتوا براحة، نسهّل تواصل محترم مع الأهالي بحيث ما يضيع وقتكم.
حوالي ٣٣٪ من اللي يسجلون نرفضهم. لأننا ما نخدم إلا الشخص الجاد واللي يبحث عن ارتباط سليم. معظم مستخدمينا زيك، ما يفتقروا للفرص، ناس ناجحين، مشغولين، وعندهم خيارات. بس يهمهم يختاروا الشخص الصح، بطريقة تحترمهم وتحترم وقتهم.
في ناس تزوجوا من أول أو ثاني ترشيح. وفي ناس ينتظرون وقت أطول، بس بدون استنزاف أو أوهام.
نِصفك مو بديل عن الأهل والطريقة التقليدية، نحن أداة اضافية تساعد بتسريع الأمور بشكل يؤدي الى اختيار سليم.
حمل التطبيق وقلنا رأيك.
سياسة الخصوصية و شروط الاستخدام: https://sites.google.com/view/nisfak-privacy-policy/home

bluejetty:00063520:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00063520:ios.description:
Let the hunting season begin right now! An exciting hunt for bears, deer, wild boars and other wild animals awaits you!
Do you want to feel adrenaline from pursuit of savage animals? Hunting Animals 3D is for real hunters, who like to spend time in the open wild nature and breathe fresh air. Test your accuracy and precision for long range shooting. Take your sniper rifle and start amazing adventure trip through the forest to your trophy! But be careful — the animals here are smart and careful. They react to every sound, follow every movement and can smell you from a mile away. And if you meet a bear, remember: a hunter can easily become a prey.
If you prefer the tranquility of the water, prepare your gear for an intense fishing experience. Navigate through deep lakes and rushing rivers to catch massive fish. Master the art of waiting and striking at the perfect moment to secure your aquatic prize.
Wildlands of Ontario, Alaska and Colorado await you — and each location proposes challenging hunting missions. Seasonal changes and dynamic weather make each hunt unique. One day you will be tracking a deer in an autumn forest, and another time you will be hiding from a snowstorm in Alaska.
Pass the long, dangerous and exciting way from an amateur hunter to the professional! Hunt on vast hunting ground in search of worthy trophy animals. Most mighty and dangerous of them will decorate your personal trophy room. Track the loot, disguise yourself, choose the right moment to shoot and take into account the influence of the type of weapon and ammunition on the result.
Choose from the weapons available:
Sniper rifles for accurate long-range shots;
Hunting rifles for universal hunting;
Professional crossbow for silent mining;
Shotgun for close and decisive fights;
Knife for close combat.
Also waiting for you:
AI hunter
Not sure how to get close to the loot or which weapon to choose? The built-in AI assistant will provide answers to all questions about hunting.
Hunting with a dog
Hunt alone or together with the hunting dog. That’s best tracker and guard for you. Rely on its sense of smell and hunt down even most cautious prey.
Load your gun, ready, aim, fire! Welcome to Hunting Animals 3D!
Privacy Policy: https://gamenesis.com/privacy
Terms Of Use: http://gamenesis.com/tos

bluejetty:00151870:ios.name: Wood Block Crush
bluejetty:00151870:ios.summary:
Wood Block Crush — A Gentle, Relaxing Puzzle Filled with Comfort and Delight
Wood Block Crush is a relaxing new-style puzzle game where you send a “shooter” along a conveyor belt to pleasantly break down cute and charming art pieces. With
bluejetty:00151870:ios.description:
Wood Block Crush — A Gentle, Relaxing Puzzle Filled with Comfort and Delight
Wood Block Crush is a relaxing new-style puzzle game where you send a “shooter” along a conveyor belt to pleasantly break down cute and charming art pieces. With its warm wood-grain background and soothing atmosphere, the game is perfect for unwinding, taking a small break, or enjoying a calm moment anytime.
Each artwork is composed of block-like elements, giving you the enjoyment of breaking down a stacked, three-dimensional illustration. Choose the shooter that matches the color of the piece you want to hit, send it onto the conveyor belt, and clear every block to complete the stage.
As the shooter moves, it spins gently around the artwork. This charming spiraling motion is surprisingly calming and pleasant to watch. Combined with the wooden aesthetic across the entire screen, the game creates a warm and peaceful space that feels comforting and inviting.
The rule is incredibly simple.
 You only need to clear everything to win!
 Even with such simplicity, the shape and color placement of each artwork adds subtle strategy. Finding an angle that breaks pieces cleanly or matching colors in satisfying sequences creates a smooth rhythm and a rewarding sense of play. When the artwork collapses beautifully at the end, you experience a brief but unmistakable moment of pure satisfaction.
Adorable visual design and gentle animations.
 Smooth and intuitive controls with no stress.
 A refreshing burst of calm when everything disappears at once.
Wood Block Crush is a cozy puzzle game that brings a little more comfort to your day. Each stage can be enjoyed in short sessions, making it ideal for commuting, break time, or relaxing before bed.
 Play at your own pace and enjoy the soothing pleasure of clearing each piece.

bluejetty:00095855:ios.summary:
Car Sort – Match 3 Car Puzzle with a Twist of Traffic Jam Fun 
Welcome to Car Sort, the most satisfying and brain-teasing match 3 puzzle game on the road. Sort cars, clear car jam, and relax your mind as you help quirky vehicles find their
bluejetty:00095855:ios.description:
Car Sort – Match 3 Car Puzzle with a Twist of Traffic Jam Fun 
Welcome to Car Sort, the most satisfying and brain-teasing match 3 puzzle game on the road. Sort cars, clear car jam, and relax your mind as you help quirky vehicles find their way out of a jammed-up world!
Tap, Match, Sort — and Drive Away the Stress!
In Car Sort, your mission is simple yet challenging: match 3 or more cars of the same color to clear them from the board and keep the roads moving. Every level is a new traffic jam puzzle full of color, chaos, and clever strategy. Think fast, plan smart, and enjoy every satisfying match!
Key Features You'll Love:
- Unique Car-Themed Match 3 Gameplay: Combine your favorite vehicles — from police cars and taxis to rainbow buses and space-age rides — in a fun twist on classic match 3 puzzles.
- Chill but Challenging: Whether you're in the mood to relax or flex your brain, Car Sort offers a perfect balance of soothing visuals and strategic car match puzzles that grow with your skill.
- Exciting Levels & Dynamic Traffic Zones: Travel through colorful neighborhoods, tricky intersections, and fantastical roads as you unlock new challenges and zones.
- Boosters & Combos Galore: Need a little help? Use powerful boosters to clear tough car jams and create epic combos that will leave the road wide open!
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: No Wi-Fi? No problem. Enjoy offline gameplay and make progress wherever you are — stress-free and at your own pace.
- Fun for Everyone: With intuitive gameplay and a cheerful design, Car Sort is perfect for players of all ages. Easy to pick up, hard to put down!
Why You'll Keep Coming Back:
- No Timer for you to relax: Each puzzle invites you to think a few moves ahead — but never pressures you with a timer. It’s your road, your rules.
- Engaging Events & Daily Rewards: Come back every day for surprises, bonuses, and special traffic-themed events that keep the fun fresh and rewarding.
- A World Full of Character: From heroic helicopters to grumpy garbage trucks, each vehicle has a personality. Help them on their journey and enjoy the playful animations as they drive off!
Ready to unwind and challenge your brain at the same time?
Download Car Sort now and start matching cars, sorting colors, and clearing traffic jam your way!
Let’s hit the road — the car match puzzle fun is just a tap away!

bluejetty:00062918:ios.description:
Get ready to spice up your game night by trying our new and improved version of Adult Charades! Instead of writing down words on a piece of paper, have the app generate random words for your group of friends to act out and guess.
During the game, get creative to help the player figure which word is on the phone by using your imagination to sing, dance, act, draw, describe, or even hand gesture clues to the person guessing. Do whatever form of communication works best for your group to reach a new high score.
Wonderful App Features:
- Unlimited amount of players
- 20+ Categories to choose from
- Unlimited game play, without ads
How To Play:
1. Choose a category 
2. Select player one - have them place the phone on their forehead horizontally 
3. Ready, Set, Go!
4. All players call out clues to help player one guess the item on their forehead before the timer runs out
- If player one guesses correctly, tilt the phone down/forward.
- If player one isn’t sure, tilt the phone up to cue next item.
5. Once the timer is up, see the score you got! 
- Pass phone to the next player.

bluejetty:00045942:ios.description:
ID MPU by Valid é o aplicativo oficial de identificação digital do Ministério Público da União
Agora você pode ter a sua identidade do Ministério Público em versão digital no seu dispositivo móvel. ID MPU by Valid é um aplicativo seguro que proporciona mais praticidade ao se identificar.
IMPORTANTE:
- A versão digital da Carteira do Ministério Público da União está disponível somente para as novas carteiras emitidas a partir de maio de 2023.
- A Carteira Digital do MPU é válida em todo território nacional e possui o mesmo valor jurídico da versão física.
- A carteira digital atende a Membros, Membros Eméritos, Servidores e Servidores Aposentados do Ministério Público da União.
Confira os benefícios de se identificar através da versão digital no seu dia a dia:
- Acesso a sua identidade profissional, independentemente de conectividade à internet após conclusão da primeira validação do documento.
- Suas informações de identificação protegidas por senha ou biometria, o que proporciona mais segurança no armazenamento e transporte.
- Versão digital dispensa cópia autenticada em cartório, uma vez que é válida assim como o documento impresso.
- Identidade na palma da sua mão através do dispositivo celular para se identificar como membro ou servidor do MPU no seu dia a dia.
- Validação da autenticidade do documento através de padrão QR code;
- Possibilidade de compartilhar cópia segura, assinada digitalmente com certificado digital.
COMO EMITIR A SUA CARTEIRA DIGITAL?
Passo 1: Instale o aplicativo Carteira Digital - MPU no seu dispositivo celular. Para o primeiro acesso, é necessário ter em mãos a nova carteira emitida a partir de maio de 2023.
Passo 2: Identifique o QR code no verso da sua carteira profissional de identidade e siga as instruções para validação do código e verificação biométrica do seu rosto.
Passo 3: Aguarde a confirmação dos seus dados. Em poucos minutos, a versão digital do seu documento estará disponível no seu dispositivo celular para sua maior praticidade e segurança.
O Carteira Digital - MPU é o aplicativo oficial do Ministério Público da União desenvolvido através de prestação de serviço pela empresa Valid, também responsável pela confecção dos documentos físicos.

- Validação da autenticidade do documento através de padrão QR code;
- Possibilidade de compartilhar cópia segura, assinada digitalmente com certificado digital.

COMO EMITIR A SUA CARTEIRA DIGITAL?

Passo 1: Instale o aplicativo Carteira Digital - MPU no seu dispositivo celular. Para o primeiro acesso, é necessário ter em mãos a nova carteira emitida a partir de maio de 2023.

Passo 2: Identifique o QR code no verso da sua carteira profissional de identidade e siga as instruções para validação do código e verificação biométrica do seu rosto.

Passo 3: Aguarde a confirmação dos seus dados. Em poucos minutos, a versão digital do seu documento estará disponível no seu dispositivo celular para sua maior praticidade e segurança.

O Carteira Digital - MPU é o aplicativo oficial do Ministério Público da União desenvolvido através de prestação de serviço pela empresa Valid, também responsável pela confecção dos documentos físicos.

اكتشف طريقة جديدة وممتعة لتصفّح وشراء المنتجات: يحوّلك Elixir إلى تجربة تسوّق غنية بمقاطع الفيديو القصيرة، حيث يمكنك استعراض أحدث الصيحات من الأزياء والتجميل والإلكترونيات وديكور المنز
bluejetty:00098706:ios.description:
Elixir – إعادة تعريف التسوّق عبر مقاطع الفيديو القصيرة
اكتشف طريقة جديدة وممتعة لتصفّح وشراء المنتجات: يحوّلك Elixir إلى تجربة تسوّق غنية بمقاطع الفيديو القصيرة، حيث يمكنك استعراض أحدث الصيحات من الأزياء والتجميل والإلكترونيات وديكور المنزل، ثم الشراء بنقرة واحدة.
المميزات الرئيسية
تصفح مدعوم بالفيديو: اسحب للأعلى والأسفل لمشاهدة مقاطع فيديو قصيرة مصمّمة خصيصًا لك. تقنية التحميل المسبق والتجزئة الذكية تضمن عرضًا فوريًّا ودون تقطيع.
شراء داخل الفيديو: أعجبك منتج؟ اضغط “أضف إلى السلة” مباشرة من المقطع دون مغادرة الشاشة.
محرّر فيديو مدمج: سجّل وحرّر مقاطعك باستخدام محرّر داخلي متقدّم: طبق الفلاتر، وأضف الملصقات والنصوص، وشاركها فورًا داخل التطبيق—لا حاجة لأدوات خارجية.
تنبيهات في الوقت الحقيقي: تابع العروض المحدودة وتخفيضات الأسعار وتوفر المنتجات وإشعارات حالة الطلب حسب تفضيلاتك.
تفاعل اجتماعي: أعجب، علّق وشارك المقاطع مع أصدقائك أو على منصات التواصل. تابع المبدعين والمتاجر المفضّلة لديك واكتشف مجتمعات تشاركك ذوقك.
توصيات ذكية: يتعلّم Elixir من اختياراتك ليقدّم لك منتجات مخصصة تناسب اهتماماتك.
التخزين للمشاهدة لاحقًا: احفظ مقاطعك المفضّلة لمشاهدتها لاحقاً او أوفلاين، مثالية للرحلات والمناطق ذات الاتصال المحدود.
بحث وفلاتر متقدمة: حدّد النتائج بسرعة بحسب الفئة، العلامة التجارية أو الشعبية لتصل إلى ما تريد بالضبط.
قائمة أمنيات ومجموعات: احفظ المنتجات لتعيد زيارتها أو شاركها مع الأصدقاء ضمن مجموعات مُنسّقة.
دفع آمن ومرن: اختر من بين بطاقات الائتمان، المحافظ الإلكترونية وطرق الدفع المضمّنة داخل التطبيق.
لماذا ستعشق Elixir؟
Elixir ليس مجرد تطبيق؛ بل هو مجتمع للتسوق يدمج المتعة مع الراحة. سواء كنت من محبّي الصيحات الجديدة، أو تبحث عن أفضل العروض، أو مبدعًا يودّ عرض منتجاته، ستجد في Elixir المنصة الأمثل التي تبقيك متفاعلًا ومتجددًا.
كيفية الاستخدام
تصفّح: اسحب لمشاهدة مقاطع قصيرة مصممة حسب ذوقك.
اكتشف: اضغط للاطّلاع على التفاصيل، القراءة عن تقييمات المستخدمين، والمقارنة بين المنتجات.
اشترِ: أضف إلى السلة وأكمل الدفع بأمان وسرعة.
اصنع وشارك: سجّل مقاطعك، علّم المنتجات، وألهم الآخرين.
انضم إلى حركة Elixir
حوّل كل تمريرة إلى لحظة اكتشاف. حمّل Elixir الآن وابدأ رحلة التسوّق الديناميكية التي تنتظرها!

bluejetty:00178702:ios.name: Ship Simulator : Sea Game
bluejetty:00178702:ios.summary: Get back to your dreams and Simulate your world in Real Cruise Ship Driving Simulator adventure game. Buckle up to become commander of giant Ship and ship tycoon in deep blue sea. Offroad Games Studio developed "Ship Simulator 2023" game wi
bluejetty:00178702:ios.description:
Get back to your dreams and Simulate your world in Real Cruise Ship Driving Simulator adventure game. Buckle up to become commander of giant Ship and ship tycoon in deep blue sea. Offroad Games Studio developed "Ship Simulator 2023" game with a different set of transport challenges and adventures. Explore multiple cruise ship transportation challenge vehicles in highly advanced transport ship Simulator 2022 game. Sail through the biggest oceans and exotic locations like Alexandria, Limassol, Corfu, Tripoli, Oran, Valencia and many others.
"Cruise Ship Simulator 2023" Titan cruise Gwadar ship game allows you to enjoy multiple driving and simulation experiences. This New big ship transporter simulator game is combo of car driving simulator and ship driving and racing game. Navigate your ship in iconic port cities around the world in dynamic oceans, ports and deliver cargo in defined time frame to destination. Load Big vehicles from port and deliver it to other port without bumping into any hurdle. Choose your unique advanced ship to roam around in realistic and detailed open world map and complete missions.
"Real Ship Simulator Game 2023" advanced boat driving simulator along with cargo simulator is a real game in which you will travel from one port to another. No Gawadar Cruise Ship racing game and boat simulator game is complete without some luxurious cruise ships - check them out by unlocking. Enjoy the easy smooth control with giant cruise ship to travel in a big blue sea to complete challenging missions.
As the captain of a giant cargo ship it's your duty to transport cargo from one port to another safely. Enjoy playing this ultimate Ship Simulator 2022 game but keep eye on fuel and health of ship. Drive your big Titanic Ship as a cargo ship professional captain, ship sailor and big cruise ship driver and complete assigned jobs in stipulated time. Drive vehicle to port without crashing and park there to deliver to other port. Mini map given to guide and to control direction of your ship use Helm (Ship Steering) and speed button. Multiple camera option is available to make your driving and journey toward your destination more smooth.
Game Features:
1. Weather Effects
2. Visually stunning graphics
3. Variety of ships to choose from
4. Open world map
5. Realistic sounds of water splashes and actual ship engine sounds
6. Interesting and easy Controls
7. Stimulating Hurdles
8. Race against time
Hit install button and become a transportation tycoon in Ship Simulator 2022 game and make your journey memorable in deep oceans and beautiful ports of world. Please make sure to share it with your friends and give your valuable feedback after playing this ship simulator 2022 game.

bluejetty:00118869:ios.description:
Securely Access all your corporate resources from your iPhone and iPad through a Virtual Private Network (VPN) tunnel. 
As you launch business applications such as RDP, VoIP or any other app on your Apple mobile device, all transmitted data to corporate is encrypted, without any additional actions required by you. 
This application connects to a Check Point Security Gateway. Please contact your security Administrator for first-time setup. For an SSL VPN Portal application please download the “Check Point Capsule Workspace” 
Administrators: Deployment details are available on the support site: http://supportcontent.checkpoint.com/solutions?id=sk69540
Application Features
• Securely connect to corporate resources from your iPhone and iPad with a full layer-3 VPN tunnel
• Supports SSL and IPSec (including visitor mode) 
• Authentication methods: user/password, user certificate, challenge/response, one time password tokens
• VPN Connection persistency upon device roaming 
• “On demand” automatic connection establishment upon access to corporate resources
• Scan a QR code or click a URL for a 1-step first-time-configuration 
• API for external applications 
To learn more about Check Point Capsule visit http://www.checkpoint.com/capsule/
About Check Point Software Technologies 
Check Point Software Technologies, Ltd. is a world-wide leader in Network and Endpoint Security. 
Visit www.checkpoint.com

YOUR DAILY SPORTS FEED

bluejetty:00041795:ios.summary: MMGuardian Parental Control helps parents keep their kids safe online. Parents can manage screen time, track location, block apps, and monitor kids phone usage. As a leading parental control app, MMGuardian gives you all the tools to protec
bluejetty:00041795:ios.description:
MMGuardian Parental Control helps parents keep their kids safe online. Parents can manage screen time, track location, block apps, and monitor kids phone usage. As a leading parental control app, MMGuardian gives you all the tools to protect your child from digital risks and guide them towards healthy device habits.
This is the app for the parent's phone. Install this app first, and you will be guided to install the correct app for your child's phone (iPhone or non-iPhones).
COMPREHENSIVE MONITORING
- View your child's location, SMS text messages, app usage, call logs, and web browsing history.
- Receive safety alerts when messages indicate dangers such as sexting, drugs, cyberbullying, grooming, violence, or suicidal thoughts*.
- Monitor phone calls: see who your child is calling and receiving calls from.
MANAGE SCREEN TIME
- Set daily screen time limits.
- Block or allow apps easily with the built-in app blocker.
- Schedule when specific apps can be used to avoid distractions.
SAFE WEB BROWSING
- Block inappropriate websites.
LOCATION TRACKING
- Track your child's phone location in real-time.
- View location history to know where they have been.
- Use the family locator feature to find your child quickly.
DETAILED REPORTS
- Full reports of text messages, call logs, app usage, and web activity.
- Understand your child's phone habits with easy-to-read summaries.
SOCIAL CHAT MONITORING
MMGuardian also monitors messages from popular social media apps:
- WhatsApp
- Kik
And for non-iPhone child phones:
- Facebook Messenger
- Snapchat
- Instagram
- TikTok
- Discord
FREE 14 DAY TRIAL:
Try all premium features free for 14 days. After the trial, continue protecting your child by subscribing:
- $4.99/month or $49.99/year for one child phone.
- Family plans available for up to 5 child devices.
SETUP NOTES:
- Both parent and child phones must use the same email address.
- Both devices need network data for communication.
- Compatible with iPhone or non-iPhone child phones.
- When the child phone is an iPhone, an additional computer app must be installed to get message and call history reports.
We encourage parents to openly discuss using a parental control app with their children. Explain how it helps protect them from risks such as screen time addiction, cyberbullying, sexting, and online predators, while encouraging responsible digital behavior.
