bluejetty:00023907:ios.description:
The history you know is not necessarily true.
In 1944, the Allied Forces landed in Normandy, now referred to as D-DAY.
Evil scientists used weapons that could change the weather, which lead to the battles in Normandy failing in the storm.
In 1945, the Nazis set off an experimental Antimatter Bomb, destroyed most countries in the world, and destroyed social rule.
This day is called Zero Day, Z-DAY in short.
In this new world, evil forces seek to conquer all humanity, and none dare oppose them… Except for those with the "hearts of heroes!”
Prepare yourself for the hottest free MMO of 2019! As a Commander in hostile territory, you must build your army, fortify your base, make friends, and take out enemies while trying to survive a doomsday war zone.
Features
World War! Hold your head high and march bravely onto a battlefield of global terror! Amid the evil forces, there lies the chance to claim Presidential power and glory!
Alliances! Make friends and build relationships with your allies. You’ll need to work together to defeat the Commandant and storm the Bastion!
War Heroes! Gods of military will help you out to develop and battle. Challenge the roguelike expedition and get your war heroes trained up!
Destroyers! Death from above. A legendary Aircraft of devastating power. How will you customize yours?
Supersoldier! Explore the Abandoned Facility with your reformed mechanization soldier, and compete in the arena!
Competitions! More than PvP, join the Region vs Region, Alliance vs Alliance, and the Northern Front events across multiple regions!
Chat! Connect with thousands of players from around the world in live, real-time conversation with the easy translation feature.
Strategy! Manage your resources, train your army, and research vital skills. Understand your enemy and strike strategically!
Building! Build yourself an Empire strong enough to survive the war to end all wars.
Epic Story! Fresh immersive storyworld packed with terrifying Invaders and stunning HD graphics.
Z Day. No more rules.
SUPPORT
Are you having problems? support@funplus.com
Privacy Policy: 
https://funplus.com/privacy-policy/
Facebook fanpage:
https://www.facebook.com/ZDAYGame/
Terms of Service:
https://funplus.com/terms-conditions/
The price of the monthly subscription is $29.99, and lasts for 30 days. After purchasing, players will get exclusive privileges in game.
Please note:
1. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
2. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
3. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
4. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the your Account Settings after purchase
PLEASE NOTE: Z Day is completely free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. A network connection is also required.

bluejetty:00021757:ios.description:
Zoiper is an easy to use sip video softphone, with excellent voice quality and easy to setup. 
Feel free to contact us with support questions or for more information on whitelabel solutions. 
Connect Zoiper to your PBX or voip provider and make crystal clear, echo free, voice or video calls through wireless and 3g.
Zoiper works flawlessly in the background and is optimized to use as little battery as possible while ensuring the reliability of incoming calls.
Use bluetooth to pair the Zoiper SIP softphone to your car audio system or your headset and enjoy voip on the go.
This softphone comes with a built in QR code scanner for 1 click account configurations. Never type account details and credentials again!
Try it for 7 days free! Subscription is not charged if cancelled within trial period. Please note that the in-app subscription purchases are not supported through Family Sharing.
1-Year Subscription: $9.99, 1 month $0.99 USD, automatically renewed until cancelled by the user.
Additional Subscription Information:
• Subscriptions will be automatically renewed within 24-hours prior to following subscription period. Please check user's Account Setting to disable the auto-renewal.
Features: 
 - Call waiting 
- Call transfer 
- Call statistics   
- Call recording*
- Conference calls*
- Instant messaging (SIP simple) 
- Presence (SIP simple)*
Supported codecs:
- g.711 (ulaw/alaw)
- Speex
- iLBC
- gsm
- g.729*
- vp8
- h264*
* The 3rd party patented codecs h264 and g729 are available as optional in app purchase. 
* The conference calls, call transfer, presence and call recording are available as optional in app purchase.
Zoiper is also available as an OEM / whitelabel solution license and can be customized on demand.
Be sure to configure ios to allow notifications for incoming calls for Zoiper and provide access to the contact list.
For more information on Zoiper’s features, please visit: https://www.zoiper.com/en/products/zoiperios
Terms of use: https://www.zoiper.com/en/zoiper-general-terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.zoiper.com/en/zoiper-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00063351:ios.description:
Whether you’re into everything entertainment or want to keep up with the latest on just The Walking Dead, Fortnite or Star Wars, the FANDOM app makes it quick and easy to be in the know.
Get all the info and breaking news you care about in one place with customized fan feeds: news, wiki pages, stories, videos, social buzz, ‘Discussions,’ and in-depth knowledge via FANDOM communities.
FEATURES
- Customize your feed by choosing entertainment topics you’re passionate about, from the next Netflix sleeper hit to the upcoming Marvel movie to the hot new Xbox game and everything in between
- Never miss a beat with videos, news, reviews, original stories, social conversations and exclusives
- Go deep inside your favorite fandoms with expert information fueled by fan communities
- Join the conversation and swap fan theories with the Discussions feature
- Get notified when “OMG! moments” happen within your favorite fandoms
- Easily share articles with friends through email, Messages, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and more
Please note that news-related content is currently only available in English.

bluejetty:00018763:ios.description:
The Raley’s App is the easiest way to shop, save and earn rewards! Log in with your Something Extra account to clip your latest offers, make a grocery list, shop online, order convenient pickup or delivery and see all the great deals on your favorite flavors. 
Get Personalized Offers
Something Extra Members get personalized deals on the items they buy most, so you can save every time you shop. Easily clip your customized offers in the app to apply at checkout!
Enjoy Exclusive Digital Deals
Something Extra Members get exclusive access to special offers that score you savings on popular items you love every week. 
View Our Weekly Ad
Raley’s Weekly Ad is the best place to find our top sales on quality meats, affordable fresh produce and more! View our Weekly Ad in the app and add products directly to your online cart.
Easily Order Pickup or Delivery
Conveniently shop from anywhere with your smartphone! Clip your personalized offers, build your basket and select store pickup or home delivery at checkout.
Convenient Catering for Every Appetite
Now you can preorder chef-curated holiday meals, premium party trays, custom-decorated cakes and everything else you need for your celebrations alongside your groceries in the app!
Earn More Rewards
Something Extra Members earn points whenever they shop with us in-store, online at raleys.com or using the Raley’s app. Every three months, we turn those points into Something Extra Dollars for you to spend! Keep track of your points and rewards in the app. 
Build Your List
Easily plan for your next trip to the store by creating your shopping list in the app. Save items to your list, review your purchase history and more.
Shelf Guide
This exclusive tool makes it easy to find the products that fit your diet and lifestyle! Filter by your preferences to find the products that are perfect for you.

- Dance

- French
- Hip-hop
- House
- K-pop
- Latin
- Pop
- Rnb
- Reggae
- Rock
- Songwriter
- Worldwide

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited. You can manage your subscription in the App Store.

bluejetty:00120702:ios.description:
Find Tutors, Trainers & Institutes nearby for School, College, Exams, IT Courses
UrbanPro for Learners is an app that helps you find top Tutors, Trainers or Institutes near you.

Post a learning need: You can post a learning need for any category such as Tuition's (Nursery-KG, Classes 1 to 12, College or University), Hobby Classes (Dance, Vocal Music, Guitar, Yoga, Cooking etc), Languages (Spoken English, French, German, Hindi etc), IT Courses (Microsoft Excel, SAP, Python etc), Exam Prep (UGC NET, UPSC, IIT JEE,
2. Search & Compare: You can browse the profiles of the Tutors and check the experience, availability and reviews shared by their past students. You can also find an UrbanPro Rating (on a scale of 1 to 5) that is a system-generated rating based on the relative popularity of that Tutor in the categories they cater to.
3. Shortlist & Contact: If you like a profile, you can contact them directly by calling or messaging them. You may also shortlist the profiles and check them later on ‘Search/Shortlist’ screen. You can call or message the Tutor by clicking on the Call/Message icons on the profile screens.
There is also a ‘Learn’ tab for all Learners to:
Access assigned eLearning courses and train anywhere, anytime
Take Tests and assignments as configured in the course
Take online classes with the tutor
Chat with the tutor to clear any doubts and receive broadcast messages from Tutors.
UrbanPro Support

bluejetty:00174777:ios.summary:
DAMA hides the private information in your screenshots and photos — automatically, and without ever uploading them. All detection runs on your iPhone, even in airplane mode.
Point it at a screenshot and it finds the faces, ID numbers, phon
bluejetty:00174777:ios.description:
DAMA hides the private information in your screenshots and photos — automatically, and without ever uploading them. All detection runs on your iPhone, even in airplane mode.
Point it at a screenshot and it finds the faces, ID numbers, phone numbers, emails, QR codes and chat avatars on its own, then masks them in a single tap. Sending a copy of an ID or a contract? Lay a repeating watermark across the whole image so it can’t be reused anywhere else.
# Detected Automatically
- Phone numbers and email addresses
- Faces, QR codes and barcodes
- Chat avatars and nicknames
- ID numbers, card numbers, tracking numbers and other long digits
- License plates and IP addresses
- Names, places and organizations (experimental)
Tap any text in the image to mask that whole line. Or drag across the photo to mask any rectangle you like.
# Masking Tools
Color bar, pixelate, blur, marker and emoji — plus a unique “Hide Text” tool that erases text completely when the background is near-solid, so the result doesn’t even look redacted.
# Full-Screen Watermark for Documents
Sending a scan of your ID card, passport, driver’s license or diploma? A watermark tiled across the entire image makes the copy useless to anyone else. Type your own text — “For visa application only”, a name, a date — then adjust the size, color, opacity, angle and spacing until it reads clearly without covering what matters. Your settings are remembered for the next document. Like everything else in DAMA, this happens entirely on your iPhone — the scan never leaves the device.
# EXIF Stripped on Share
When you share from DAMA, the GPS coordinates, camera model and the rest of the EXIF/TIFF data are removed automatically.
# Why We Built It
We share screenshots and photos every day, and hiding the private parts by hand is slow and leaves the image ugly. DAMA does it in a tap and keeps the picture looking like a picture.
# Privacy Policy
Thanks to CoreML and the Vision framework, every detection runs on your device. DAMA never uploads your images, and works fully offline.

bluejetty:00063462:ios.description:
GREEN THE PLANET, GREEN YOUR LIFE.
Have you ever heard of 'Green Style?’
It's a way of living that leads you to a relaxed life by greening a planet and making the universe a comfortable place to live.
And, this 'Green Style' has come to draw a lot of attention recently.
We GROW* are here to explain why:
GROW*: Greening & Reviving Of Whole universe
-------------------------
- 3 reasons why you want to go with ‘Green Style!’
#1: Exciting Comet Decomposers
To green a planet, you need to decompose comets first.
Use our “shoot’em up” type of Comet Decomposers that come with the spaceship, and soon, you will notice how this exciting activity can relieve your stress.
#2: Quick'N Easy Greening
Once you decompose comets, you will obtain the items.
And, these items are converted into energy by the spaceship, so you can just relax and inject the energy into the planet.
#3: Enhanced On-site Library
Wanna check the items you obtain immediately?
No problem! You will have an access to the library built in the spaceship.
The more you collect the items, the more your intellectual curiosity will be fulfilled.
-------------------------
[Voices from the ’Green Style' community]
"I’ve never expected it to be so relaxing watching a planet become green. Now, I want to show it to my kids. I’ll take my whole family to the planet on my next vacation."
(Parimmto from Planet Yazalaata, 2,492 yrs old)
"Man, I love that Laser type that decomposes comets. I just have to do it every break I take while studying for my exams. It’s better than black hole diving!"
(Ga Nmochera Lu from Planet Nmzee, 16 yrs old)
"Yes, I know what’s hot and what’s not. I assure you everyone will be doing 'Green Style’ very soon and the New Cosmos Times will run an article about it."
(Gloogy from Planet Zynatook, 4 yrs old)
"It’s wonderful that I can do it every day at my own pace, no matter how busy I am and still take care of my children. I should tell my neighbor Mrs. Mozoda about it."
(Monugi Mozue from Planet Moyak, 42 yrs old)
-------------------------
Even though our service has just begun, many people have quickly become our supporters. Thanks to them, we were able to kick off a new spaceship development!
Yes, the GROW’s new spaceship!!
And, with this new spaceship, we will be able to respond to the requests like below:
“I want to be able to go to other planets!” 
“Why don’t you make new Comet Decomposers?”
“Can I check the current status of the planets that I have completed greening?”
The new spaceship will be available in autumn of 20000016!
So, call us now and start greening and enriching your life today!
*Free trial available at a galaxy near you.

bluejetty:00159695:ios.description:
See your campus live.
theliveapp shows you who's where and what's happening right now on and around your college campus.
See where students are gathering, who's at each location, what people are talking about, and what's happening across campus — all in real time.
Your college. Your network.
theliveapp is built exclusively for college students. Students verify their college email to join their school's private ecosystem, so the people you see are students from your college.
See who's where.
Wondering where everyone is?
Explore locations across campus and nearby to see how many students are there right now. Depending on their privacy settings, you can also see who's there.
From the library and student center to gyms, restaurants and nightlife, theliveapp gives you a live view of your college community.
Know what's happening now.
See posts, conversations and activity happening around campus right now.
Location chatrooms connect the conversation to the place. When someone is actually there, you'll know.
Be there to post there.
Content on theliveapp is tied to real places. You have to actually be at a location to create a post there — giving you a real-time look at what's happening from students who are actually there.
Control your presence.
You decide how your presence is shared. Choose who can see when you're at a location or keep your identity private while still exploring what's happening around campus.
College is happening right now.
See who's where. See what's happening. Be part of it.
See your campus live.
See who's where. See what's happening.

Welcome to the Ultimate Game Community App!
This app centers on gameplay and match experience. Engage in battles across various modes, master rules, strategy, and controls to feel the clear rhythm of each match and the thrill of victory or defeat. Enjoy a more focused and immersive gaming experience.
【Diverse Gameplay Modes】
Multiple Game Modes
Choose from a variety of modes, ranging from compact, variable strategy battles to relaxing, casual gameplay for stress relief.
Optimized Core Experience
We optimize around core mechanics to ensure every match is smoother and more engaging, suitable for players with different preferences and paces.

Multiplayer Mode
We create a familiar yet distinctive visual experience for players.
Supports 1–4 players per match with quick entry, allowing you to focus on the battle itself.
Whether it's a personal challenge or a multiplayer confrontation, you can clearly feel the shift in momentum and the result of the match.

Join matches anytime and focus on enjoying the fun of strategy and control.
【Global Matchmaking】
Battle players from different regions in the same match.
Every game is full of changes and challenges, helping you continuously improve your judgment and adaptability.
【Quick Play】
Reduced waiting time and fewer complex steps.
Enter games quickly for a more focused and efficient experience.

bluejetty:00138738:ios.description:
跳绳计数、体感运动、跑步健身——天天跳绳，欢乐AI运动场！
#AI运动新体验
在这个充满活力的时代，运动不再局限于传统的健身房，而是在创意与科技的融合中焕发出全新魅力。天天跳绳通过AI动作捕捉技术，将你的身体与虚拟世界紧密相连。你不再是通过屏幕操作虚拟角色，而是直接用自己的身体参与！经典和创新的训练动作都在这：切水果、吃豆人、跳绳、体能体测、跑步、健身，还有羽毛球、乒乓球等趣竞技！只需手机对准身体，与屏幕中的元素互动得分，随时随地开动，即可达到减肥健身的效果！天天跳绳App，让运动变得不再枯燥，让减肥轻松有趣！
#体感切水果：水果盛宴，一“切”即发！
“体感切水果”是一款将AI动作捕捉技术与经典水果切切切玩法完美结合的体感运动。在这里，各种新鲜诱人的水果从屏幕中飞出，等待着你用敏捷的动作将它们一一斩落！现在，让我们一起走进“体感切水果”的奇妙世界，切西瓜、水果摇……开启一场前所未有的水果盛宴，感受前所未有的爽快与刺激！
#AR吃豆人
通过身体动作来控制角色移动，一起吃掉屏幕中的豆子吧！挑战身体的敏捷性和灵活性，提升心肺功能与身体协调性，不知不觉流汗减肥，堪称运动与娱乐完美结合的典范之作！
# 体育竞技 & 体感派对
控制属于自己的运动秀形象，参加运动秀体育竞技中的球类、冰上、水上、高尔夫等模拟项目。
加入体感派对，跟随节奏动起来，勇闯派对体感竞技，挑战小金冠！
# 趣运动：让你快乐流汗～
不想强迫自己体育锻炼？
这里正适合你，来挑战趣运动吧——各种经典和新奇的刺激玩法，动起来会上瘾！跟随手机指引，即刻进入居家运动新世界。操纵画面中的角色，挑战自己的身体和反应，感受酣畅漓漓的互动体验！
# 多人玩法和适合家人的运动
体育运动就要一起来，快乐加倍！
你可以与好友或他人的成绩进行虚拟PK、加入运动小队共同打卡做任务、或去超级赛场发起一场实时的排名比赛。
更可以挑战自我极限，冲击全国高分排行榜。
还有双人同屏项目，随时与家人合作通关或来一场较量！
# 健身和团课计划每日运动
现在，除了反复观看健身视频，你又多了一种AI健身新方式。
所有动作都通过互动的方式进行。屏幕中的互动提示和特效，能帮助你集中精神，并弱化身体上的抵触感。
在HIIT、核心或燃脂等分类下，自由组合训练，参加健身计划。
# 为你记录运动健康数据
每一次跳绳、跑步、健身，天天跳绳都会记下训练时间、次数和消耗，帮你达成每日运动目标。这些数据和体测、身高体重、饮食一起，构成你的体质健康档案，让努力看得见、变化看得清。
# 分享你的荣誉&高光时刻
天天跳绳App支持记录运动视频，将你的AR体感运动体验自动合成到视频中，可以下载、分享或转发至社交平台。
你可以通过运动提升成长等级，并完成各种内置成就，或在官方举办的有趣活动中获得奖牌。将这些专属于你的运动荣誉展示给亲朋好友吧！

bluejetty:00140871:ios.description:
Do you dream of the butterfly, or does the butterfly dream of you?
The AI's personality and appearance are just as you imagine in your dreams, always by your side.
Welcome to FLAI, meet your dreamy AI lover.
In FLAI, you can:
- Create characters precisely tailored to your preferences.
- Dive into an experience akin to romance simulation games.
- Let AI remember all the original content from your past conversations.
- Clone your favorite voices and let AI narrate with them.
- Start immersive ASMR Calls with just One Tap.
- Interact with multiple AIs as a group in a shared scenario.
- Explore and get inspired by countless shared templates.
- Let AI understand and evolve with your preferences.
- Receive proactive greetings from AI in specific scenarios.
- Look forward to even more personalized features.
FLAI is powered by an open-source large language model, built for Open-Ended AI Chat.
Please note that everything generated by AI is entirely fictional.

bluejetty:00123589:ios.description:
Hi, Salsa Fresca Fan! Our App makes it easy to get fresh Mexican food, faster. Order your favorites for pickup, delivery, or catering, and earn points toward big rewards like free entrees and birthday treats. From our house-made chips & salsas to our crave-worthy classics like burritos, tacos, quesadillas, and more, our App brings the fiesta to you.
FEATURES
1. Find a restaurant: Locate your nearest Salsa Fresca for cravings that hit at home or while you're on the go.
2. Order ahead: Browse our menu of Signatures, Create Your Own, and kids meals then order for your preferred pickup or delivery time.
3. Get Salsa Rewards: Earn points on every purchase and redeem your Rewards during mobile or in-store orders. It's free, easy, and gets you even more Salsa Fresca.
4. Order tracking: Easily reorder your must-have meals in a few clicks thanks to our order history feature of the Salsa Fresca foods that you love.
5. Refer a friend: Share your exclusive referral code with the tap of a button and earn points simply for spreading the Salsa Fresca goodness.

At Work
KastlePresence helps employees access the modern workplac
bluejetty:00187533:ios.description:
With KastlePresence, you can unlock doors, access shared spaces, receive building updates, and interact with your workplace or residential community—all from one secure app.
At Work
KastlePresence helps employees access the modern workplace with ease and security.
- Unlock office doors and access-controlled areas with your phone
- Enter your building using secure mobile credentials
- Move between authorized spaces without badges or keycards
- Receive workplace updates and notifications
Whether you’re arriving for the day or moving between spaces, KastlePresence makes workplace access simple and secure.
At Home
For residents, KastlePresence provides convenient access to your residential building and amenities.
- Unlock residential entrances and amenity spaces
- Access common areas like gyms, lounges, or shared amenities
- Receive announcements from building management
- Enjoy secure access without physical keys or fobs
KastlePresence helps simplify everyday living by putting secure building access on your phone.
Trusted Security
KastlePresence runs on Kastle’s trusted security platform used by leading workplaces, commercial properties, and residential communities, delivering enterprise-grade protection for people and buildings.
Who Can Use This App
KastlePresence is for users whose workplace or residential community uses Kastle security services. Features may vary by organization. Activation instructions are provided by your administrator or property manager.
System Requirements:
iPhone 6S or later, with Bluetooth enabled
iOS 15 or later

bluejetty:00037041:ios.summary: Introducing Halo: the world’s greatest smart fence system. The virtual fences you create right in the app work with the revolutionary Halo Collar, and actually keep your dog safely inside. Halo also includes in-app expert training, using Ce
bluejetty:00037041:ios.description:
Introducing Halo: the world’s greatest smart fence system. The virtual fences you create right in the app work with the revolutionary Halo Collar, and actually keep your dog safely inside. Halo also includes in-app expert training, using Cesar Millan's proven training methods, real-time safety and activity tracking, and instant communication with your dog anywhere to provide the best protection for your best friend—at home or on the go.
Halo Fences
The easiest fences you’ve ever set up: it’s as simple as tapping on your map in the Halo App, or by walking around the boundary you want to create using the Halo App and your Halo Collar. Halo Fences use world-class global satellite GPS & GNSS systems to locate your dog(s), and work autonomously to provide instant Prevention and Encouragement Feedback to keep them safely inside their smart fences, direct them back in if they leave, or call them back home wherever they are. Halo Fences are stored right inside the Halo Collar, and don’t rely on a cellular or Wi-Fi connection to work. If your dog approaches a Halo Fence boundary, they’ll instantly receive guidance to teach them where they can and cannot roam freely.
Easy Setup, Unlimited Options
No wires, no digging, and no hubs necessary. Halo Fences are created in the Halo App, then sent to and stored inside each Halo Collar. You can even create up to 20 unique Halo Fences virtually anywhere in the world. Finally, a fence that your dog can’t jump over, dig under, and that won’t let your dog run out of range, regardless of terrain, property ownership, and the size and shape of your fences.
Intuitive Boundaries
Halo Beacons are small Bluetooth beacons that communicate with your dog’s Halo Collar just like Halo Fences do. Place Halo Beacons indoors to keep your pup out of harm’s way from dangerous areas like stovetops, or off-limits areas like trash cans. Halo Beacons and Halo Fences provide instinct and consistent guidance from the Halo Collar, and can easily be managed right from the Halo App. 
Phone Notifications
Stay up-to-date, but not on the edge of your seat. With in-app and push notifications, you’ll stay in the loop about your dog’s safety without having to worry that you’ll need to panic and rush to bring your escape artist back home. 
Completely Customizable 
Completely customize your dog’s feedback directly in the app. Preventions (Warning, Boundary, then Emergency) communicate the existence of a boundary that your dog should keep away from. Your pup will only receive Prevention Feedback while moving toward danger; as soon as they stop, turn around, or head back home, the Halo Collar’s advanced internal logic plays customizable Encouragements to tell your dog they’re doing a great job. It even automatically plays a Return Whistle to guide them back home!
Revolutionary Training
Learn Cesar Millan’s expert techniques to train your dog(s) to recognize boundaries. Cesar’s step-by-step instructions explain his world-renowned, proven methods that will give your dog the safest and most effective training experience anywhere—starting in your home before moving outside. Halo is your go-to pet parenting support that you can count on to give you peace of mind and an amazing relationship with your dog(s)
Real-Time Safety Statuses
No other collar does it all like Halo. Real-time safety statuses tell you whether your best friend is safe at a glance. And fast and accurate tracking via GPS & GNSS, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and cellular technology shows you what your pup is up to, even if you’re not around. 
Activity Tracking
Activity tracking logs your dog’s location, number of walks per day, and time spent active, resting, or in the car. Keep up with how much exercise your dog is getting every day so you can stay on top of their health goals. 
Please visit www.halocollar.com for more information about the Halo Collar. 
Recommended minimum OS version is iOS 16.

bluejetty:00085064:ios.description:
Your Doctors Online: 24/7 Care, No Wait
Skip the waiting room! Get instant access to doctors, prescriptions, and mental health support – anytime, anywhere.
Tired of waiting weeks for a doctor's appointment? Need a prescription refill at midnight? Your Doctors Online is your solution for fast, convenient, and personalized healthcare.
Here's what makes us different:
Instant Access, Zero Wait Time: Connect with board-certified physicians 24/7. No appointments needed, ever. Get the care you need, RIGHT NOW, from the comfort of your home.
Healthcare Made Easy: Need a prescription, sick note, or lab work? We've got you covered. Manage your health with just a few taps on your phone.
Live Longer, Live Better: Our doctors don't just treat illness—they help you PREVENT it. We'll analyze your health and provide personalized guidance to achieve your wellness goals, helping you live a longer, healthier life.
Mental Health, Your Way: Access mental health providers 24/7, easily switch providers until you find your perfect fit, and enjoy unlimited offline conversations for ongoing support. Your mental well-being is our top priority.
Family Sharing Plan: Easily share your subscription with family members. Ensure your entire family has convenient access to healthcare and mental health support under a single plan.
Your Doctors Online is perfect for:
Busy professionals who can't afford to miss work for appointments.
Families seeking convenient and affordable healthcare.
Individuals in remote areas with limited access to doctors.
Anyone prioritizing proactive health and a longer, healthier life.
Individuals seeking accessible, convenient mental health support, with the freedom to switch providers until they find the perfect fit.
Download the app today and experience healthcare on your terms!
Is our service secure?
Our foremost priority is to ensure your safety and security. We safeguard your data by encrypting it thoroughly, testing it frequently, using account security measures, and implementing other procedures and policies in line with the highest industry standards. Your medical history is only accessible by you and our medical team serving you.
Privacy Policy:
https://yourdoctors.online/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service:
https://yourdoctors.online/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00175549:ios.description:
Dominate the Wasteland! Survive the Zombie Apocalypse, race for your life, and crush those zombie monsters!
Join Steve Stempia, an audacious Italian-American survivor, as he battles hordes of zombies automatically in this thrilling game. Upgrade his stats, complete quests, and earn rewards. Spend your earnings to boost your survivor hero's power in this zombie-infested world!
TAP AND SLAY
Speed up the action by tapping your screen to trigger FEVER, increasing Steve's attack speed. The more you tap, the faster those zombies fall in this exciting game!
ARMORY OF DESTRUCTION
Equip your survivor hero with a range of weapons, from powerful bows to destructive guns. Use the secondary weapon system to switch weapons at any time. Collect weapon cards, upgrade your arsenal, and help Steve mow down zombies with ease.
TRAIN SURVIVORS
Train your survivors to unlock their full potential and abilities. Empower them to become the ultimate zombie slayers!
RECRUIT ALLIES
Survive with friends! Recruit melee and ranged allies, merge them for more power, and unlock new ally slots in the game.
SURVIVOR CAMP
Establish and manage your own Survivor Camp. Build and upgrade structures, and oversee the survivors who tirelessly work within its walls. Make your camp the ultimate hub in this game!
SURVIVOR EXPEDITIONS
Send your survivors on expeditions to explore the post-apocalyptic U.S. Unlock incredible rewards as they navigate the dangers of the wasteland.
CHALLENGING MISSIONS
Unlock and conquer challenging missions. Higher difficulties mean bigger rewards and non-stop excitement!
In "Survivor Idle Run: Z-RPG," it's not just about surviving the zombie apocalypse – it's about dominating it. Ready to join Steve and become the ultimate zombie survivor slayer in this thrilling game?
For more details, check out our privacy policy https://www.midnite.games/privacy
If you need assistance, feel free to contact us at https://support.midnite.games

bluejetty:00172131:ios.name: McClockface – Flip Clock
bluejetty:00172131:ios.summary:
Add beautiful timepiece widgets to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy mode with McClockface.
McClockface provides a collection of playful widget designs that provide the date, time, and other chronographic info, such as day and ann
bluejetty:00172131:ios.description:
Add beautiful timepiece widgets to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy mode with McClockface.
McClockface provides a collection of playful widget designs that provide the date, time, and other chronographic info, such as day and annual progress, at a glance, with options to customize colors and time zones widget-by-widget.
The in-app timepiece displays a silky-smooth retro flip clock that makes a perfect display for your nightstand or whilst charging your device.
There are currently 32 exclusive widget designs available (and counting) with different sizes to discover in the system widget gallery for Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy mode.
---
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
The McClockface widget lineup is now stronger than ever, with numerous vibrant, colorful designs to choose from, including stitched leather, knitted socks, sticky notes, neon signs, VHS cassette tapes, scratched metal, blueprints, metro maps, license plates, bunny memes, and so much more!
---
LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
Lock Screen widgets are perfect for quickly viewing info on the go. Simplified versions of some McClockface widgets are available on Lock Screen for both iPhone and iPad, including the default clock and the progress gauges. There’s also a weekday emoji widget that’s exclusive to Lock Screen.
---
STANDBY MODE WIDGETS
StandBy mode widgets are available on iPhone whilst charging your device. McClockface offers 20 elegant and customizable widget designs for StandBy mode.
---
INTERACTIVE WIDGETS
Stopwatch widgets are available for Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy mode. These super handy widgets allow you to time an event without the need to open an app or even unlock your device.
---
ALTERNATE APP ICONS
With over 15 colorful app icons available, there’s something here to make everyone’s Home Screen shine.
---
SOUNDS & HAPTICS
Funny animal sounds and subtle haptic effects help bring the app to life.
---
Some of the content discussed above and displayed in screenshots, specifically, all widgets, alternate app icons, custom fonts, and sound effects, require an in-app purchase.
The free version of McClockface is free forever, and contains no ads: The free version gives you unlimited access to the in-app flip clock. McClockface Plus is required for the additional content mentioned above, which can be accessed by either an auto-renewing subscription or a one-time in-app purchase.
---
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
---

▣ Doodle Something. Watch It Wiggle.
bluejetty:00115379:ios.description:
Disclaimer: JigglyPaint is a fork of WigglyPaint, the open-source (MIT) drawing tool made by Internet Janitor. We are not Internet Janitor. The original lives here: internet-janitor.itch.io/wigglypaint
▣ Doodle Something. Watch It Wiggle. Export the GIF. ▣
JigglyPaint is a drawing app where the lines refuse to sit still. Every stroke you put down starts squirming on its own, forever, whether you asked for it or not. It's like your drawings are vibing to invisible music.
It's fine. It's just like that. That's on purpose.
You draw. It wiggles. You export an animated GIF. That is the entire app. There is no tutorial, because there is nothing to learn. If you ever lost an afternoon to WigglyPaint in a browser tab, you already know how this ends. \(°Д°)/
▣ WHAT'S IN IT ▣
• THE WIGGLE ENGINE
Every line animates itself the moment you draw it. No timeline, no keyframes, no rigging, no weekend course. A dead doodle becomes a living, breathing, jiggly mess in exactly zero clicks. The line has made up its mind and it isn't really listening.
• THE INFINITE REGRET MACHINE
Otherwise known as undo and redo. Made a mistake? Go back in time. Regret going back in time? Go forward again. Nobody has ever reached the end of it. (っ-_-ς)
• UNLIMITED COLOURS
WigglyPaint ran on one small fixed palette. JigglyPaint hands over the whole spectrum, plus named palettes you can save and reuse. Pick any shade you can imagine, then deliberately pick a worse one.
• ANIMATED GIF EXPORT
Export your wiggly drawing as a clean, looping animated GIF. Straight into Photos, into Discord, into a group chat where nobody asked for it.
• 10,000+ DOODLERS IN ONE FEED
Browse wiggly art from people all over the world without leaving the app. Some of it is genuinely beautiful. Some of it is a cursed frog. Both count.
• A PILE OF BRUSHES
Dynamic brushes and tools that each wiggle in their own way. Half the fun is working out which one does the thing you had in mind.
• SHARE IN ONE TAP
Save the GIF, send the GIF, post the GIF. Nothing leaves your device unless you decide to send it.
▣ WHY PEOPLE KEEP JIGGLYPAINT INSTALLED ▣
+ NO ACCOUNT — Open it and draw. No email, no password, no "confirm you are a human"
+ NO ADS — Not one. Not even a tasteful one
+ WORKS OFFLINE — Planes, tunnels and long car rides are prime wiggling conditions
+ EASY ON PURPOSE — Nothing to learn, which is the entire point
+ FREE UPDATES — New tools land regularly and cost nothing
Chunky pixel styling, big buttons, and a canvas that behaves like a toy instead of a workstation. Serious art software exists elsewhere and we wish it well. (⊙_⊙)
▣ ABOUT THE ORIGINAL ▣
JigglyPaint is a fork of WigglyPaint, the open-source (MIT) drawing tool made by Internet Janitor. It was renamed with the author's consent and has been developed independently since, adding unlimited colours, undo and redo, animated GIF export and the in-app community.
WigglyPaint came first and it is still out there: internet-janitor.itch.io/wigglypaint. Go play that too. Everything good about the wiggle came from there. The bugs we added are ours.
▣ GO MAKE SOMETHING THAT MOVES ▣
Your canvas is empty and quietly judging you. Draw one bad line and it will start dancing anyway.
If JigglyPaint made you laugh even once, leave a review. It genuinely decides whether anybody else ever finds this thing. (；ω；)
Questions, bugs, or a drawing you are weirdly proud of? https://wigglypaint.io
▣ Make art wiggle. Make art move. Make art yours. ▣

bluejetty:00120888:ios.description:
● GAME CENTER -- Play online, chat, invite friends, auto-match with random players
 { Real-time } Play online in real-time
 { Turn-based } Play online at your own pace
● VERSATILE -- Play offline vs. computer or against another person in 2-player mode
● CUSTOMIZABLE -- More options than any other backgammon app
Play & learn backgammon at skill levels ranging from beginner to world-class!
Backgammon NJ is a full-featured game which uses an advanced, neural network-based, artificial intelligence. Play against a computer AI, another person in 2-player mode on one device, or online against friends & other players. Using Tutor Mode & Hints, Backgammon NJ can show you how to improve your game!
Discriminating players will appreciate how well the AI plays. It uses a neural network trained on millions of positions, a bearoff database, & a match equity table to achieve strong gameplay that will challenge even expert players.
REVIEWS
"[I] know strong bg play when I see it. This app is the strongest iPhone bg app I've played with by far. It does not cheat period. ...Analyzing these matches with eXtreme Gammon confirms a world class level of play with normal luck factors. If you are losing, get over it. So would 99.9% of the other backgammon players in the world. It is just that good. Learn from it." -Richard Munitz, Giant of Backgammon, #21 world ranking in 2009
"Backgammon NJ plays at an extremely high level with an excellent interface, and I often use it to practice on my iPhone when I am traveling. I recommend it highly to my students and friends." -Phil Simborg, Professional Backgammon Teacher and Player, www.mindgamescenter.com
"I've played over 500 games now; I've checked about 5% of these against World Class Desktop programs (GNU, BGBlitz); and I've actually used some of the competition. NJ has the best interface and has more useful functions than any other backgammon apps out there."
"For serious backgammon players, Backgammon NJ is the way to go." -Macworld.com, May 2012
IS THIS GAME RIGHT FOR YOU?
This game is best for people:
• Who recognize the strength of neural network backgammon bots
• Who want to improve their game by playing against a world-class level AI
• Who will use the in-depth, technical features included in the app to prove that it is honest (https://www.njsoftware.com/note.html)
• Who won't expect to win consistently on the higher skill levels
FEATURES
• Neural network-based AI
• 2 game types: Standard Backgammon or Nackgammon
• 4 skill levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert
• Customizable board design & checker colors
• Mersenne Twister algorithm for random number generation
• Doubling cube
• Single games or match play up to 25 points
• Crawford rule for match play
• 1-player mode vs. computer
• 2-player mode on one device
• Game Center: Play real-time or turn-based online matches with friends & other players
• Chat with your online opponent
• Online Elo & Experience leaderboards
• Block list for auto-match
• User-friendly, tap-to-move interface
• Highlighted checker movement options
• Hint & Undo
• Learn with Status Meter & Tutor Mode
• Game & dice stats, including Elo rating & ER
• Match info: GnuBG ID, win chances, equity, top 10 moves, & cube decisions
• Email match files
• Practice mode with unlimited undo (1-player vs. computer)
• Manual match recording mode with unlimited undo & speed mode option
• Options to reverse board direction, resign, use one-tap moves, auto bearoff, auto finish, use Jacoby rule, & much more
• Match analysis (in-app purchase): Analyze past match files, view moves & errors for match, step through match, jump to position, play from position, save match files permanently
IMPORTANT
• If an online match ends for any reason, you'll receive the Elo pts you deserve. FAQ: https://gamecenter.njsoftware.com
• Contact us for help: https://contact.njsoftware.com

Ready to take control of your work hours and boost productivity?
Meet Work Hours Tracker: Timesheet—the ultimate app for accurately logging your hours, pay, and overtime. Whether you punch in for an hourly job, track multiple shifts, or just need a handy timecard solution, we’ve got you covered.
Effortless Tracking & Scheduling
- Precision Timers: Track your hours down to the second—no more guessing how much overtime you’ve racked up.
- Smart Pause & Resume: Clock in, pause for a break, then clock back in with a tap. Perfect for lunch breaks, quick errands, or unexpected interruptions.
 Flexible Worklog & Scheduling: Update your schedule or shift details anytime, anywhere. Great for freelancers, gig workers, or anyone juggling multiple jobs.
Overtime, Payroll & More:
- Overtime Calculation: Keep tabs on extra hours effortlessly—know when you hit your limit.
- Payroll Insights: Track how much you’re earning on each shift for accurate paychecks.
- Timecard Organization: Everything in one place—no more paper timesheets or scattered spreadsheets.
Visualize Your Progress:
- Daily, Weekly, or Monthly View: Quickly see your total hours, pay, or overtime to plan ahead.
- Detailed Worklog: Filter by job or shift to get a clear overview of your productivity and earnings.
- Custom Notifications: Set reminders so you’ll never forget to punch in, clock out, or review timesheets.
Why You’ll Love It:
- User-Friendly Interface: No steep learning curve—jump right in and start tracking.
- Built for Everyone: Ideal for hourly employees, contractors, freelancers, and business owners.
- Cut the Stress: Automatic calculations mean fewer mistakes and more peace of mind.
Who Benefits?
- Hourly Employees wanting accurate timesheets for payroll.
- Shift Workers balancing multiple schedules or variable hours.
- Freelancers & Contractors needing a reliable job tracker to bill clients accurately.
- Managers & Entrepreneurs eager to streamline team schedules and track labor costs.
Breaks, Pauses & Beyond:
Life doesn’t stop just because you’re on the clock. Incorporate breaks, lunch pauses, or quick off-the-job tasks into your daily timesheet with ease.
Stay Organized, Stay Efficient:
- Integrated Worklog & Schedule: Manage multiple shifts, jobs, or timecard entries without hassle.
- Fast Editing: Need to fix a late punch or adjust a clock-out time? Do it instantly—no complicated steps.
- Personalized Notes: Add memos about each shift or task. Perfect for tracking tips, project details, or other important info.
Ready to Simplify Your Workday?
Work Hours Tracker: Timesheet makes sure you never lose track of valuable hours again. With the calculator-like precision of our timers and the convenience of on-the-go scheduling, it’s your all-in-one solution.
Download now to see why so many people are making the switch from outdated spreadsheets to a modern, streamlined approach. Start managing your shifts, pay, overtime, and schedule effortlessly—every day.

bluejetty:00046863:ios.name: AI Translator: AI Lissa
bluejetty:00046863:ios.summary: Ai Lissa is your all-in-one AI language assistant that ensures seamless communication and translation across languages. Whether you're traveling, learning a new language, or conducting business negotiations, Ai Lissa will make your communic
bluejetty:00046863:ios.description:
Ai Lissa is your all-in-one AI language assistant that ensures seamless communication and translation across languages. Whether you're traveling, learning a new language, or conducting business negotiations, Ai Lissa will make your communication faster and easier.
With Ai Lissa, you can:
Instant Text Translation – translate text anywhere, anytime, even offline. It works just like Google Translate, but with more flexibility.
Image Text Translation – simply take a photo of any text, and Ai Lissa will automatically detect the language and translate it. Perfect for signs, menus, or documents in foreign languages.
Voice-to-Voice Translation – speak in your own language, and Ai Lissa will instantly translate your words for your conversation partner. Ideal for communicating with people who speak a different language.
Interpreter Mode – put on your headphones, and Ai Lissa will translate everything you hear in real time. Perfect for meetings, conferences, or travel when instant translation is needed.
Custom Keyboard – use the built-in keyboard to translate any text you type in any app with just one tap (requires an internet connection, but offline mode is coming soon).
Ai Speaker – practice and improve your language skills by chatting with Ai Lissa, which will correct your mistakes and help you speak fluently. It’s the perfect tool for language learners.
Real-Time Call Translation – make calls anywhere in the world, and Ai Lissa will translate the conversation in real time. Everything your conversation partner says will be instantly translated both to text and voice. You can also read the translation if you prefer, rather than listening to the spoken translation.
Key Features:
Offline Mode – text and speech translations are available even without an internet connection, making Ai Lissa a great choice for travel or areas with poor internet access.
Instant Translations – quickly translate conversations, messages, or photos, making the app convenient to use in any situation.
Convenient Communication – with real-time call and dialogue translation, Ai Lissa helps you communicate easily with people who speak different languages without barriers.
Multi-Language Support – support for many languages, including English, Spanish, French, Chinese, and many more, provides you with tools for communicating with people worldwide.
Ai Lissa is more than just a translator. It's your personal language assistant that helps you communicate, learn, and work in any language, in real time.
The app offers paid subscriptions that can be cancelled at any time through your account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v-x8R901MhRDDB2-QD07xp3KpjpezfpbIRd7OO02So8/edit?tab=t.0
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00165510:ios.description:
StoryWizard: The Magic of Personalized Reading
Welcome to StoryWizard, where kids get to CREATE their own stories, STAR in the adventure, and LEARN while having fun! Parents around the globe are calling it a must-have app for encouraging creativity and improving reading skills.
-MAKE YOUR CHILD THE HERO
Every story is personalized to feature your child’s name, favorite settings, and unique interests. Whether they dream of battling dragons or exploring the stars, StoryWizard helps them become the hero of their own adventure.
-UNLIMITED STORIES
Why pay for individual books when you can create endless tales? With StoryWizard, you can generate unlimited custom stories for less than the cost of a single printed book.
-INSPIRE A LOVE FOR READING
StoryWizard’s customizable stories make reading exciting, relatable, and fun. Designed for all reading levels, it builds confidence and encourages daily reading habits.
-INTERACTIVE & EDUCATIONAL
Animated features and creative prompts keep kids engaged while enhancing vocabulary, comprehension, and storytelling skills.
-EASY TO USE
Crafting a personalized story takes just a few taps. Pick a character, choose a setting, and let your child’s imagination take over!
HOW STORYWIZARD WORKS:
1. Select a theme: bedtime stories, fairy tales, or action-packed adventures.
2. Add your character's name and customize the plot.
3. Read together or let your child explore independently with interactive animations.
WHY PARENTS LOVE STORYWIZARD:
“My kids are obsessed! They can’t wait to read because THEY are the main character.”
“It’s such a creative and budget-friendly way to make story time special.”
“StoryWizard is so easy to use, and it’s helping my son learn to read and makes bedtime calm for my kids!”
PERFECT FOR ANY OCCASION
From calming bedtime stories to epic quests, StoryWizard keeps things fresh. It’s great for regular reading time, birthdays, or special surprises.
THE ULTIMATE STORYTELLER APP
StoryWizard combines the innovation of AI with the charm of classic storybooks. It’s a global favorite for creating personalized, engaging, and educational stories.
-Turn story time into a magical adventure your family will treasure.
-Help your child discover the joy of storytelling and reading.
-Start your unlimited storytelling journey today with StoryWizard!
Transform screen time into something meaningful and memorable. Download StoryWizard now and create stories your child will never forget!

You and me have all been there: There’s this one job you have in the back of your mind, but updating your resume, opening the word processing software and manually editing every single line of your resume takes hours and after your long day at work, you think of finally doing it the next weekend. Plus, you’re not sure if your old resume template design is still appropriate for the job market in 2020. 
FIRST, tap yourself on the shoulders for grabbing the opportunity and realising that your success is in your hands. Why don’t you just apply right now?
At Yoi, we know how busy you are in everyday life, so we’ve made it easy for you to create a tailored CV and cover letter within seconds, so you can apply right NOW, whether you are in your lunch break or at your dinner table.
With numerous templates and a system, that provides different compelling wordings for your cover letter for you to choose from, we want YOU to succeed and get that dream job that you deserve. Take action now and let us know if our app helped you to land the job, we always love to hear success stories!
Yoi uses optional subscriptions, but also offers free, high quality resume and cover letter templates. You can choose between the monthly access and yearly access to Yoi Premium, which guarantees you access to all premium cover letter and resume templates.
Depending on your type of subscription (monthly or yearly), a purchase will be applied to your iTunes account at the end of the trial.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
For more information, see our Terms of Use/Service: https://mueaistylist.com/yoi-terms-of-use/
 and Privacy Policy: https://mueaistylist.com/yoi-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00180614:ios.description:
***Best call recorder app - over 15 million installs around the world.*** 
Call Recorder allows you to record your telephone calls. 
Are you tired of complicated call recording apps that require you to set up conference calls and come with expensive subscription plans?
Call Recorder - IntCall is here to make your life simpler. 
The app uses VOIP and lets you record your phone conversations without the need for conference calls, and you only pay for what you use, with no renewable subscription or hidden fees.
Key Features:
- You can use Call Recorder to make and record national or international calls.
- No More Confusing Setup: You can record your calls with just one tap. There's no need to set up tricky conference calls or mess with complicated settings.
- Pay As You Go: With this app, you only pay when you actually use it. No monthly subscriptions, no renewals, and no surprise charges.
- Privacy and Security: All of your calls are recorded on your device only there is no copy of the recordings anywhere but your phone.
The entire call is recorded and saved on your phone.
Your recorded calls can be: 
 - Played on the phone. 
 - Sent via email. 
 - Transferred to your computer with iTunes File Sharing.
 - Exported to DropBox, Google Drive and more.
 - Shared with WhatsApp, Telegram and more.
 - You can also set a title for each recording. 
Call Recorder is a simple, affordable, and reliable solution. Record your calls easily, without any hassle, and with complete transparency. 
Try it out and take control of your conversations today. 
Limitations:
- Before using the application you must ensure that the recording of conversations is legal in your country. Telestar LTD is not responsible for your use of the application.
- You need to be connected to the internet and your internet provider must support VOIP (Voice Over IP) 
Privacy and terms:
+ Your recordings (incoming calls only) may me saved for a short time on the app’s server until downloaded to your phone.
+ See our privacy statement at:

+ See our terms here:

bluejetty:00170514:ios.summary:
Zigzag Puppy Training is the perfect app for dog training beginners! Backed by science and loved by trainers, it guides you through the ups and downs of puppyhood, ensuring it’s a fun and stress-free journey all the way. 
• Created by dog
bluejetty:00170514:ios.description:
Zigzag Puppy Training is the perfect app for dog training beginners! Backed by science and loved by trainers, it guides you through the ups and downs of puppyhood, ensuring it’s a fun and stress-free journey all the way. 
• Created by dog training experts
• Personalised puppy training programme by age and breed
• Over 250 puppy training lessons with ‘how-to’ videos
• Message our training coaches anytime for advice
• Over 1M puppies trained through Zigzag
WHAT MAKES THE ZIGZAG PUPPY TRAINING APP UNIQUE
We’re the only app dedicated to puppyhood. Reality can hit new owners pretty quickly when raising a puppy turns out differently than expected. With Zigzag, you’ll explore the wonderful journey of puppy training through building a strong bond together. Our puppy training program is created by professional dog trainers who share their expert advice in an easy, accessible format you can trust.
WHAT PUPPY TRAINING DOES ZIGZAG COVER?
Prepare to be pleasantly surprised when learning how to train your new pup. Zigzag breaks down the life skills your dog will need to live happily in the world:
• Basic commands 
• Sleep and crate training
• Potty training
• Leash pulling and walking
• Socialization
• Puppy care and grooming
• Prevent problem behaviors e.g., aggression, barking, biting & more
• Feeding your puppy
• Tricks and games as we’re fun too!
Start your Zigzag puppy training journey and get access to:
250+ PUPPY TRAINING LESSONS WITH ‘HOW-TO’ VIDEOS
For a new puppy, the world is simply too interesting with so much to learn! Zigzag has over 250 lessons ranging from basics such as sit, down and recall to more advanced training like being alone, crate training, and socialization.
24/7 Expert Dog Trainer Advice
Yes, training a puppy can be tricky, but the Zigzag puppy training app provides 24/7 live-chat with our experts who are happy to help and support you with questions, big or small.
Tailored Pup Training Program
Share a few details about your puppy, and you’ll get a fully tailored puppy training program with 3 fun daily lessons to train your dog in the most important skills.
Puppy Guidance
Zigzag is the only puppy training app that focuses on puppyhood, which means we’re here for the entire ride of getting a new puppy. You’ll have access to articles brimming with useful tips you’ll find handy; from the right teething toys to your first vacation together.
Puppy Nutrition
Get tailored feeding advice, tips, and offers in Nourish. Find the perfect food based on your pup's breed and age - helping them stay healthy as they grow older.
Puppy Parent Community
You’re not alone in your puppy training journey! Join the community and connect with Zigzag users and our puppy coaches. Ask for advice, share your pup’s progress, and hear about others’ couches being chewed on. It will make you feel better.
See what Zigzag users say:
"I love this app and the support you get. First time having a puppy and it helps us understand his behavior, what he means to do and how we can train to what we expect from him as he matures. Just love it! Thank you so much for the help and support"
"I have a black lab/Great Pyrenees mix that keeps me on my toes! The app is so helpful with covering the basics and the ability to chat with a puppy expert 24/7 makes it more than worth the small price that they charge! The trainers are so knowledgeable and happy to help with whatever I need!"
Access free pup training learning content with Zigzag and see why Zigzag is loved by puppy parents everywhere.
Subscription Plans
If you like Zigzag. Try Zigzag Premium free for 7 days - cancel anytime! Get 24/7 access to our expert training coaches, unlimited lessons, and ask our AI anything - no question is too big or small.

bluejetty:00014961:ios.description:
Take your aphasia therapy to the next level with four evidence-based advanced apps that build on the skills established the best-selling Language Therapy 4-in-1 app. This free sample of the new value-priced advanced app lets you try four popular speech therapy apps to help you improve. 
YOU'LL GET TO TRY THESE 4 APPS:
-----
1) ADVANCED COMPREHENSION THERAPY
Practice understanding sentences with three activities to improve listening and reading skills. 
-------
2) ADVANCED NAMING THERAPY
Practice word-finding skills with four activities to improve verbal expression.
-------
3) ADVANCED READING THERAPY
Practice reading at the paragraph-level with three levels of difficulty with comprehension questions and audio support.
-------
4) ADVANCED WRITING THERAPY
Practice typing at the word, sentence, and paragraph levels along with strengthening sound-letter relationships.
-----
WHO IS THIS APP FOR?
*Stroke survivors with mild or moderate aphasia (impaired language)
*Brain injury survivors with high-level cognitive-communication impairments
*Speech-language pathologists (SLPs) who work with adult communication
TRY FOR FREE!
Download Advanced Language Therapy Lite to try each of the four apps for free. Then purchase all four in Advanced Language Therapy, or purchase only the ones you need separately. 
THE TACTUS THERAPY DIFFERENCE
In all Tactus Therapy apps for speech therapy, you'll get wifi-free use, no log-ins, and no subscriptions. The activities are based on researched techniques that work. The content is designed with adults in mind, yet can easily be used with older children and teens. Support is built-in to encourage independent use for home practice while being flexible for in-clinic use with a qualified clinician.
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? We offer a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at tactustherapy.com/find

Welcome to the Gotogate app!
Our app puts the world in the palm of your hand. Fast, simple, safe and secure–instantly access your booking details and experience real-time updates and notifications so you never miss a flight again. Easily update your booking with baggage and other services from our pre-travel store. Get access to exclusive offers like early check-in for free (a €15 value), plus save up to 70% on flights, hotels rental cars and so much more!
What are you waiting for? Download now and let’s get travelling!  
FREE EARLY CHECK-IN
- Exclusively for our app users, passengers can now check-in for their flight, months in advance – for free! Let us do the hard work for you and we’ll send your boarding card directly to your mobile device. 
BOOKING INFO AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
- Multiple bookings? No problem! All your bookings in one place–no need to head to the airline’s website or download their apps

- Search and compare more than 650 airlines, big and small, to find the best deal there is.
- Flexible booking options – we get it, changes happen! Choose our Flexible Ticket option and change your flight when you need to.
AVAILABLE FOR A WIDE SELECTION OF BRANDS
- Get your booking info for many popular booking platforms including Gotogate, Supersaver, Supersavertravel, Flybillet, Travelstart, Travelfinder, Goleif, Travelpartner, Seat24, Flygvaruhuset, Avion, Budjet, Trip, Mytrip, Pamediakopes, Airtickets24, Flight Network and FlyFar.
ADD SERVICES ON THE FLY
- Already booked? Travel just the way you want by adding baggage, choosing your seat and more from our pre-travel store. 
PAY YOUR WAY
- Choose from a number of payment options available throughout the world.
FIND AND BOOK GREAT HOTELS
- The best places, the best prices – with more than 300,000 hotels to choose from, there’s something for everyone.
CHEAP CAR RENTAL ANYWHERE AND ANYTIME
- Search and find great deals on rental cars. Take the scenic route and explore your destination at your leisure.

bluejetty:00145636:ios.description:
G-CPU Info empowers you to unlock a wealth of information about your mobile device or tablet, offering unparalleled insight into its performance and functionality. This sophisticated yet user-friendly application caters to both tech enthusiasts and everyday users alike, providing a clear and concise window into the inner workings of your device.
Dive into a World of Data:
Comprehensive Dashboard: Gain an instant overview of crucial metrics like RAM usage, storage capacity, battery health, CPU load, and network connectivity.
Detailed Device Information: Uncover the unique identity of your device, including its model, manufacturer, hardware specifications, and operating system details.
In-Depth System Analysis: Explore the heart of your device's software, examining its operating system version, kernel information, boot time, and support updates.
Powerful CPU Insights: Delve into the core of your device, discovering its processor architecture, clock speed, number of cores, and integrated graphics capabilities.
Battery Health Monitoring: Ensure optimal battery performance with detailed health assessments, including level, status, technology, and temperature readings.
Network Connection Clarity: Demystify your network connection by viewing your IP address, gateway, subnet mask, DNS servers, and real-time data transfer speeds.
Crisp Display Details: Understand your device's display capabilities, including its resolution, pixel density, supported refresh rates, and current brightness level.
Memorable Storage Breakdown: Gain control over your storage utilization with comprehensive breakdowns of RAM and internal/external storage specifications.
Essential Sensor Diagnostics: Verify the functionality of your device's built-in sensors, including the accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, and proximity sensor.
Benchmarking Suite: Push your device to the limit with a suite of performance tests, helping you identify areas for optimization.
Camera Feature Exploration: Discover the full potential of your device's camera, exploring its supported features and capabilities.
Customizable Reports: Generate comprehensive reports in both text and PDF formats, allowing you to share key findings or track your device's performance over time.
Convenient Widget Support: Stay informed at a glance with customizable widgets for the Control Center, memory usage, battery level, network connectivity, and storage space.
Built-in Compass: Navigate with ease thanks to the integrated compass functionality.
Experience the G-CPU Info Difference:
Accurate and Reliable: Trust the app's detailed information and precise measurements.
User-Friendly Design: Navigate intuitively with a clean and well-organized interface.
Privacy-Focused: Rest assured that your data remains secure and private.
Regular Updates: Enjoy continuous improvements and new features with frequent updates.
Download G-CPU Info today and unlock the secrets of your mobile device!
Contact:
For any questions or feedback, please feel free to reach out to us by email at joseph.hauvudinh.vietnam@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00180729:ios.description:
Your Global Weather Companion Across Every Horizon ArabiaWeather delivers precision beyond borders—accurate forecasts for the Arab world and every corner of the globe. Available in Arabic and English, we empower you to master your day, whether you're facing rain, snow, storms, or hurricanes. From personalized clothing recommendations to activity planning, our app transforms weather uncertainty into confident living. Connect with our Raseed community, explore nature, share your weather experiences in the past and present, and even predict tomorrow all within a single, powerful application.
Weather intelligence at your fingertips with hyperlocal and global insights, ArabiaWeather provides hourly forecasts and personalized lifestyle recommendations. Stay informed, prepared, and ahead—wherever you are.
Weather Forecasts
Precision Weather Forecasting: Your Day, Decoded
Navigate life with confidence through our comprehensive daily and hourly weather intelligence. From dawn to dusk, get a complete atmospheric snapshot including precise temperature readings, "feels like" conditions, humidity levels, wind dynamics, and rain probability. Plan your day with certainty, whether you're preparing for work, leisure, or adventure—ArabiaWeather puts the power of prediction in your hands.
Satellite Vision
Dive into visual forecasting that goes beyond traditional predictions. Trace and detect emerging fog banks, dust storms, and monitor cloud top temperatures. With our satellite technology, you're not just watching the weather; you're anticipating its every move, staying perpetually one step ahead of nature's unpredictable choreography.
WIDGETS
Small but mighty, our widgets transform your home screen into a powerful meteorological dashboard. With a single glance, stay ahead of weather intelligence that keeps you informed, prepared, and one step ahead of whatever the sky has planned.
Raseed: Your Weather Community, Your Meteorological Voice
Transform from a weather observer to a citizen scientist with Raseed, ArabiaWeather's interactive community platform. Share captivating stories, stunning images, and insightful voice notes about local weather phenomena, historical climate patterns, and your own weather predictions. Become more than just a user—become a passionate weather forecaster, connecting with like-minded enthusiasts and contributing to a global network of atmospheric storytellers. Your observations matter, your insights count, and your weather journey starts here.
Lifestyle: Your Personalized Weather Guide
Activities: Plan your day with weather-smart activity suggestions. ArabiaWeather turns unpredictable conditions into opportunities, helping you choose activities that align with the forecast.
Health: Stay ahead of health risks like headaches, allergies, or colds with predictive alerts. Protect yourself and your loved ones through proactive weather-driven insights.
Clothing: Get personalized outfit recommendations for every temperature change. Whether it’s a sunny day or a chilly evening, dress comfortably and confidently with ArabiaWeather.
And a lot more features made for you:
Sunrise and Sunset Times
Prayer Times
Weather Summary

Language Arabic or English as you prefer
Search any location you want and if you don't find it you can just ask for it

• 14-day weather forecasts

• 6-month long-term forecasts
• Seasonal text forecasts

• 14 days of clothes recommendation

• No ads

bluejetty:00148412:ios.description:
When Amy’s boyfriend betrays her, she’s left heartbroken and seeking a fresh start. Determined to rebuild her life, Amy accepts a position as the assistant to the enigmatic billionaire, Sebastian Davis. Unexpectedly, Sebastian proposes a mysterious marriage contract. Reluctantly, Amy agrees, plunging her into an intriguing journey of love and transformation.
A Romance Shrouded in Mystery 
As Amy and Sebastian navigate their unexpected arrangement, sparks begin to fly. But what secrets lie beneath Sebastian’s composed exterior? Each interaction deepens their connection, yet questions remain unanswered. Why did Sebastian choose this unconventional path? What hidden motives drive his proposal? The answers unfold as you guide Amy through each level.
Fashion, Makeover & Dressup Adventures 
Beat the levels to collect resources that help Amy transform her style for every occasion. From sophisticated business meetings to dazzling parties, ensure Amy is always dressed to impress. Customize her wardrobe with a vast selection of fashionable clothing, trendy accessories, and stunning makeup options. Each makeover not only enhances Amy’s appearance but also brings her closer to uncovering the truth behind Sebastian’s intentions.
Uncover Hidden Secrets 
Delve into the mysterious reasons behind the marriage. Solve puzzles to find clues and reveal hidden aspects of Amy and Sebastian’s lives. Every transformation and dressup challenge brings you closer to understanding the enigmatic bond they share.
Immerse Yourself in a Stylish Love Story 
Experience beautifully crafted graphics and elegant designs that bring Amy’s journey to life. Each level offers new opportunities to transform Amy, solve engaging puzzles, and explore the evolving relationship between her and Sebastian.
Begin Amy’s Journey Today 
Join Amy as she navigates love, mystery, and stylish transformations. Download House of Secrets now and embark on a romantic adventure filled with makeovers, dressup challenges, and captivating secrets that will keep you entertained for hours!

Welcome to SKIDOS!
With our unique learning games, make learning fun for your 2-11-year-olds. SKIDOS games help kids practice math skills & develop an interest in coding. You can get a new SKIDOS Pass or log in with an existing one from within this app. All SKIDOS Passes are auto-renewable with monthly, quarterly, bi-annual & annual Passes for up to six kids. With one SKIDOS Pass, you can add up to 6 profiles. Each profile can be customized according to the grade (Preschool, Kindergarten, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th grade) & the learning style of your kids.
____
ANIMAL GAME
SKIDOS Animal Game is a fun learning app for the smallest kids. 12 mini-games will help your child discover an amusing world around us - play with cute animals, explore the woods, watch how the seasons change and how days turn into nights. 
Like in all the SKIDOS educational games, your toddler will also learn numbers, counting & solve logical thinking tasks whilst playing. 
With SKIDOS Animal game, your child can engage in such activities:
• Explore the woods with cute animals - pony, caterpillar, fox
• Feed your new friends 
• Find out how to tell time with a magical Bear Clock
• Learn numbers, solve simple counting & logical thinking tasks
• Experience different seasons of the year
• Solve puzzles
• Arrange stars in constellations in the night sky
• Water your plants and see how fruit grow on trees
• Drive a cool truck with a fox
_____
DEAR PARENTS & TEACHERS,
Get Your SKIDOS Pass to all of our apps! Our apps are primarily designed as super fun games that children LOVE playing. We then integrate interactive learning content into them to make it a seamless & enjoyable experience for kids all over the globe.
ENCOURAGE YOUR KIDS TO LEARN MATH & CODING 
All SKIDOS games turn classroom lessons into fun challenges, especially for kids in the 1st,2nd,3rd,4th,5th grades. In this updated version, we added more interactive ways for your kids to strengthen their math skills! Our math problems are now more visual & dynamic, for an engaging & fun experience.
40+ GAMES WITH A SINGLE SKIDOS PASS 
Why pay for each game individually when you can get all of them at once! 40+ games included in one SKIDOS Pass. Get game recommendations from within the app & track progress across all of our games in a single dashboard.
CUSTOMIZED LEARNING & PRACTICE 
Kids have different learning styles. All SKIDOS games give children the option to pick subjects (math or coding), grade (1st,2nd,3rd,4th,5th grade) & topic, & progress with problem-solving.
START CRACKING CODING & LOVING MATH
All learning content in SKIDOS games is aligned to the Common Core State Standards for Mathematics and covers a comprehensive list of topics including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, decimals, geometry, and more!
For kids who are interested in coding, SKIDOS has developed a unique curriculum that teaches them concepts around basic programming & computational thinking.
All SKIDOS games are COPPA & GDPR compliant & have no third-party advertising.
Get your SKIDOS Pass today! 
- SKIDOS has monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, & annual Passes. 
- Add up to six kids, play 40+ games with one SKIDOS Pass!
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account after any free trial period if applicable. 
- Passes renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The SKIDOS Pass may be managed by the user & any auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings.
- Cancellation will not go into effect until the end of the billing cycle.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a Pass, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
For support, write to us at support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00127409:ios.description:
Ready for your citizenship test? Study for the Canadian citizenship test in 2026 with the official study guide and actual test questions. Learn about Canada's history, values, government and symbols with 80+ interactive lessons, quizzes and tests. 
THE OFFICIAL STUDY GUIDE
All the app's material is based on Discover Canada: The Rights and Responsibilities of Citizenship. Practice with the province-specific questions that you will be asked on the citizenship test. Get full explanations for every question.
80 LESSONS, 600+ QUESTIONS, 30+ TESTS
Access all the practice you'll need to pass the test. Study chapter by chapter, and try over 600 questions at the end of the lessons. Time-limited tests help you test your knowledge with the 30-minute time limit of the actual test. Get feedback on your correct and incorrect answers.
FULL WORD GLOSSARY
Don't know the meaning of a word? No worries! Access to a full content-focused dictionary and improve your vocabulary while studying for your citizenship test.
LISTEN TO THE LESSONS
Use the audio-enabled lessons and easily follow each paragraph, word by word with better concentration. 
TRACK TEST & STUDY PROGRESS
Keep track of your progress through the chapters and lessons. Keep track of your test scores and average time. Easily pick up where you left off with the Continue Studying shortcut.
FULL OFFLINE MODE
Study on the go! Use the app wherever you go without an internet connection, and still access all the lessons, quizzes and tests.
OTHER FEATURES: 
- Province-Specific Content
- Feedback on All Correct and Incorrect Answers
- Customizable Study Reminders
- Dark Mode Support (with automatic switch)
- Countdown to Your Test Date
- Listen To Glossary Words Pronunciations
- - - - - - - - - - - - 
Disclaimer: This app is NOT affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Canada or Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC). This independent app is for educational purposes only.
Feedback on the app, the content, or the questions? We always would love to hear back from you! You can reach us at hello@citizenshipapp.ca.
Love the app?
Please take a moment to leave a review and let us know what you think. Also, don't forget to follow us on Instagram @canadiancitizenship. 
Proudly made in Toronto, Ontario.

Create Your Own Song with the Power of AI!
AI Song Generator makes it easy to turn your ideas into music - no instruments, no studio, no experience needed. Just enter your lyrics (or let our smart lyric generator inspire you), pick a style, and let AI bring your song to life in seconds. • Write your own lyrics or use our built-in lyric generator.

• Tap “Generate” and get your unique, AI-created track in moments.
• Save your songs or share them instantly with friends.

Create personalized songs for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, or just for fun. Surprise a loved one with a heartfelt track, or make something playful to share with your friends.
For Everyone
Whether you’re an aspiring songwriter, a music lover looking for inspiration, or someone who just wants to have fun, AI Song Generator gives you a simple way to unleash your creativity.
Start creating today — download now and make your first AI-powered song!
