If you are not an existing NMB Bank customer, you can open a savings account by visiting your nearest branch and then
bluejetty:00021716:ios.description:
NMB Bank’s new Mobile Banking App is called eNMB, it provides banking on the go for all existing retail banking customers.
If you are not an existing NMB Bank customer, you can open a savings account by visiting your nearest branch and then experience banking through our new application.
If you are an existing NMB bank customer, you can download the application follow the simple one-time activation process, and experience the new digital experience.
The new application is the first step towards the digital journey started by NMB Bank, the users can experience 
• Self services:
 - Self application activation for NMB Bank retail banking customers.
 - PIN reset.
 - Navigate to branches.
 - Navigate to ATM.
 - Contact support.
 - Change PIN.
 - FAQ
• Banking on the go services:
 - View Accounts.
 - View FD.
 - View Loans.
 - Inter Bank Fund Transfer.
 - Intra Bank Fund Transfer.
 - Schedule Transfer.
 - Add Payee
 - Direct Transfer to Payee.
 - Create FD.
 - Email TDS.
 - Download & Email Statement
• Services:
 - Stop check.
 - Occupation change.
 - Update marital status.
 - Update VAT/PAN.
 - Update the purpose of A/C.
 - Update the source of funds for A/C.
 - Update change in anticipated transactions to A/C.
 - Update number per year for the A/C.
 - Update temporary address
• Pay Your Bills:
 - Pay school fees.
 - Pay water bill.
 - Pay electricity bill.
 - Topup
Get started:
To get started with eNMB, you just need your Customer Information File Number (CIF), In case you do not know your CIF number the application provides the option to fetch this number, you can follow the instructions.
The app will take you through a one-time activation process when you download the mobile application and start the activation.
eNMB App requires the following permissions:
 - Location: This is required for locating and navigating to the branches and ATM.
 - Photos / Media / Files / Camera: This is required to let you access the gallery / click an image to set a profile picture.
Please note that your data is safe with NMB Bank. We do not share any information with the third party without your initiation.
We never call you asking for your PIN, CIF, or Account numbers, please avoid giving such information to callers on the phone, email, or any other media for the security of your account.

bluejetty:00179679:ios.description:
Sleepy monsters have been sleeping for centuries! All of the sudden, they were woken-up by scary dragons which came to take what has been theirs for ever, their land and their caves!
Merge Monsters is a world of heroic monsters which you can capture, evolve and battle against scary enemies! Involve yourself in this incredible heroic dragons catching game where you can defeat your enemies and reveal the ancient story of lost Godzilla brothers. Wake-up the sleeping dragons and unite them together!
Merge Monster's merge-style game is great because while you are out of play, monsters are fighting and earning you money which you can use when you come back in the game! 
Merge Monster is super easy to play, just merge monsters of the same kind, evolve them to higher rank, discover new monsters, make army of your top dragons and win against enemy creatures.
DISCOVER - Who is the next monster in my troops? Merge them and climb the ranks with upgrades such as increasing your spawn speed, chance of earning gem whilst merging, double spawn, spawn boost, spawn level, etc.
RELAX - Play when you want to ease your mind or when you are commuting or just need to kill time, join us. We promise you good vibes only and awesome new monsters waiting to be discovered.
BATTLE - Tap, tap, tap! Fast! Battle your army of monsters against Dragons Bosses every tenth level. Level's are coming up fast, so be ready for a battle every few minutes.
MERGE & EVOLVE - Experience evolution of the dragons where each dragon has three stages and then they evolve to higher, more powerful rank! Also, don't forget to form your squadron of The Legends which will help you fighting scary dragons.
EASY TO LEARN - Very similar to puzzles game where you combine two of the same and make merge magic while you collect and discover new monsters!
PLAY WHILE OFFLINE - Merge Monsters will still be running in the background and collecting coins until you come back!
UPGRADES - Enjoy the upgrades such as Auto Merge function where monsters merge automatically while you can sort other things in the game!
There is always something which comes up on the board so be careful to watch for power-ups and upgrades to be ready to Fight the Dragons Bosses!
— Are you ready to catch them all? Wait no more, Merge Monsters awaits! —

bluejetty:00186186:ios.description:
Find the right German phrase. Hear it spoken. Keep it ready offline.
SpeakEasy German is a phrasebook for English speakers, with recorded native-speaker audio, pronunciation guides, and flashcards. Prepare for Germany, Austria, and other German-speaking destinations with useful words and phrases for eating out, getting around, checking in, and meeting people.
HEAR HOW TO SAY IT
Every phrasebook entry pairs the German text with an easy-to-read pronunciation guide and a native-speaker recording. Tap to listen, or press and hold to hear the recording more slowly.
KEEP YOUR PHRASEBOOK WITH YOU
The bundled phrases and their recordings work offline. Browse by category, search for a word or phrase, and save useful entries to Favorites for quick access.
PRACTICE WITH FLASHCARDS
Review phrases by category, or practice your Favorites. Read the English, flip the card to see the German and pronunciation guide, and tap to hear the recording.
TRANSLATE SOMETHING NEW
Use the built-in text translator for words and sentences outside the phrasebook. Translation depends on language support and may require an internet connection to download language data. Phrasebook recordings remain available offline.
START FREE, UNLOCK MORE
Try six free phrasebook categories: Greetings, Basic Phrases, Railway Trains, Travel Essentials, Days, and Numbers. The Complete Edition unlocks all phrasebook categories, all flashcard categories, and unlimited use of the built-in translator. The full phrasebook contains over 1,700 words and phrases. Additional content and unlimited translation require an in-app purchase.
MADE FOR EVERYDAY USE
• Native-speaker recordings and slow playback
• English-friendly pronunciation guides
• Category browsing, search, and Favorites
• Flashcards for self-paced practice
• Built-in text translation with a free daily allowance
• Light and dark appearance
• US, UK, and Canadian English spelling
• Works on iPhone and iPad
Terms of Service:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00119785:ios.name: Zoho Show: Presentation Maker
bluejetty:00119785:ios.summary: Create, share, and edit beautiful presentations on your iOS or iPadOS device while you're on the go. Import PowerPoint presentations (.PPTX files) and pick up where you left off. Work on your slides offline and download them as an image or
bluejetty:00119785:ios.description:
Create, share, and edit beautiful presentations on your iOS or iPadOS device while you're on the go. Import PowerPoint presentations (.PPTX files) and pick up where you left off. Work on your slides offline and download them as an image or a PDF.
CAPTURE YOUR AUDIENCE'S ATTENTION WITH STUNNING TEMPLATES
Use Show's large array of presentation templates and themes to simplify your slide creation process. Pick from marketing, sales, and many more template options for your next deck. Get access to hundreds of individual slide templates like a cover slide, image slide, and more.
GIVE YOUR IDEAS THE PERFECT PLATFORM
Choose from a wide range of customizations available in Zoho Show to create your slides. Add and customize text, images, shapes, and more.
ADD SMART ELEMENTS, SILHOUETTES, AND MORE
Pick from 100+ available shapes ranging from Basic Shapes to Equation Shapes to add to your slides. Use stylish silhouettes to illustrate your slides. Use smart elements like the Fill Indicator and Shape Indicator to visually represent numbers.
GRAPHICALLY REPRESENT DATA WITH CHARTS
Pick from 15+ chart options to engage your audience. Choose from line charts, area charts, pie charts, and other chart types to visualize your data and make it easier to understand. You can also add animation effects to charts to enhance their visual appeal.
ORGANIZE DATA BETTER WITH TABLES
Arrange and categorize your data by adding tables to your slides. Pick from preset table styles and customize your tables with multiple formatting options. Add animation effects to the tables to make your data more visually interesting.
ENRICH YOUR SLIDES WITH IMAGES
Add images to slides right from your phone. You can also add images shot using the device's camera or by inserting the image URL. Get access to the Unsplash library and choose from millions of royalty-free images from within the app.
ADD AUDIO AND VIDEO TO YOUR SLIDES
Add audio and video to your slides to retain your audience's attention. You can add background music to slides and use videos to supplement your presentation content.
ADD STUNNING ANIMATIONS AND SMOOTH TRANSITIONS
Keep engagement levels high with eye-catching animation effects and transition effects. Make slide elements Appear, Float In, Swivel, and more with more than 20 animation effects. Choose from 25+ slide transition effects like Blinds, Spiral, and Zoom.
SHARE AND COLLABORATE WITH TEAM MEMBERS
Invite collaborators by simply adding their email address in the share option to get started working together. To help avoid data loss or conflicting edits, Show allows you to choose the level of access for each collaborator.
WORK TOGETHER WITH YOUR TEAM
Discuss slide elements with your team members by adding comments to them. Reply to comments for more contextual team conversations.
NEVER LOSE YOUR PROGRESS WITH AUTO-SYNC
No need to constantly hit 'save': Show saves all your progress automatically. All you have to do is create your free Zoho account and sign in for your changes to be synced directly to the cloud.
USE YOUR PHONE AS A REMOTE
Show's compatibility helps you use your iPhone or Apple Watch as a remote to deliver presentations on an Apple TV.
PRESENT WITH YOUR APPLE TV
Present your ideas on a bigger screen by connecting to your Apple TV. Navigate and control your slides using the Apple TV remote.

bluejetty:00032785:ios.description:
Simple Match 3 is a relaxing and challenging puzzle game with absolutely no ads.
Swap tiles and make matches of 3 to clear levels. Unlock hundreds of unique tiles and customize to fit your style. Discover a variety of different elements and mechanics as you progress through the game. Use satisfying boosters and power ups. 
Unlike most match-3 games, Simple Match 3 was created to give players a relaxing and satisfying experience, without annoying ads, obnoxious effects, or time wasting story elements.
FEATURES:
No ads: Absolutely no ads or subscription purchases. The base price includes 350 levels, a unique daily level with leaderboard, and zen mode. 1 small in-app purchase unlocks even more.
Customization: Customize to your heart’s content with hundreds of different tiles and lots of different background colors. You can even choose the color of the user interface buttons to match your theme! 
Daily Level: Play a unique level every single day. Try to make it to the top of the online leaderboard! 
Zen Mode: Relax and make matches with no move limits, no goals, and limited obstacles in Zen Mode.
Satisfying experience: Enjoy super satisfying effects as you clear tiles, smash through crates, destroy glass, and more! The effects were created to be satisfying, without being too obnoxious or overwhelming. 
Achievements: Complete a variety of achievements to unlock more tiles.
Boosters: Spin the prize wheel every day to gain boosters. You can also get even more boosters by completing the daily goal. 
Handcrafted levels: Play through 350 handcrafted levels and try to earn 3 stars. Some levels are simple, others are more challenging. Discover a variety of unique elements as you progress. If you want more, 1 small in app purchase unlocks 350 more levels.
Created with love and care: Developed by a single person with care. Levels are designed to be fun, challenging, and satisfying without the need to purchase endless boosters. 
Download Simple Match 3 today and see what makes it so special!

bluejetty:00126666:ios.description:

You must be of legal drinking age to use Untappd. Please drink responsibly.

bluejetty:00043843:ios.summary:

A visitor scans a QR code at your door or gate. Your
bluejetty:00043843:ios.description:
DoorVi is a smart doorbell app and QR video intercom system with visitor management and access control for homes, apartments, gated communities & offices. Answer the door from anywhere.
A visitor scans a QR code at your door or gate. Your phone rings with a live video call. You see who it is, speak to them, and open the door — from the couch, the office or abroad. No visitor app. No wall handset. No cabling.
HOW THE VIDEO INTERCOM WORKS
1. A DoorVi QR code is placed at your door, gate or building entrance.
2. The visitor scans it with any phone camera.
3. The right resident, apartment, employee or department is called on live video.
4. You see the visitor and open the door or gate from your phone.
QR CODE VIDEO INTERCOM
A video door phone without the wiring. Guests, deliveries, couriers, drivers, technicians and service staff reach you through one scan.
• Live audio and video calls from a QR code
• No app, signup or login for the visitor
• Answer from anywhere with an internet connection
• Speak to a visitor before deciding to let them in
• A smart doorbell for one home, a video door phone for a whole building
VISITOR MANAGEMENT
DoorVi replaces the shouting at the gate, the phone calls and the paper register. Visitors reach the exact resident, apartment, office or department they came for, and the person being visited identifies them on video before anyone is let in.
For a property, visitor management means one entry process across every door, gate and tower, without new cable to a single apartment.
GUEST PRE-APPROVAL
Expecting someone? Approve them before they arrive.
Create a visitor pass with your guest's name and phone number, choose the access point they should use, and set the access details. Share the pass by WhatsApp, SMS or any messaging app.
When your guest arrives, they enter with the access code they were given — no call, no waiting at the gate, no need for you to be reachable.
Guest pre-approval is built for the visitors you already expect: family, house help and domestic staff, drivers, nannies, cleaners, deliveries, contractors and short-stay rental guests.
ACCESS CONTROL AND GATE OPENING
DoorVi connects the video call to the door itself. Open doors, gates, barriers, electric locks and relay-based entry systems straight from the call, and let pre-approved guests in with an access code.
• Remote door and gate opening from your phone
• Access codes for pre-approved visitors
• Access control that works with a property's existing hardware
• Keyless entry, with no fob or card to hand out
DIGITAL CONCIERGE
Place a Digital Concierge tablet at the entrance and visitors search for the resident or department they need, then start a video call from the screen. The same kiosk drives the gate, lock or relay, so arrival, verification and entry happen in one place.
SMARTPHONE INTERCOM FOR BUILDINGS
Residents, tenants, employees and security teams use the phones they already carry instead of a wall handset. A new apartment is added in seconds, not with a cable run.
FOR RESIDENTS AND HOMEOWNERS
• See and speak to every visitor before opening the door
• Never miss a delivery because you were not home
• Let family, staff or guests in remotely
• Pre-approve guests and share access codes
• Keep the door closed to anyone you do not recognize
FOR PROPERTY MANAGERS AND DEVELOPERS
• Video intercom across an entire property, without cabling
• Faster, calmer visitor entry at the gate
• Digital visitor management and guest pre-approval
• Access control and Digital Concierge deployments
• One system for residential, commercial and mixed-use property
WHERE DOORVI IS USED
DoorVi is used in apartments and condos, gated communities, villas, condominiums, offices and corporate campuses, co-working spaces, hotels and commercial buildings.
QR code video calling, visitor management, guest pre-approval and access control, together in one intercom app.
Questions, or planning a property-wide rollout? Visit doorvi.co

bluejetty:00153299:ios.description:
Your coding agent shouldn't wait for you to get back to your desk.
A task can run for an hour and then stop five minutes in to ask for permission or a decision. Happy lets you answer from your phone, and the same agent carries on in the same repository with the same tools and context.
Happy is the mobile app for Claude Code and Codex. The agents keep running on your own computer, and your phone is how you start them, steer them and review their work.
WHAT YOU CAN DO FROM YOUR PHONE
• Start a new session or pick up one you began at your desk
• Get notified when an agent needs input or finishes
• Approve or deny permission requests, or let a session run in Auto mode
• Choose the model and reasoning effort from the providers set up on your computer
• Review changes: a file list, colored diffs, and the full set of changes on a branch
• Attach a screenshot or photo to your prompt
• Browse sessions in one list or grouped by project, with each checkout's chats as tabs
• Open a side chat next to a session without losing your place
• Drafts follow you between your phone and your computer
HOW IT WORKS
Happy runs on your computer, and this app connects to it.
1. Install Happy Desktop from happy.engineering, or if you prefer the terminal, run: npm install -g happy
2. Create an account in the app. You don't need an email address or a password.
3. Scan the QR code your computer shows to link it to your phone.
Then start a session from either device. What you see on your phone is the same live session that's running on your computer.
YOU WILL NEED
• A computer running Happy Desktop or the Happy CLI
• Access to the coding agents you want to use, such as a Claude or ChatGPT/Codex plan or API key. Happy uses your existing accounts.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sessions are end-to-end encrypted. Your code, agent and encryption keys stay on your devices. Happy's servers only relay and store encrypted session data and can't read your prompts, responses or code.
OPEN SOURCE
The app, the CLI and the server are MIT-licensed and on GitHub. Read the code, run your own build or host your own server.
ALSO ON DESKTOP
Happy Desktop adds a harness that works across providers and lets you switch models in the middle of a task. The sessions it starts show up on your phone too.
Happy is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or OpenAI. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic. Codex and ChatGPT are trademarks of OpenAI.
Privacy Policy: https://happy.engineering/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00087605:ios.summary:

Let’s be honest: an app can't tell you exactly how often to water your plants because there are too many variables. The best way to use an app is to teach it when you water your plants so it can learn the s
bluejetty:00087605:ios.description:
PLANT WATER REMINDERS DONE RIGHT
Let’s be honest: an app can't tell you exactly how often to water your plants because there are too many variables. The best way to use an app is to teach it when you water your plants so it can learn the schedule for each plant. All you need to do is mark plants as watered and Ploi does the rest!
PLANT JOURNAL
If you're looking for a way to keep track of your plant's life and get tips on how to care for them, Ploi is the plant app for you! With Ploi, you can log everything from when you watered your plant to when it started to bloom. Plus, our care guides are full of information on how to keep your plants healthy and happy.
GROWTH PROGRESS
If you're like most people, you probably have a few houseplants. Maybe you have a fiddle leaf fig tree or a peace lily. Perhaps you have a snake plant or a succulent. No matter what type of plant you have, it's important to document its growth.
One way to do this is to take photos of your plant at different stages of its life. For example, you might take a photo of your houseplant when you first get it, and then again after a month, and then every few months after that.
Another way to document your plant's growth is to keep a plant journal. In your journal, you can write about how your plant is doing, what changes you've noticed, and how you're caring for it.
Documenting your plant's growth is a great way to keep track of its progress and to create a plant log that you can look back on. Plus, it's a fun way to document your plant's journey from a small seedling to a full-grown plant!
FREE PLANT IDENTIFICATION
If you come across a flower that you can't identify, take a picture of it and upload it to the app. Within seconds, you'll be given the plant's name and species. If you're ever curious about what plant is this, you know what app to use!
FREE PLANT CARE GUIDES
If you're looking to become a plant parent, Ploi has an ever-growing list of plant care guides that can help. Our guide is crafted specifically for each plant species, so you can learn everything you need to know about taking care of your plant.
Ploi also has widgets on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
Terms of Use: https://ploi.me/terms

bluejetty:00169528:ios.summary:

The app gives you a simple way to organize, edit, convert, and prepare PDF documents without relying on complicated software or web-based tools. It is designe
bluejetty:00169528:ios.description:
A practical PDF editor and PDF converter built for clear everyday document work.
The app gives you a simple way to organize, edit, convert, and prepare PDF documents without relying on complicated software or web-based tools. It is designed for users who need a dependable PDF workflow for work, study, and personal files.
Most tools work offline and process documents directly on your device. This helps you work with important files while keeping them under your control, especially when online PDF services are restricted. The only tool that requires an internet connection is Office to PDF, used for converting Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files to PDF.
Base PDF tools:
• Merge PDF. Combine multiple PDF documents and images into one PDF file.
• Images to PDF. Create PDF documents from photos, scans, and image files.
• Extract PDF Pages. Save selected pages from a PDF as a new document.
• Edit PDF Pages. Reorder, rotate, or delete pages in a PDF document.
• Split PDF. Break one PDF document into smaller PDF files.
• Scan Documents. Capture documents with your camera and save them as high-quality PDF files.
• Protect PDF. Add or remove password protection from a PDF document. Removing protection requires the correct password.
• Add Page Numbers to PDF. Place page numbers where you need them in a document.
• Align PDF Page Width. Align page width across a PDF document for a more consistent layout.
• Text Recognition OCR. Recognize text in scanned documents and images.
• Sign PDF. Add a signature to a PDF document.
• Compress and Resize Photos. Reduce image file size and adjust image dimensions.
Some tools are available in the Pro version:
• Compress PDF. Reduce PDF file size for easier sharing and storage.
• Office to PDF. Convert Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files to PDF. This tool requires an internet connection.
• Photo Templates for PDF. Turn photos into styled PDF documents using templates.
• PDF to Images. Export selected PDF pages or a full PDF document as image files.
• Add Watermark to PDF. Add text or image watermarks to PDF documents.

If you own an apartment building, what would you do?
In this game, you are not only the manager of the apartment, but also the confidant of the tenants. You need to build suitable rooms for the tenants and provide various facilities. At the
bluejetty:00160716:ios.description:
If you own an apartment building, what would you do?
In this game, you are not only the manager of the apartment, but also the confidant of the tenants. You need to build suitable rooms for the tenants and provide various facilities. At the same time, you will face various challenges and opportunities, such as improving tenant satisfaction, adjusting the number and location of facilities, etc. But as long as you are flexible and wise, you can easily handle all the problems.
Are you ready to join Cat Lady's Happy Home? Come and play with us!
【Become the perfect apartment manager from the perspective of tenants】
Gradually upgrade and improve the facilities in the apartment, rationally build shops to improve the quality of life of tenants, and build public facilities to meet the needs of tenants
【Meet and become good friends with tenants】
There are human tenants of all ages, as well as everyone's favorite animal friends! They have different occupations, different hobbies, earning abilities and living habits. You will get to know these lovely tenants, develop relationships with them, and unlock the little stories that happened between you~
【Build different types of rooms】
In the game, there are male apartments, female apartments, single apartments, standard apartments, high-end apartments and duplex apartments for you to choose from. Different room types may attract some unique tenants!
【Extensive community infrastructure】
You can build restaurants, courier stations, breakfast shops, supermarkets, etc. to meet the living needs of tenants. After a period of time, you can even run your own shops and use your own ideas. There are also public bathrooms, toilets, and rest rooms for you to build!
【Easy and fun mini games】
Every day, you can participate in Ding Dang’s adventures on the random map, and explore different events to get rich rewards; you can unlock ingredients in Cat Lady’s kitchen, make delicious dishes and desserts, and share food with your lovely tenants!

* Minimalist interface without distractions

Daily Planning

Habits That Stick

Focus Without Stress

* Those who seek structure without micromanagement
* People tired of overloaded task managers

* Simple priorities & color tags
* Flexible repeats for tasks
* Reminders that keep you on track
* Clean, intuitive interface
* Private by design - fully local, no sign-up
* Works entirely offline — no internet needed
Planelle isn’t just another task manager. It’s quiet support for those who want to live with intention. It doesn’t fight for your attention — it helps you protect it. Simplicity isn’t a lack of features; it’s freedom from the unnecessary.
No ads. No accounts. No pressure.
Just Planelle.

bluejetty:00090306:ios.summary:
Account Manager helps you take control of your finances with the ultimate digital ledger and bookkeeping tool. (Account Manager - Ledger Book)
Stop relying on messy paper registers and complicated spreadsheets. Account Manager - Ledger Boo
bluejetty:00090306:ios.description:
Account Manager helps you take control of your finances with the ultimate digital ledger and bookkeeping tool. (Account Manager - Ledger Book)
Stop relying on messy paper registers and complicated spreadsheets. Account Manager - Ledger Book provides a simple way to organise your personal, household, and business finances. Record money coming in and going out, manage multiple accounts, maintain a clear financial record, and monitor your cash flow with ease. Whether you need a digital ledger, cashbook, account book, money manager, or personal finance tool, it helps keep your financial information organised while working completely offline and privately.
Plan your spending with a daily budget, review your financial activity, and make informed decisions about where your money goes. Use it for household spending, business transactions, travel expenses, or everyday money management. Support for multiple currencies, financial reports, visual charts, bookkeeping, account management, and spending analysis gives you a complete view of your finances. Stay organised, understand your spending habits, and maintain better control of your money anytime, anywhere.
Key Features:
◉ Comprehensive Ledger Tracking: Effortlessly manage multiple accounts. Track "Credit" (Money In) and "Debit" (Money Out) with a single tap.
◉ Expense & Income Charts: Monitor your income and expenses with clear visual charts showing monthly, yearly, and all-time statistics, helping you manage and control your budget more effectively.
◉ Professional PDF Reports: Generate detailed daily, monthly, or yearly reports. Export and share them via WhatsApp or Email for tax purposes or business meetings.
◉ 100% Secure & Private: Your data stays on your device. Use the built-in App Lock (PIN or Biometrics) to ensure your history is for your eyes only.
◉ Easy Backup & Restore: Take regular backups and securely store your ledger on Google Drive or iCloud, and restore it whenever you switch devices or in case of unforeseen circumstances.
◉ Offline Functionality: No internet? No problem. Record transactions anytime, anywhere.
◉ Multiple Currency Support: Seamlessly handle transactions in different currencies, catering to your diverse needs.
◉ Backup Reminder and Settings: Receive reminders to periodically back up your account data, ensuring the safety of your information.
By utilizing these powerful features, you can efficiently manage your accounts, track your income and expenses, and make necessary adjustments when needed. The Accounts Manager app provides a user-friendly platform for seamless financial monitoring and control.
The Accounts Manager app values user feedback and encourages your suggestions. We strive to provide the best possible user experience, and your input plays an important role in helping us improve.
Note: This app works completely offline. Please periodically backup your account data to help restore it in unexpected situations.

bluejetty:00030673:ios.description:
Need to rehome or sell your dog, puppy or kitten? List your pet on Pets Home in minutes and reach families near you, or browse thousands of pets looking for a new home.
LIST YOUR PET IN MINUTES
Rehoming a dog, selling a litter of puppies, or finding a new home for a cat you can no longer keep — Pets Home connects you with families in your area.
• Post from your phone in a few taps, with photos
• Reach buyers and adopters near you, or worldwide
• You're prompted to disclose vaccination, health and training details, so the right home finds you faster
• Message people directly and choose who your pet goes to
• Every listing is reviewed by our team before it goes live
FIND YOUR NEXT PET
Browse dogs, cats, puppies, kittens, rabbits and small animals for sale or adoption near you. Filter by breed, age, size and distance, and message the owner directly.
BOOK PET CARE YOU CAN TRUST
Find local sitters and walkers, compare rates and read genuine reviews: dog walking, boarding, house sitting, drop-in visits, doggy day care and pet taxi.
EARN FROM YOUR LOVE OF ANIMALS
List your own pet care service and keep 100% of what you earn — zero commission. Set your own rates and hours, build up reviews, and get your own web page owners can find on Google.
WHAT BREED IS MY PET?
Snap a photo of your pet to instantly uncover their breed, health requirements, vaccination schedule and daily care needs in seconds.
TRAINING BUILT AROUND YOUR DOG
A step-by-step plan shaped by your dog's breed, age and behaviour, with daily sessions, progress tracking and reminders.
MESSAGE SAFELY
Conversations stay in the app. No phone numbers, no email addresses, no middlemen. Report anything that looks wrong and our moderators review it.
ALSO INCLUDED
• AI pet advisor for everyday pet care questions
• Pet cost calculator — know what a pet really costs before you commit
• Playdates and responsible breeding matches with owners nearby
• Submit pet videos and earn a share of the ad revenue
• Available in 19 languages
Download Pets Home and find the right home for your pet.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
Unlock premium features for sellers: boost listings, advanced analytics and more.
Monthly and annual options.
Payment is charged 24 hours before renewal.

bluejetty:00085229:ios.description:
YOUR TRAVEL REWARDS, IN ONE EASY APP
The Avios app makes it easy to collect, spend and manage Avios. British Airways Club, AerClub, Vueling Club and Iberia Club customers can check their Avios balance, view recent transactions, discover ways to collect Avios and plan how to spend them on travel and other exciting products.
Already an AerClub, Vueling Club and Iberia Club customer? Simply sign in with your existing details. You do not need to join the British Airways Club.
SAVE ON FLIGHTS, HOTELS, CAR HIRE AND MORE
Spend Avios on flights, hotels, car hire and more. Discover opportunities to collect and spend Avios with airline, travel and lifestyle partners.
Availability may vary depending on your programme and market.
COLLECT AVIOS WHEN YOU SHOP
Discover ways to collect Avios with selected shopping, food, travel and lifestyle partners.
The Avios app makes it easy to find partners you can collect Avios with.
GET MORE FROM YOUR AVIOS
Check your balance and keep track of recent activity.
The Avios app helps keep your Avios experience within easy reach.
WHY DOWNLOAD THE AVIOS APP?
• Access your British Airways Club, AerClub, Vueling Club or Iberia Club Avios accounts using your existing programme login details.
• Check your Avios balance and recent transactions.
• Discover ways to collect Avios with more than 2,000 partners.
• Spend Avios on reward flights, hotels, car hire and more, where available.
• Keep track of your Avios activity and plan your next trip.
Features, partners and availability may vary depending on your programme and market.

bluejetty:00121727:ios.description:
L’app MyTIM ti permette di controllare da iPhone e iPad le tue linee mobili prepagate e le tue linee fisse.
Puoi accedere utilizzando l’account MyTIM con il tuo indirizzo e-mail come username.
Se vuoi creare un account associandolo ad una linea fissa, lo puoi fare da App collegandoti in Wi-Fi alla rete FIBRA o ADSL della linea TIM che vuoi registrare.
Saremo lieti di ricevere i tuoi suggerimenti o eventuali segnalazioni tramite l’indirizzo e-mail mytim.app@telecomitalia.it
Con questa versione della app MyTIM puoi:
- Registrare un account MyTIM per accedere da App o da Web
- Controllare lo stato di attivazione delle tue linee 
- Gestire e memorizzare le modalità di pagamento preferite
- Ricevere Assistenza da un operatore via chat o attraverso la Community WeTIM
- Seguire il tracking dei tuoi ordini 
- Acquistare offerte e prodotti TIM
- Trovare rapidamente ciò di cui hai bisogno grazie alla casella di ricerca
 - Accedere rapidamente alle funzionalità più utili tramite la sezione azioni veloci
- Scoprire le novità, l’intrattenimento e i concorsi di TIM tramite le storie 
- Accedere ai vantaggi di TIM Party, il programma di fedeltà di TIM, completamente gratuito che ti premia con tanti regali pensati per te: giga, minuti, smartphone scontati, concorsi con premi esclusivi e molte altre sorprese
- Non sei cliente TIM? Puoi comunque partecipare ai concorsi esclusivi, tracciare i tuoi ordini, attivare una SIM e tanto altro
Per le tue linee mobili:
• Visualizzare il credito residuo
• Avere informazioni sul tuo piano tariffario
• Verificare le tue offerte per controllare i Minuti, SMS e Giga disponibili
• Visualizzare e gestire i servizi attivi sulla tua linea
• Effettuare ricariche online con un click utilizzando carta di credito, PayPal e Satispay oppure utilizzando una RicariCard e attivare il servizio di Ricarica Automatica
• Visualizzare i movimenti del credito sulla linea
• Acquistare i biglietti per i mezzi di trasporto, la sosta e l’accesso alle ztl su diverse città
Per le tue linee fisse:
• Consultare le offerte e i servizi attivi sulla linea
• Consultare le fatture dell’ultimo anno
• Visualizzare la fattura in formato pdf ed effettuarne il download
• Pagare la fattura con carta di credito o PayPal
• Domiciliare la fattura su conto corrente o carta di credito
• Effettuare un trasloco o un subentro
Per consultare la Dichiarazione di Accessibilità dell'app MyTIM, visita il seguente link:
https://www.tim.it/dichiarazione-di-accessibilita-mytim
L’app MyTIM continuerà ad essere arricchita di sempre maggiori funzionalità. Aggiornala sempre per non perdere le novità!

Simulator of destruction

Slowmotion
- You have the full control over the time rate: slow it down, inrease the speed or just stop the simulation
Gravity
- Took it all from freezing time... Well, play with low / hight gravity or just turn it off like you are in space ;)
Controll of gameplay
- Disable or enable explosions visualization (if it covers debris you want to see), only smoke or even lights / flashes.
- Too many debris on the screen? Just enable limitation option so all debris over certain value will smoothly dissapear
- Not enought debris? Simply increase destructibility level
Guns
- About 13 different explosives (missiles, dynamites, bombs)
- Earthquake, tornado, singularity
- Different sized cannon balls
- Custom gun editor
Maps
- Destroy over 30+ prebuild map from skyscrapers to ancient structures
- Map editor: Build your own map and save it to one of available slots
Simulator
We have created this game for our personal needs - always dreamed of the game that allows you to destroy buildings, but there wasnt any, sooo... had to do one ourselves : )

bluejetty:00145987:ios.description:
Nut Sort - Color Puzzle 3D is a fun and addictive game that challenges your brain while keeping you entertained! Match colorful nuts to their bolts, sort them strategically, and clear the board. Progress through levels that start easy but get more challenging, and collect nuts to unlock and build exciting island structures.
How to Play the Nut Sort Color Puzzle 3D Game:
- Tap a bolt to pick up a nut and move it to another bolt.
- Match nuts of the same color on one bolt to complete the level.
- Use "Undo" to fix mistakes and "Hint" if you're unsure of the next move.
- Add an extra bolt if you’re stuck, or restart the level anytime.
- Collect Nuts to unlock & build the island building
Nut & Bolt Sort color puzzle Game’s features:
- Simple one-finger controls.
- Thousands of levels to test your skills.
- Relaxing yet challenging puzzles to train your brain.
- Sort nuts by color to complete each exciting level.
- Test your color sorting skills in challenging level.
- Create stunning island buildings as you progress through the game.
- Collect nuts, bolts, and exciting bonuses from daily rewards.
- Restart the level if you’re stuck or want a restart the level.
- Enjoy exclusive offer and boosts your progress.
Download the Nut Sort color puzzle 3d game now to enjoy hours of fun, challenge your mind, and see who becomes the ultimate nut sorting master!

bluejetty:00162098:ios.name: Parafuzo - Diaristas e Faxina
bluejetty:00162098:ios.summary: Cuidar de casa ficou muito mais fácil e prático! Precisando de diaristas confiáveis e profissionais para fazer uma faxina na sua casa ou escritório? Que tal alguém para passar suas roupas? Ou um montador de móveis com total praticidade e se
bluejetty:00162098:ios.description:
Cuidar de casa ficou muito mais fácil e prático! Precisando de diaristas confiáveis e profissionais para fazer uma faxina na sua casa ou escritório? Que tal alguém para passar suas roupas? Ou um montador de móveis com total praticidade e segurança? Na Parafuzo você encontra e tem R$ 35 de desconto no primeiro serviço de uma assinatura.
Aqui você tem a liberdade para agendar o serviço que melhor se encaixa na sua rotina, no seu bolso e naquilo que a sua casa precisa.
Conheça nossos serviços disponíveis abaixo:
Limpeza Padrão - aquela limpeza de rotina, ideal para manter a qualidade e higiene da sua casa, além de facilitar o seu dia a dia. Você ainda pode personalizar o serviço com um dos itens opcionais: interior de geladeira, interior de armários, aspirar tapetes e estofados, limpar janelas, duas horas de passadoria, limpar área externa e lavar roupas.
Limpeza Pesada - para aqueles dias em que sua casa precisa de um cuidado maior e de uma limpeza bem caprichada. A sua diária terá maior duração, dando tempo suficiente para que os profissionais caprichem em todos os detalhes. Nessa faxina estão inclusos os principais opcionais da Limpeza Padrão.
Limpeza Pré-Mudança - ideal para você deixar seu novo lar pronto para curtir sua casa nova. Essa faxina especial inclui a lavagem dos azulejos, banheiro, limpeza dos rodapés, portas e batentes. E, para a sua comodidade, os produtos de limpeza são levados pelos profissionais.
Limpeza Pós-Obra é recomendada para ambientes que passaram por pequenas reformas. É mais detalhada, para deixar o ambiente perfeito para que você possa aproveitar a casa reformada, sem dores de cabeça.
Limpeza Comercial - a limpeza para empresas da Parafuzo serve para você que tem um negócio de pequeno e médio porte e não quer precisar se preocupar com a faxina e organização do seu escritório. Nota fiscal inclusa.
Passadoria de Roupas - para quando a pilha de roupas está enorme e você precisa de ajuda! Com a Parafuzo é muito fácil: selecione o número de peças, contrate uma diarista especializada em passadoria e pague por horas contratadas.
Montagem de Móveis - Acabou de comprar móveis novos? Contrate montadores qualificados, prontos para montar qualquer tipo de móvel.
Além dos melhores serviços, na Parafuzo você encontra os melhores profissionais! Nossa avaliação média para os serviços prestados é de 4.8/5.
*Benefícios Para Assinantes*
Além de pagar até 20% mais barato na faxina, você ainda tem suporte exclusivo por WhatsApp e Assistência Residencial Grátis - acesso a serviços de chaveiro, encanador, eletricista, vidraceiro, conserto de eletrodomésticos e muito mais.
*Sobre a contratação*
Na hora de contratar, você informa o número de quartos e banheiros (sala e cozinha já estão inclusos), a frequência que deseja receber o atendimento (uma única vez, semanalmente ou quinzenalmente), seleciona a data, o horário e escolhe sua forma de pagamento (a cobrança acontecerá somente após o serviço realizado). Depois disso, é com a Parafuzo! Nós encontraremos o melhor profissional credenciado da sua região!
*Funcionalidades do aplicativo*
Fez o pedido, mas precisa de alguma alteração? No nosso aplicativo você pode reagendar, cancelar ou pular serviços. Gostou de um profissional que lhe atendeu? Você pode convidá-lo como seu profissional preferencial! Além disso, tenha atendimento via chat de suporte da Parafuzo, disponível de segunda a sábado das 7h às 21h e aos domingos e feriados das 9h às 17h.
Ficou com alguma dúvida? Chama a gente. Contratar pela Parafuzo é muito rápido e prático!
Atendemos mais de 200 cidades de todo o Brasil. Confira algumas delas:
* São Paulo e região metropolitana
* Campinas
* Ribeirão Preto
* Rio de Janeiro
* Belo Horizonte
* Brasília
* Porto Alegre
* Curitiba
* Florianópolis
* Recife
* Fortaleza
Dúvidas? Entre em contato conosco pelo e-mail: contato@parafuzo.com 
*Siga nossas redes sociais!*
Facebook: www.fb.com/ParafuzoCasa 
Instagram: www.instagram.com/ParafuzoCasa

bluejetty:00114460:ios.name: Word Deck Solitaire
bluejetty:00114460:ios.summary: Word Deck Solitaire is a fresh word-and-card puzzle where you solve associations, arrange cards into the right categories, and progress through a refined solitaire-inspired board. Each level challenges your logic, vocabulary, and ability to
bluejetty:00114460:ios.description:
Word Deck Solitaire is a fresh word-and-card puzzle where you solve associations, arrange cards into the right categories, and progress through a refined solitaire-inspired board. Each level challenges your logic, vocabulary, and ability to organize words into meaningful groups with limited moves. The rules are simple to learn, yet the strategy develops quickly, creating a clean and satisfying flow for players who enjoy thoughtful puzzles.
At the start of every level, you receive a set of category cards and a mixed deck of word cards. Your task is to place each word into the correct category while keeping the board clear and your moves efficient. The layout resembles a classic solitaire tableau, but instead of suits and numbers, you work with words, meanings, and associations. As you advance, categories become more nuanced, combinations grow trickier, and the relationships between words require sharper reasoning.
Word Deck Solitaire is designed for players who enjoy structure, clarity, and well-paced progression. Levels begin simple and steadily increase in complexity without overwhelming the user. You are always given enough information to think through the puzzle, making success feel earned rather than lucky. Whether you prefer fast sessions or longer, meditative play, the game adapts naturally to your style.
The experience focuses on calm difficulty, clean visuals, and a polished card-based interface. With hundreds of handcrafted levels, varied themes, and a smooth difficulty curve, Word Deck Solitaire offers long-term engagement for fans of logic games, solitaire variations, word puzzles, and category-based brain teasers. It is an ideal choice for anyone looking to train associative thinking, expand vocabulary, and enjoy a modern twist on a solitaire-inspired card mechanic.
Play offline, progress at your own pace, and return anytime to continue your journey through word associations. Word Deck Solitaire combines the familiarity of card solitaire with the depth of category logic, delivering a unique puzzle experience that feels both intuitive and refreshing.

Reach your next finish line with Endorphins — the top-rated training app powered by science, built by world-class coaches, and backed by the largest run community in the country.
Whether you’re running your first 5K or chasing a Boston Qualifier, Endorphins gives you personalized plans, real-time progress tracking, expert coaching, and an in person community of 1500 events to help get you there.
WHY THOUSANDS OF RUNNERS RUN & TRAIN WITH ENDORPHINS:
1) Personalized Coaching Plans
We build your training plan around you—your pace, your race, your goals. Whether it's a 5K, 10K, half, full, or ultra, your plan adapts as you go.
2) 1500 Community Events A Year
Train with other runners who share the same goals as you

Sync your Garmin, COROS, or Strava to track runs in real time. We use your data to adjust your plan and optimize every workout.

Our strength programs compliment your running schedule for optimal improvements and gains.
5) Real Coaches. Real Results.
Our team has trained thousands of runners—from first-timers to sub-elites. You’re never more than a message away from expert support.
JOIN THE LARGEST RUN COMMUNITY IN AMERICA:
1) In-Person Energy
We host 1,500+ free group runs a year in 12+ cities. From long runs to shakeouts, connect with others who share the same goals and values as you.
2) Community Benefits
Endorphins members get access to drops, exclusive partner benefits, and race-weekend events.
3) Track Progress + Stay Accountable
From weekly goals to post-run recaps, we keep you on track and connected to your training—day in, day out.
4) Built to Grow With You
As your goals evolve, so does your training. Whether you’re starting from scratch or going sub-3, we’ve got the plan.
PLANS FOR EVERY GOAL:
First-time 5K to your next marathon PR
Strength + mobility for runners
Recovery programs post-race or post-injury
And more, always evolving
COMPATIBLE WITH:
Garmin, COROS, Strava, and more.

Train smarter with adaptive plans, real-time sync, and exclusive coaching content.

Subscriptions auto-renew. Manage in your iTunes settings.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION:
Endorphins uses your health data for accurate heart rate, distance, and pace tracking when using Apple Watch.
18+ ONLY:
Endorphins is for adults 18+. Accounts may be removed if underage use is detected.

bluejetty:00072717:ios.description:
Works with CarPlay!
The R8(w) Companion™ app leverages 6+ years of historical data in its acclaimed 'Advanced False Assist' filtering engine, detector optimizations and shared features from the Radar Companion™ series of apps. (Available separately for owners of the V1, R4, R9, & DS1 radar detectors). The filtering engine is updated on a regular basis from accumulated real world usage data for better filtering against falses, and protection against real threats.
R8 Companion™ is a feature rich app, designed to give you the most out of your R8, while enhancing your driving experience along the way. It is extremely easy to get up and running. Featuring intelligent alerts and advanced muting! R8 Companion™ is the COMPLETE solution to enjoying your R8. 
NOTE: R8 Companion™ requires a Uniden R8 or R8w radar detector with US Version 145 (R8) or 143 (R8w) firmware (OR EARLIER) to function correctly. R8 Companion will NOT function correctly without the appropriate firmware for each detector.
Enhanced GPS location based 'false muting' via SpotLocks - All future updates to this app are free to purchasers of R8 Companion.
R8 Companion's alerting and muting systems are fully optimized for the R8 platform. Intelligent voice announcements and on-screen visuals will always keep you informed and aware of the situation around you. 
R8 Companion full feature list:
• SpotLocks - Location based false silencing has never been this good or easy. Turn on the intelligent location-based learning and let R8 Companion™ do the rest. Or you can manually 'lock' or 'unlock' locations with ease from the main alert screen.
• SpotLocks works seamlessly with your R8’s built in 'auto mute memory' locations. If you create or delete a location from the app it will apply the changes to your R8 at the same time.
• Option to play detector tones in app.
• 'Proximity' meter - leverages the high resolution signal strength and direction information provided by the detector to show you a better representation of the signal's source.
• 'K & X falses in area' meter shows you how many possible false alerts exist in the area you are travelling based on the accumulated SpotLock data™.
• 'Custom Phrases' for a given threat's audio announcements.
• High resolution meter for the priority alert (Not limited to the # of bars on the R8 display).
• Customizable heads-up display (HUD).
• HUD displays the priority alert's band, signal strength, frequency, & direction.
• HUD of the secondary alerts' bands, signal strengths, frequencies, bogey counts & directions.
• Mute rear K & X band signals independently.
• Advanced BSM/CAS/Ka False Muting (Optimized for the R8 platform).
• Ability to set the R8’s internal detector settings from within the app. No need for different apps to modify your detector settings. Do it all from the companion app.
• 'Ghost' muting quiets false alerts when you are stuck traveling near a false emitting vehicle.
• "Passive Mute™"- Quiets the R8 below user set speeds & during weak K & X signals.
• Bogey count display showing total number of threats.
• Vehicle speed (MPH or KMH) display. Speed is color coded for each alert type.
• Mute status with the ability to manually mute/unmute alerts as you need.
• Detailed & intelligent voice announcements of direction, band, frequency, strength, number of alerts, occurrences of mixed signals and more.
• Automatic muting of Ka, K, and X bands ('Time before mute' set for each band).
• 'Reduce Speed' notification for user set speed.
• ‘Urgency Alerts™’ - Unmutes growing threats & announces these alerts via voice & notifications.
• ‘Alert History’ - View your past alerts with detailed information about each encounter.
• Compass heading.
• Imperial/metric units.
• Detailed trip summary at the end of your ride including duration, distance, alerts, muting stats, battery, and more.
• iPhone & Apple Watch notifications of direction, band, & frequency.
• Help system.

bluejetty:00153849:ios.description:
Snapdex is your all-in-one Pokémon card value scanner and TCG companion app. Instantly scan, identify, and track your cards with real-time prices from trusted sources. Whether you’re a casual fan or a dedicated collector, Snapdex helps you discover the true value of your Pokémon cards and manage your collection effortlessly.
• Scan Any Pokémon Card Instantly •
Turn your phone into a powerful Pokémon card value scanner. With Snapdex’s advanced recognition technology, simply point your camera at any card, and Snapdex instantly identifies it and shows its value. No more manual searches or typing card names, just snap and see your results in seconds.
• Get Real-Time Card Values •
Stay informed with accurate, up-to-date Pokémon card prices. Snapdex pulls live data from multiple sources like TCGPlayer, CardMarket, and eBay, giving you real-time value tracking, price trends, and market fluctuations for every Pokémon card you own or scan.
• Manage & Value Your Collection •
Snapdex makes collection management simple. Organize your Pokémon cards into custom collections, view your total portfolio value, and track individual card prices over time. Whether you’re a collector, player, or investor, Snapdex helps you understand the worth of your collection at a glance.
• Key Features •
- Instant Scanning: Use Snapdex’s camera-based Pokémon card value scanner to identify any card in seconds
- Real-Time Market Prices: View up-to-date values from TCGPlayer, CardMarket, and eBay
- Comprehensive Card Info: See detailed data like set, rarity, and card number
- Collection Management: Create custom collections and track total values
- Watchlist: Monitor specific Pokémon cards you want to buy or trade
- Smart Search: Find any Pokémon card by name, number, or set
- Series Browser: Explore Pokémon TCG sets and series with ease
• Why Snapdex? •
Snapdex isn’t just another app... It’s the Pokémon card value scanner built for serious collectors. Whether you’re cataloging your cards, checking current prices, or analyzing trends, Snapdex gives you everything you need in one intuitive tool.
Download Snapdex today and transform how you scan, value, and manage your Pokémon TCG cards.

bluejetty:00122241:ios.description:
TYT brings you award-winning news and talk, and groundbreaking, independent journalism. We not only offer progressive commentary and fresh ideas with The Young Turks, hosted by Cenk Uygur and Ana Kasparian, but we’ve added fresh new shows and hosts to the mix! Whether you’re looking to be informed, entertained, or both, TYT has the stories you want and the anti-establishment, no-holds-barred insights you need.
Watch full episodes of your favorite shows including:
- The Young Turks
- The Damage Report
- Indisputable
- and more! 
Getting started is easy. Just download the free app and enjoy TYT’s videos, podcasts and live streams. Some of our content is exclusive to TYT Members (marked with a “TYT Plus” banner). You can become a member to watch or listen to this content - cancel anytime. 
A paid membership to TYT includes:
- Access to all of TYT’s content: members get full versions of all videos and podcasts, with more than 15 hours of live content per week.
- Ad-free experience: No annoying pre-rolls to slow you down.
- All the news you care about: Customize your notifications to receive updates on live shows, special events, and breaking news.
In addition to these perks, a paid membership to TYT helps support independent journalism. TYT covers stories that are largely ignored by major media organizations, and holds the establishment accountable by taking politicians on both sides of the aisle to task for their actions every day. This is possible thanks in large part to the support of our members!
Payment is charged to the iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be automatically charged each month for renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings. If you turn off auto-renew during the current subscription period, your subscription will be canceled for the subsequent period.
For help, please visit https://accounts.tytnetwork.com/faq

bluejetty:00015997:ios.description:
Can you crack the code?
Astraware CodeWords is an addictive word puzzle game with a difference! You start with a crosswords style grid but instead of words, each letter has been substituted with a number from 1 to 26. It is up to you to figure out which number stands for each letter!
There are no clues but 3 letters are already in place to help you get started and each letter of the alphabet is used at least once. You start by guessing possible words and matching numbers with letters, until you've fully cracked the code - and your vocabulary and logical reasoning will be stretched along the way!
Did you know that the letter 'e' is the most commonly used letter in English? Did you know that 'th' is the most common pair of letters to be seen together? You'll use this knowledge and more as you make your guesses and work out the words!
Astraware CodeWords gives you access to play our free Daily puzzles - top the global leaderboard by completing the puzzle in the fastest time! For an extra challenge there is a Weekender puzzle available each Friday with a trickier grid and more unusual words.
Great features include:
- Unlimited access to our two Daily puzzles and Weekender puzzle.
- A collection of 50 built-in puzzles in various sizes and difficulties, perfect for beginners and avid players
- Extra puzzle streams for endless play
- Intuitive interface
- Highlighting to show where you've chosen the same letter for different numbers
- Option to fill in letters manually, or choose auto to fill in all occurrences of that letter at once
- Save slots available to have several puzzles on the go at once, so you can stop for a break and come back to a puzzle later
- Option to purchase extra value puzzle packs for offline play
- Puzzles Plus subscription for unlimited puzzles
Puzzles Plus Subscription Terms and Details
Puzzles Plus is our optional subscription for CodeWords which entitles you to play all of the available Daily, Weekender and Stream puzzles as soon as they are available, without in-game adverts or any requirement to earn tokens. Subscribers can also choose to highlight their high scores with a choice of badges.
Subscriptions are available with renewal periods of either monthly, quarterly (every 3 months), or yearly. The price shown is the cost of the renewal, with the saving value for longer subscription periods as a comparison to the monthly option.
After you confirm a subscription, you will have a free trial period of seven days. Your iTunes Account will be charged as soon as the free trial is over. If you cancel the subscription at any time before the free trial is over, you will not be billed.
The subscriptions are automatically renewing, and you will be charged again at the end of your current subscription period. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn this off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
The renewal cost will be the same for each subscription period, and will be charged within the 24 hours before the end of your current subscription.
You can manage the subscriptions at any time by going to the Account Settings in the Settings App after purchase. There are options to either change to a different renewal period (which will be at a different price) or to cancel your subscription completely.
If you cancel the renewal you will still have access to the Puzzles Plus features until the full subscription period is complete. If you confirm the purchase of a subscription before the free trial is complete, any unused portion of the free trial will be lost.
These terms are listed at the Astraware site at : https://www.astraware.com/about/puzzlesplus/
For more information on Data and Privacy, please view the Astraware Privacy page at http://www.astraware.com/privacy

• Want to build an emergency fund but don’t know where to start
• Want to invest for retirement and take advantage of time
• Need focus to achieve big goals (house, car, exchange program)
• Are beginners and want to see real investment growth
Stop postponing your dreams. Start making your money work for you today.
Your future self will thank you for downloading this app now!
Download now and begin your journey toward financial freedom!

bluejetty:00019231:ios.description:
Micro Breaker - is a fresh take on a brick breaking game with a great and expanded gameplay that you've never seen before. Here you can acquire and upgrade amazing power-ups that will change your odds in more difficult stages. You can unlock different paddles and balls that you can use to beat the high scores and smash your way through the online rankings!
IMMERSIVE AND ENGAGING
Master the paddle with engaging controls in the 3D environment that will change your perspective about brick breakers forever! Combining dynamic graphics with almost natural controls will allow you to enjoy this classic and refreshed gameplay! 
TWO DIFFERENT MODES WITH UNLIMITED OPPORTUNITIES
You can enjoy a normal mode with 130 different stages divided between 4 different zones. Each zone has a non-linear stage layout and it's entirely up to you which route you take, but you can beat all the stages to gain more stars! Will you be able to reach and beat all Boss stages? There's also a challenge mode, where you will face those stages in random order, trying to get the highest winning streak to gain more rewards while climbing online scoreboard in both modes!
DAILY QUESTS AND MORE
We've prepared daily quests that will award you with some prizes for breaking through some stages. The game will additionally reward you for your progression through the normal mode. The in-game currency will allow you to unlock even more exciting ways to enjoy smashing bricks and bosses! Besides that, many achievements are waiting to be unlocked, can you get them all?
BREAKING IN AUGMENTED REALITY
Additionally, we're happy to announce that you will be able to enjoy and soak into the game even more with the AR mode option! You can activate this mode at any moment to enjoy the smashing in the brand new light! Breaking, smashing and going through the motion in the surrounding of your choice!
**FEATURES**
 • Easy and natural controls
 • Dynamic 3D graphics
 • Realistic physics
 • 2 different game modes
 • Over 130 stages and 4 different zones
 • 4 challenging boss stages
 • Over 50 power-ups
 • Unlockable paddles and balls with different perks

bluejetty:00119129:ios.description:
Japji Sahib is a Sikh prayer, that appears at the beginning of the holy scripture of the Sikhs, the living Guru, Guru Granth Sahib. It was composed by Guru Nanak Dev, the founder of Sikhism. It is headed by Mool Mantra and followed by 38 paudis (stanzas) and completed with a final Salok at the end of this composition.
Japji Sahib is believed to be the first composition of Guru Nanak, and considered in Sikhism as the faith's most comprehensive essence.
[1] It is regarded amongst the most important Bani or 'set of verses' by the Sikhs, as it is first Bani in Nitnem. It is notable for its discourse on what is true worship and the nature of God. It states that God is indescribable, the only true form of worship is acceptance of God, and to remain one with loving God, always.

bluejetty:00145779:ios.description:
Found a tattoo you love on Pinterest? See it on your own skin before you commit.
Browse tattoo designs by category, tap the one you like, and it lands straight on your camera — at the size, angle and spot you choose.
A tattoo is permanent. This is the cheapest way to find out whether you really want it.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a style — abstract, realistic, pop art, Japanese, lettering and more
2. Tap any design you like
3. The camera opens with that design on your skin
4. Move, resize and rotate it until the placement feels right
5. Take the shot, save it, or send it to your artist
BROWSE WITHOUT LEAVING THE APP
Thousands of tattoo ideas, sorted by style. No copying links, no switching apps, no downloads. Tap a design and you are already trying it on. Sign in with your own Pinterest account to keep browsing beyond the preview.
BRING YOUR OWN DESIGN
Have a design somewhere else? Share it to this app or pick it from your gallery. The background is removed automatically, so only the linework lands on your skin.
REALISTIC PLACEMENT
• Automatic background removal — the ink, not the white square around it
• Ink blending that sits on the skin instead of floating over it
• Eraser to tuck the design around curves and edges
• Multiple layers, so you can build a full sleeve piece by piece
FOR TATTOO ARTISTS
• Stencil mode — threshold any design down to clean black-and-white linework
• Export to PDF at real print size in centimetres, ready for thermal paper
• Print-resolution output (3000 px — around 25 cm at 300 DPI)
• Save client mockups and send them before the appointment
PREMIUM
The app is free to try. Premium lifts the try-on limit and removes the watermark from saved designs.
Subscription auto-renews. Cancel any time in Settings at least 24 hours before renewal.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Pinterest.

bluejetty:00024087:ios.name: All‑in‑One Year Calendar SE
bluejetty:00024087:ios.summary: All-in-One Year Calendar SE for iPhone is an easy-to-use yet powerful personalizable year planner, complete with markups/highlighting, events, reminders, holidays, birthdays and anniversaries, daily notes/diary, advanced week numbers, custo
bluejetty:00024087:ios.description:
All-in-One Year Calendar SE for iPhone is an easy-to-use yet powerful personalizable year planner, complete with markups/highlighting, events, reminders, holidays, birthdays and anniversaries, daily notes/diary, advanced week numbers, customizable month layout and appearance, sharing, and iCloud syncing. It will save you time and help you stay organized, works perfectly for day-to-day, short-term and long-term planning. See your deadlines in a glance, mark important dates, schedule vacations, record shift work, track activities or resolutions, and much more.
Example 1:
To plan vacation days, first indicate public holidays and other days off in red text color. Mark kids’ school holidays in blue. Then find days suitable for vacations and label them with stylish hand-drawn markups. View the number of days taken and scheduled for the year from the markup legend. Markups can be easily removed or changed for plan adjustments. You can also hide unrelated markups and export the annotated calendar.
Example 2:
For part-time or contract work, track the days worked with markups. Record the number of working hours and/or project names in the daily notes. View, email, and print a list of notes. 
IMPORTANT NOTE
A monthly or annual subscription is required to use the app. A fully-functional 1-month free trial is available for all new users. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the end of the free trial period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your iTunes account settings.
NAVIGATION AND DAY VIEW
• 3 zoom levels: full year, half year, 2 months
• Year navigation by gesture, button, scroller, or direct entry
• Day view that lists events, holidays, birthdays and anniversaries, markups, daily notes, and a "how many days away" count
MARKUPS
• Use the floating markup toolbox to add markups (scribbles or colors)
• Apply 1 icon, background, and text color markup per day, AND up to another 8 bonus markup styles on each day - enough for the entire family!
• Fast multi-day markup entry
• Organize markups and see their counts in the legend
• Hide individual markups before sharing
EVENTS
• Sync with your existing calendars
• Add up to 5 alarms per event
• Two-way event sync with local calendars and iOS supported external calendars such as iCloud, Google Calendar, Yahoo, Exchange server, Outlook or Calendar on a Mac or PC, and CalDAV
• One-way sync from subscribed calendars
REMINDERS
• Two-way sync with the Reminders app
• Add up to 5 alarms per reminder, including notifying before or after the task is due
• View reminders on calendar by due date or completion date, or as a list
HOLIDAYS
• Select desired countries and holidays from 41 nations
BIRTHDAYS
• Display and add birthdays, anniversaries, and custom-labeled dates, synced with the Contacts app
DAILY NOTES
• Add free-form daily notes with a single tap
LAYOUT
• Start the year from any month for your fiscal or academic calendar
• Configure week starting day and weekend days
• Fully customizable week numbers that can start from any day of the year
APPEARANCE
• Over 35 handpicked font choices
• Choose a simple background color, or apply a beautiful wallpaper using built-in images or pictures from your photo library, with preset and configurable effects
• Select colors for the default, weekend, and holiday text
• Optional grid lines
• Set calendar language and format using your regional settings
EXPORT AND SHARING
• Export your calendar, markup legend, and/or notes
• Save, email, print via AirPrint, create PDF, tweet, post to Facebook, and more
APPLICATION BADGE
• Optionally show a badge on the app icon corresponding to the current day of the month, or the week number (ISO week number or custom).
OTHER
• Create additional year calendars that can be configured independently for extra tracking or multiple users
• Sync calendar(s) across all your devices via iCloud
• Integrated Spotlight search
• Dark Mode support
Terms of use: https://voidtech.net/apps/terms_of_use

Word Jewels Tower is SUPER FUN and 100% FREE!
DOWNLOAD NOW!
EASY TO LEARN AND PLAY!
• One-minute tutorial that teaches you how to play!
• Make words in any direction with just a swipe!

• No timers, so take your time and find the best words
• Beautiful graphics and animation
• Relaxing sound effects
• Listen to your iPod music while playing
GO FOR A HIGH SCORE!
• Score summary shows you how well you did
• Compare your scores with the world using Game Center
WORD LOVE!

• Magic auto-save - go ahead and quit the game, take a phone call, send a text - when you come back, your game will be waiting for you! Works on both old and new iThings!
Thanks for playing!

bluejetty:00120533:ios.name: Rhythm Sight Reading Trainer
bluejetty:00120533:ios.summary: Accelerate your sight reading skills with instant feedback on timing accuracy. Our carefully graduated levels, from beginner to professional, allow you to start at your optimal skill level and progress at your own pace. You'll improve more
bluejetty:00120533:ios.description:
Accelerate your sight reading skills with instant feedback on timing accuracy. Our carefully graduated levels, from beginner to professional, allow you to start at your optimal skill level and progress at your own pace. You'll improve more rapidly than practicing solely on your instrument. Practice anytime and anywhere. Many advanced features.
KEY FEATURES
DIVERSE EXERCISES
- Explore common and rare rhythms from 2 to 12 beats per bar (2/2, 3/2, 4/2, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 6/4, 7/4, 3/8, 5/8, 6/8, 7/8, 9/8, 12/8).
- More than 200 fixed exercises (100 (longer ones) on iPad).
- Thousands of random exercises.
- Suitable for absolute beginners as well as professionals.
- Challenge yourself with exercises involving rests, ties, syncopations, duplets, triplets, quadruplets and quintuplets.
- Add swing to quarter note meter exercises with varying degrees of swing intensity.
- Automatic count-off with one or two bars.
- Longer (random) exercises in landscape orientation.
PRACTICE & TEST MODE
- Practice mode: listen or tap along while the rhythm is played.
- Test mode: hear the metronome and read/tap the rhythm.
- Visual feedback instantly displays accuracy with each tap (color and position).
- Easily adjust metronome tempo by sliding or keypad.
- Two tap buttons for higher tempos or tapping with alternating fingers.
RHYTHM EDITOR
- Edit any exercise to suit your preferences.
- Intuitive editor with minimal taps.
- Includes an editor for ties.
- Unlimited undo.
- Add your exercises to favorites.
- Share exercises with others.
EXTRA CHALLENGES
- Expert mode: higher default tempo and more accuracy required.
- Endurance test (continuous reading).
- Speeding-up tests.
- Left- and right-hand independence: tap the beat and rhythm with two buttons.
- Note duration test.
- Count 6/8 in two (dotted quarter as the beat).
- Ear training function for rhythmic dictation.
- Maintain rhythm focus while notes from a chord progression are played.
REPORTING
- View a frequency chart of your tap results.
- Access progress reports for fixed and random exercises.
- Share your results, such as a 100% score graphic or progress reports, via email.
SOUNDS
- Choose from various percussive instruments for app player, metronome, and taps.
- Play chord progressions with guitar, e-piano, marimba, or bass.
- Optional stereo sound with taps in the right ear and metronome/player in the left ear.
- Optional beat-counting voice function.
MICROPHONE
- Utilize the microphone for an alternative to tap buttons.
- Play rhythms with hand claps, finger-snaps, or an instrument.
- Adjust sensitivity settings.
- Supports external microphones.
MIDI
- Receive taps from a Midi device connected via Apple USB camera adapter or USB-C (e.g., keyboard, guitar, drum kit).
- Automatic device detection.
- Touch-sensitivity support.
- Export any exercise as a MIDI file.
OTHER FEATURES
- Experience very low latency with instant response.
- Support for left-handed tapping.
- Choose between classical and flat interface themes.
- Support for dark mode (iOS13+).
- Universal app (iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad).
- Supports all screen sizes.
- Tested on iOS and iPadOS 27.

bluejetty:00143622:ios.summary:
Non solo pedaggio senza coda, ma anche cercare e trovare parcheggio. Un nuovo modo di vivere gli spostamenti più fluido, sostenibile e integrato. Con l'app Telepass niente potrà più fermarti. 
Scarica l’app e scopri come muoverti liberamen
bluejetty:00143622:ios.description:
Non solo pedaggio senza coda, ma anche cercare e trovare parcheggio. Un nuovo modo di vivere gli spostamenti più fluido, sostenibile e integrato. Con l'app Telepass niente potrà più fermarti. 
Scarica l’app e scopri come muoverti liberamente risparmiando tempo e avere il pieno controllo sulla tua mobilità. Ecco cosa puoi fare insieme a Telepass:
Pagamenti e servizi di mobilità integrati
● Paga i pedaggi autostradali: accedi all’autostrada con il dispositivo Telepass in modo rapido e sicuro, senza fare code o fermarti al casello.
● Fai rifornimento di carburante: cerca la stazione convenzionata più vicina e paga dallo smartphone senza usare contanti o carte di credito.
● Trova parcheggio: accedi alle soste Strisce Blu o usufruisci di oltre 1000 parcheggi convenzionati di città, aeroporti, stazioni e fiere.
● Paga il bollo dei tuoi veicoli senza perdere tempo: il servizio è valido anche per targhe non registrate in app.
● Richiedi fino a 4 skipass senza costi di spedizione: paghi solo quando scendi nei comprensori convenzionati con la tariffa dei listini Telepass. 
● Fai il pieno di energia in tutta Italia: trovi la colonnina più vicina a te e ricarichi il tuo veicolo elettrico in pochi tap.
● Accedi ad Area C Milano e alle zone a traffico limitato (ZTL): paghi in automatico senza bisogno del dispositivo Telepass a bordo.
● Usa i mezzi pubblici della tua città: acquista i biglietti di autobus, tram e metro, dimenticando la fila alle macchinette.
● Sharing Mobility: trova biciclette, scooter e monopattini elettrici e avvia una corsa per spostarti in città in modo sostenibile.
● Compra i biglietti dei treni Italo o Trenitalia fino a pochi minuti dalla partenza e raggiungi la tua meta senza stress.
● Compra le tue tratte in nave o traghetto: grazie alle partnership con Moby, Siremar - Caronte & Tourist, Tirrenia e Toremar, accedi alle migliori offerte.
● Acquista le vignette elettroniche per viaggiare all’estero: mostri il QR code dal tuo smartphone evitando soste alla dogana.
● Fai lavare e igienizzare il tuo veicolo dove l’hai parcheggiato: da oggi non sei più tu a cercare l'autolavaggio, perché sarà lui a venire da te!
● Prenota la revisione del tuo veicolo, trovando l’officina più vicina. Non sai quando farla? Attiva il Memo per ricordare tutte le scadenze.
● Salta la fila a Venezia acquistando i biglietti per i musei, le chiese e il trasporto: il tuo viaggio inizia in app.
● Assicurazione auto, moto, viaggi, sci e molto altro ancora: attiva e gestisci in pochi tap le polizze assicurative per te e per il tuo veicolo e proteggiti dagli imprevisti.
Gestione completa dei servizi e delle spese
Puoi attivare e gestire tutti i servizi dall’app inclusi nella tua offerta Telepass in modo semplice e intuitivo. L'app ti permette anche di acquistare le assicurazioni offerte da Telepass, come l'RC o l’Assistenza Stradale in Italia e in Europa, per viaggiare in modo sicuro e senza pensieri.
Tieni traccia dei tuoi movimenti e delle fatture, con la possibilità di creare note spese per una gestione contabile più efficiente. Puoi modificare facilmente l'IBAN associato al tuo conto Telepass, aggiornare le targhe dei veicoli abbinati al dispositivo e gestire i dati personali in modo sicuro.
Supporto in caso di imprevisti
L'app Telepass non è solo un modo per gestire i servizi e i pagamenti, ma anche un prezioso alleato in caso di imprevisti. Se perdi il tuo dispositivo, ad esempio, puoi segnalarlo e bloccarlo subito in app, richiedendone la sostituzione. Inoltre ricevi aggiornamenti in tempo reale su offerte, sconti, cashback e promozioni, risparmiando sui tuoi viaggi e godendo di tutti i vantaggi Telepass.
