bluejetty:00147170:ios.description:
◦ Healing practices and community 
SomaShare was founded to support your healing journey by providing you with practices you can do daily to heal and regulate your nervous system. 
You’ll also be part of a community where you can share your progress and feelings. 
◦ Experience powerful shifts: 
By practicing with our incredible, hand picked practitioners who stand out in their field, you can begin to experience powerful shifts in your stress levels, moods, and behaviors over time.
◦ Trauma-informed 
Our focus is on bringing you trauma informed practitioners who understand the impact of overwhelming past experiences on the body, soul and spirit. 
This means you won’t be pushed, encouraged to go at your own pace and to accept your experience for exactly what it is in the present moment.
Some of the types of practices you can find on SomaShare:
◦ Emotional healing: Practices for emotional healing and integration of past stress and trauma 
◦ Regulating your nervous system: Practices for more presence and grounding, moving through states like overwhelm, anxiety or shutdown and into inner alignment and peace
◦ Feel more pleasure: Practices to tune into your inherent pleasure, joy, expansion and aliveness 
◦ Change your patterns & habits: Practices to move from habits and patterns you feel stuck in and into more freedom and flexibility in your life 
◦ Setting aligned goals: Practices to help you set goals in alignment with your values and who you are, goals that feel right in your body and spirit
◦ Profound Anxiety Relief: Practices to support you in embracing and learning from anxiety, as well as experiencing relief in the somatic symptoms of it
Some of the types of practices you will find include: 
- yoga nidra
- somatic grounding and nervous system regulation
- anxiety relief
- somatic experiencing
- creating safety in the body 
- spiritual growth
- self connection
- and more!

إنتاج نصوص ذكية:
يمكن للتطبيق القيام بذلك باستخدام
bluejetty:00130439:ios.description:
تطبيق يستخدم تقنية الذكاء الاصطناعي لمساعدة المستخدم في مختلف المجالات تتضمن الكتابة، والعلوم، وتكنولوجيا، والطبخ ،والطب، وغيرها. ويساعد المستخدم على إنشاء رسومات ومحادثات فريدة من نوعها. 
إنتاج نصوص ذكية:
يمكن للتطبيق القيام بذلك باستخدام تكنولوجيا الذكاء الاصطناعي بتحليل النصوص المدخلة وإنتاج نصوص جديدة بناءً على السياق المقدم له. يمكن أن يشمل ذلك إنشاء مقالات، قصص، أسئلة وأجوبة، أو أي نص آخر بناءً على الاحتياجات.
إنتاج صور:
يمكن أيضًا أن يتيح التطبيق للمستخدمين إنشاء صور بشكل ذكي. ذلك يمكن أن يشمل توليد صور فوتوغرافية، رسومات، أو تصميمات فنية باستخدام خوارزميات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
اختيار شخصيات:
يمكن أن يحتوي التطبيق على مجموعة من الشخصيات التي يمكن للمستخدمين اختيارها لتمثيل النصوص أو الصور التي ينشئونها. يمكن أن تتضمن هذه الشخصيات شخصيات رسوم متحركة أو شخصيات افتراضية.
واجهة مستخدم بديهية:
يكون لديه واجهة مستخدم سهلة الاستخدام تتيح للمستخدمين التفاعل بسهولة مع ميزات التطبيق واستخدام الخيارات المتاحة.
دعم اللغة العربية:
 يدعم التطبيق اللغة العربية بشكل جيد، مما يتيح للمستخدمين الكتابة باللغة العربية والتفاعل بشكل فعّال مع التطبيق.
Similar to ChatGPT, ArabGPT's primary function is to generate human-like text based on the input it receives. Here are some key aspects of what ArabGPT can do:
Conversational Interaction:
ArabGPT is designed to engage in natural language conversations. Users can input prompts or questions, and the model generates coherent and contextually relevant responses.
Answering Questions:
You can ask ArabGPT a wide range of questions, and it will attempt to provide informative and contextually appropriate answers based on its training data.
Text Completion:
If you provide a partial sentence or text, ArabGPT can help complete it by generating the next words or predicting how the sentence might continue.
Image Generation:
The primary function of ArabGPT is to generate images from textual descriptions. Given a textual prompt, it can create diverse and complex images that match the given description.
Content Creation:
ArabGPT can be used to generate creative content, such as writing stories, poems, or articles. It can also assist in brainstorming ideas or generating textual content for various purposes.
Language Translation:
While not a specialized translation tool, ArabGPT can attempt to assist with language translation by providing translations for specific phrases or sentences.
Coding Assistance:

bluejetty:00184111:ios.description:

Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.

Join a friendly world of adventure in our easy-going RPG!
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
Attention, My Lord! Your kingdom is under threat, and it's up to you to save it in Five Heroes: The King's War!
Gather a party of five powerful heroes and embark on an epic journey through a vast and dangerous land filled with thrilling adventures. Engage in turn-based combat with enemies, where every move counts. Develop a winning strategy by understanding each hero's strengths and weaknesses and using them to your advantage.
Are you up to the challenge, My Lord? Download Five Heroes: The King’s War NOW, and have your name sung by every bard in the Kingdom!
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-
FEATURES:
TACTICAL COMBAT
Every move counts! Develop a strategy that can make or break your combat success. Learn your heroes' strengths and weaknesses, and use them to your advantage.
WRITE YOUR OWN SAGA
Journey across the land to save your kingdom from deadly Skeletons, help Amazons fight ruthless Pirates, unite Barbarian clans against nasty Goblins, cleanse a tainted Forest from an ancient Curse, and more. Experience a unique story campaign and create your own heroic saga.
UNIQUE HEROES
Recruit over 500 different heroes by collecting Hero Orbs or completing quests. Level up your heroes, upgrade their skills, and evolve them to unleash their full potential.
POWERFUL ARTIFACTS
Collect various artifacts from chests or defeated enemies and equip your heroes with the best gear. Choose wisely, as each artifact provides different bonuses to your heroes.
EPIC BOSSES
Defeat waves of minions before confronting immensely powerful enemy bosses. Loot them to find unique artifacts and Hero Orbs.
PVP ARENA
Test your skills against other players in the Heroes Arena. Defeat them in PVP to unlock special heroes and artifacts.
EXPLORE THE LAND
Don't miss out on the best rewards! Fortune favors the adventurous. Explore every corner of the land to find hidden treasures and bonuses.

bluejetty:00153840:ios.description:
Find Hidden Camera&Device :HCD provides a set of utilities designed to help users observe and analyze signals, magnetic fields, and nearby devices. These tools support awareness and inspection of your environment — whether you're at home, in the office, or traveling.
Key Features:
- Infrared Light Visualizer
Use your phone’s camera to highlight reflections and light sources that may not be visible to the naked eye, especially in low-light areas.
- Bluetooth Device Scanner
Displays a list of discoverable Bluetooth devices nearby with signal strength indicators to help you understand what's around.
- Wi-Fi Network Inspector
View local Wi-Fi networks and their details for general awareness of nearby connectivity points.
- Magnetic Field Meter
Observe changes in magnetic field strength that may be related to the presence of electronic objects.
For the Curious and Cautious:
HCD is built for individuals who want to better understand their surroundings. It does not guarantee detection of hidden cameras or recording devices. Instead, it offers supportive tools to help users stay more aware and observant.

bluejetty:00166531:ios.summary:

Apple App of the Day and featured by Apple. Rated 4.5 stars by our community and loved i
bluejetty:00166531:ios.description:
Join 4 million+ home cooks who've made weeknight cooking easy. Plan your week, build your shopping list in a tap, and never cook the same thing twice.
Apple App of the Day and featured by Apple. Rated 4.5 stars by our community and loved in the press.
Mob turns cooking from a daily scramble into the best part of your day. Whether you want to get organised, eat a little healthier, or just stop making the same three dinners on repeat, we've got you, with delicious, reliable recipes and all the tools to plan, shop and cook around your real life.
GET ORGANISED
Pick your recipes and Mob handles the rest. Meal plan your week, get a smart shopping list sorted by supermarket aisle, and change portion sizes with a tap so you only buy what you need. Prep ahead so dinner's covered even on your busiest nights, and with our cook ahead and batch cook recipes you can cook once and eat well all week, we'll even show you how to freeze and reheat. From speedy weeknight dinners to packed lunches and preppable breakfasts, it all adds up to less time deciding, less money on takeaways, and less food going in the bin.
NEVER GET BORED
New recipes drop every week from our in house chefs, so there's always something fresh worth cooking. Search by whatever's already in your fridge, find quick dinner ideas for tonight, or plan meals ahead for the week. Curries, traybakes, pasta, stir fries, salads and slow cooked comfort food, save your favourites into collections and build your own go to list. It's real variety without the effort, and every recipe is designed to be genuinely delicious.
EAT HEALTHIER, NO COMPROMISE
Want more protein, more veg, or just a more balanced plate? Every Mob recipe comes with full nutrition info and macros, including high protein and lighter options, plus veggie and vegetarian recipes. Eating well is easy, and it never feels like a diet.
WHAT YOU GET
- Smart shopping list, add every ingredient in one tap
- Weekly meal plans built for real life
- Search by ingredient to use up what you've already got
- Adjust portion sizes to match how many you're feeding
- High protein, veggie and family friendly recipes
- Save and organise recipes into your own collections
- Step by step recipes that keep your screen awake while you cook
- Nutrition and macros on every recipe
- Reliable, chef tested recipes that actually work
PERFECT FOR
Busy weeknights, families, meal preppers, and anyone who wants to eat better without spending the whole evening in the kitchen. Whether you're cooking for one, feeding a hungry household, or doing a big Sunday batch cook, Mob fits around you.
NO BOXES, NO LOCK IN
Unlike a meal kit, there's no rigid box turning up at your door. You buy your own ingredients, your way, at your own supermarket, and cook what you actually feel like eating. Mob gives you the plan and the recipes, you stay in control of the rest.
OUR MISSION
We're a community of over 1.5 million home cooks on a mission to make everyday cooking exciting again, not a chore, but something to look forward to. Cooking changes lives. It's better for your health, your mood and your wallet, and we're building a movement of people who cook as part of their weekly routine and are proud to say: "I'm a cook."
Try Mob Premium free for 7 days. Get full access to Mob's recipe library and every premium feature.
If you choose to purchase Mob Premium, your Apple account will be charged once your trial has elapsed. Auto renewal can be turned off at any time in your App Store settings after purchase. Cancelling will stop future charges, but you'll keep premium features until the end of the current period. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.

Terms of Service: https://www.mob.co.uk/terms-of-service

With the free, refreshed, and enhanced Greyhound app, you have more bus trip options, same low fares, and more new features than ever before.

bluejetty:00098904:ios.description:
TRY BEFORE YOU BUY - Play the beginning for free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full game. No ads.
Bridge Constructor Studio is the latest in the best-selling series. Test your engineering skills in this physics-based puzzle game, combining the best of previous titles with a modern, charming visual style—the ultimate experience for creative builders!
Get building today!
Bridge Constructor Studio is a must-have for fans of engineering puzzles and creative sandbox games. Whether you're crafting a sturdy architectural masterpiece or experimenting with wild and unconventional designs—anything is possible!
As a bridge architect, bring your visions to life: Design your constructions in animated 3D mini-dioramas and start the simulation to watch as your creations are put to the ultimate stability test.
Back to the Roots
Bridge Constructor Studio is a classic bridge-building game where you can let your creativity run free with an intuitive building system, easy controls, no budget constraints, and optional challenges. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned bridge-building pro, there's something for everyone!
Key Features
- 70 Challenging Puzzles – Test your construction expertise with dozens of unique bridge-building puzzles across varied biomes. Seven different vehicles and multiple construction materials (wood, steel, cables, concrete pillars, and roadways) ensure each puzzle is a fresh and varied challenge.
- Limitless Creativity – With no budget or material restrictions, you can freely experiment and design without limits. For an extra challenge, earn a special reward by keeping costs within a set budget while ensuring your bridge holds up under pressure!
- Diverse Environments – Build bridges across five beautiful biomes, from skyscraper-filled cities to snowy canyons, lush green valleys, and more. The possibilities are endless with seven unique vehicles offering different physics and challenges! Construct ramps and loops for daring monster truck stunts, create sturdy steel bridges for heavy timber transporters, or use moving objects in levels to overcome obstacles with the off-road vehicle. A pizza delivery van, parcel service truck, vacation van, and city bus also join the fun!
- Sharing is Caring – Let your friends and family experience Bridge Constructor Studio without wrecking your carefully crafted masterpieces. Create up to five player profiles, each with its own campaign progress!
Are you ready to push the limits of engineering? Start building today!

SAVE MONEY AND ENERGY WITH HIVE

bluejetty:00069828:ios.description:
SAVE MONEY AND ENERGY WITH HIVE
From smart heating to EV charging and so much more, Hive makes it easy to cut costs and carbon – all from your smartphone. Already trusted by more than 2 million customers, our clever technology is changing the way homes use, store and generate energy for the better. So we can get Britain living more sustainably every day.
INTRODUCING THE NEW HIVE APP
Our better-than-ever app has even more features to make saving energy easier – all based on feedback from real Hive users.
 • Personalise your dashboard to show your most-used devices first for quicker control.
 • Track budgets, check your history and discover more ways to save with Trends.
 • Switch on your devices, set smart actions and control it all from the dashboard.
HIVE THERMOSTATS
 • Get everything you need to take control of your heating with the best-selling Hive Thermostat - or choose the Hive Thermostat Mini for all the benefits at an even more affordable price.
 • Set energy-saving schedules, boost the temperature and get alerts if you’ve accidentally left the heating on.
 • Save energy and protect your heating system with built-in features like Frost Protection and Holiday Mode.
 • Boost your control with smart Hive Radiator Valves and save by never heating a room you’re not using.
 • Upgrade to Hive Heating Plus for even more ways to save, including insight tools, budget tracking and personalised recommendations.
HIVE EV CHARGING
 • Make the switch to EV easier with Hive EV Charging, including a smart home charger, installation by British Gas and simple control via the Hive app.
 • Pair it with any British Gas electricity tariff to access SmartCharge – our revolutionary scheduling tool that automatically charges at the greenest and cheapest times. Then, get any money you’ve saved credited on your next bill.
 • Or if you’re a new customer, get exclusive access to FreeCharge for a year of free charging on us!
 • See how much you’re spending in the Hive app and get real-time updates when your car’s ready to go.
HIVE LIGHTS, SENSORS & PLUGS
 • Set the mood with a swipe and get light where you need it with our ultra-efficient bulbs.
 • Monitor power-hungry appliances with smart plugs, so you can see how much energy you’re using at any time.
 • Link your whole smart home together with Motion Sensors and get it saving energy without lifting a finger.
*NEW* HIVE SOLAR
 • Get everything you need to power your home with greener, renewable energy, including solar panels, home battery, expert installation and full app control.
 • Generate free green energy from the sun, store what you don’t use with a solar battery and sell any you don’t need back to the grid.
 • Pair it with the Hive Solar Saver tariff from British Gas and save hundreds on your energy bills.
Discover more at hivehome.com

bluejetty:00174655:ios.description:
SEAiq is a full-featured marine navigation app. It lets you load your own charts in standard formats, including S-57, S-63, iENC, BSB, and KAP. It also automatically downloads charts from NOAA for the United States.
Features include:
* Waypoints
* Routes
* Tracks
* Night color modes
* Anchor alarm
* Automatic download and display of weather (wind & isobar)
* Chart measuring tools (EBL/VRM)
* Wi-Fi-based NMEA and AIS
No purchase is required to view charts. Premium navigation features are enabled during a 7-day evaluation period. After that, an annual subscription is required. Existing one-time purchases retain the features they unlocked.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00130804:ios.name: City Driving School Car Games
bluejetty:00130804:ios.summary: City car driving game welcomes you to the latest virtual driving academy. This game teaches you how to drive and obey traffic rules. In the career mode of city driving school, you will first learn the road signs such as right turn, traffic
bluejetty:00130804:ios.description:
City car driving game welcomes you to the latest virtual driving academy. This game teaches you how to drive and obey traffic rules. In the career mode of city driving school, you will first learn the road signs such as right turn, traffic signals, parking, no parking, etc. After learning the road sign you will be examined while driving in the city. Earn coins by successfully obeying all traffic rules and completing the mission, and then use those coins to purchase your favorite car from the garage. 
City Driving School game offers six exciting modes to polish your car driving skills. Career mode is the combination of learning and obeying all traffic rules. The parking mode will test your parking skills as you have limited hits. If you hit your car with obstacles and other vehicles, then you will lose your mission. You will get puzzle parking in the mini-game mode, solve the puzzle, and get out all the cars from the parking lot. Racing and drift mode will give you more fun. The open-world mode is the combination of all modes. Enjoy your car driving in the open-world mode and missions are scattered in the city in the form of checkpoints. Get to the checkpoint and enter the mission if you like it, you can reject the mission and get back to driving.
Enjoy city car driving in the latest car driving academy and get your digital driving license in the game. The game offers many supercars so get your favorite car from the garage and enjoy your day.

bluejetty:00086561:ios.description:
Dardashaty is where Arabs meet with marriage in mind.
Every profile photo is reviewed by a person before it appears to anyone. And you decide who can reach you.
Over a decade online. More than a million members have joined, across the Arab world and the diaspora, looking for friendship, a serious relationship, marriage or Misyar.
What you get
● Private one to one conversations. Text, voice, photo and video
● Precise search by country, city, age and marital status
● Who is online now, and who is nearest to you
● Favourites, likes, and who viewed your profile
● Instant alerts when a message arrives
You decide who reaches you
● Block any member, or silence a single conversation
● Block whole countries you do not want messages from
● Report anything, and every report is reviewed
Moderation is not a slogan
A new account with a photo stays hidden from other members until it has been reviewed. Offensive photos are removed and accounts that break the rules are stopped. This takes real time every day, and it is why the standard here is different.
Email verification protects your account and helps keep fake profiles out.
Gold membership
Gold opens unlimited messaging with every member, places you higher in their conversation list, and includes every feature added in future at no extra cost.
Subscriptions available:
● One week, $19, auto-renewable
● One month, $49.99, auto-renewable, with a free one-week trial
● Six months, $199.99, auto-renewable, with a free one-week trial
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the renewal date, and payment is charged to your iTunes account. You can manage or cancel a subscription at any time from your account settings, and it will not renew.
Points are also available as a one-time purchase, for members who prefer to pay only when they need to.
Available in Arabic and English.
Your data is handled according to our Privacy Policy, which you agree to on registration and which is updated from time to time.

Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00036164:ios.name: 90 Day Diet - Weight Loss Plan
bluejetty:00036164:ios.summary: Say goodbye to your weight problems and lose weight effectively through a tested diet. This application is based on the 90 Day Diet and will organize the way you eat so you can achieve your long term weight goals. The main idea of the diet
bluejetty:00036164:ios.description:
Say goodbye to your weight problems and lose weight effectively through a tested diet. This application is based on the 90 Day Diet and will organize the way you eat so you can achieve your long term weight goals. The main idea of the diet is the selective/separate eating, which means not mixing different kind of food (proteins, starches, carbohydrates and fruits).
IMPROVE YOUR METABOLISM 
The 90 Day Diet managed to convince people that metabolism is very important part of our health and controlling the body weight. Improper metabolism is a major cause of weight loss or excessive weight gain. 
That’s why the goal of the app is to learn you how to establish a better metabolism with controlling what you eat. On of the main advantages of the 90 Day Diet is that it changes your metabolism in direction, where you can get rid of overweight and also you will be able to control your weight at desired level.
OTHER HEALTH BENEFTS TOO
The goal of the app is not only to help you lose weight, but also to improve your overall health. Thus, In addition, the 90 day Diet is extremely beneficial for people with high blood pressure. If you follow this diet you will find out that in fact its meals contain all the vitamins and minerals that your body needs. Accompanied by slight exercises, the 90 Day Diet can radically change you life for better. 
PLAN YOUR DIET
The 90 Day Diet mobile application is designed to assist you during the diet. Use it when planning a diet and creating or implementing a healthy eating plan. This is an effective and trustful diet plan to lose weight. Along with the great tracking features like the diet tracker, weight tracker and the meal plan, you will get to your goals much faster. 
90 DAY DIET FEATURES: 
- Ability to create a flexible schedule for the diet - start it today, start it in 
 the future or if you have already started it you can pick up your start 
 date without problems.
- Detailed information about every single day - what exactly you can eat 
 and recommended sample meals.
- Statistics - how many days you've passed, how many kilograms you've 
 been when you started the diet and how many you are now.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
See why 90 Day Diet app is mentioned as one of the best weight loss tips. 
Lose weight with planning a diet and implementing the features given in the 90 Day Plan app.
Get it for FREE!

bluejetty:00139704:ios.name: Clash of Destiny: Good vs Evil
bluejetty:00139704:ios.summary: A new mobile RPG fantasy game has just dropped! Brought to you by the creators of Tiny Gladiators and Hunt Royale, Clash of Destiny seamlessly blends the best elements of various exciting genres to offer innovative and captivating gameplay
bluejetty:00139704:ios.description:
A new mobile RPG fantasy game has just dropped! Brought to you by the creators of Tiny Gladiators and Hunt Royale, Clash of Destiny seamlessly blends the best elements of various exciting genres to offer innovative and captivating gameplay that will keep you immersed for hours!
FEATURES:
- Embark on a Rogue-like inspired campaign mode to sharpen your skills.
- Engage in 2v2 PvP battles to test your mettle against the best worldwide.
- Team up with friends for thrilling coop boss fights.
- Choose from 16 characters across two factions.
- Unlock cool loot and skills throughout your adventure.
In broad strokes, Clash of Destiny is a turn-based fighting game with RPG and roguelike elements, fused with extensive progression systems and a rich feature set.
Embark on your adventure in the single-player campaign mode, overcoming increasingly challenging opponents on a randomly generated map. Can you reach the very end and conquer the final boss? Be prepared for surprises that alter your approach every time you play!
Between battles, upgrade your character, acquire new skills, equip superior weapons, and devise fresh strategies for upcoming challenges. The more you play, the more characters you unlock for future playthroughs, ensuring the game remains fresh and exciting.
As you invest more time, new builds and strategies become available to you. Utilize them to dominate the campaign and prepare yourself for multiplayer modes, where only the best warriors will prevail!
This is just the beginning. Join us on this epic adventure and discover what awaits you now and in the future!
Terms of Use: https://boombit.com/tos/
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00188206:ios.description:
Your Personal Assistant for Relationships
Between busy schedules and long days, expressing love can sometimes fall by the wayside. We forget to give gifts “just because,” offer compliments, or linger in our embraces. The things that say “I love you” seem to either not get said or not get through. As a result, our relationships can easily erode and the spark can fade.
Love Nudge is a fun, habit-forming app that helps you intentionally express love in ways that are most meaningful to your partner. Designed for real-life connection, Love Nudge takes the concepts of Dr. Gary Chapman’s #1 New York Times best-seller The 5 Love Languages® to the next level. You and your loved one can learn each other’s love languages, exchange encouraging and playful nudges, set and track activity goals, and monitor the levels of each other’s love tanks for better communication and intimacy. It’s like having a personal assistant… for your relationship.
The 5 Love Languages® by Dr. Gary Chapman has helped millions of couples strengthen their relationships… one language at a time. For almost two decades, The 5 Love Languages® has stood unrivaled as a top resource for love and relationships.
NOTE: Love Nudge relies on a consistent internet connection. If you’re not connected when you launch the app, or if you disconnect while you’re using the app, Love Nudge will not perform as it should.

bluejetty:00165288:ios.description:
Find the best time & best place to fly for drone pilots
UAV Drone Forecast is an advanced drone forecast & fly weather app built for modern drone pilots — combining accurate UAV weather data, real-time airspace, airmap & no-fly zone detection, and intelligent insights to help you fly safely and confidently.
Whether you're flying a multirotor, VTOL, or DJI drone, this is your ultimate UAV forecast tool for safe and efficient flying.
FEATURES:
Drone Weather & Flight Forecast
Get accurate drone weather / fly weather / weather flight data before takeoff:
- Wind speed, gust & turbulence forecast
- Visibility & temperature
- GPS signal strength & Kp index
- Smart “Good to Fly” / “Poor to Fly” forecast
- Reliable long forecast (7-day UAV forecast)
No-Fly Zone & Airspace Map
Stay safe with real-time drone airspace map & no-fly zones:
- Detect no fly zone / no-fly zones / drone no fly zones
- View airspace drone / drone airspace / UAV map
- Compatible experience similar to tools like B4UFLY, Airmap for drones, DJI Fly map
7-Day UAV Forecast
Plan ahead with detailed UAV forecast & drone forecast:
- Full forecast fly conditions for upcoming days
- Track changing weather trends
- Optimize every drone flight / drone flights
Weather Alerts & Smart Flight Windows
- Alerts for unsafe drone weather conditions
- Best time windows to fly drone / fly UAV
- Smart forecast algorithm-based suggestions
AI Drone Assistant
- Ask about drone safety, UAV weather, air data
- Get instant recommendations
- Simplify complex flight forecast data
Smart Wind Direction Compass
- Visual wind direction for drone fly stability
- Optimize takeoff & landing
- Essential for drone pilot & UAV pilot control
Visual Weather & Flight Charts
- Clear weather charts & drone forecast graphs
- Track trends over time
- Improve drone mapping & flight planning decisions
WHY CHOOSE THIS APP
- All-in-one drone app — weather + airspace + forecast in one
- Built for drone pilots, UAV pilots & drone professionals
- Helps you fly safer, avoid no-fly zones & reduce risks
- Supports modern ecosystems: DJI, DroneDeploy, Dronelink workflows
- Designed for drone apps for users
PERFECT FOR
- Drone photography & videography
- UAV inspection & mapping
- Drone delivery & wing drone systems
- Hobby flying & professional operations
Notice:
- This app are free-to-install, but has some premium features that need purchase/subscribe to use.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled 24 hours before the end of the period.
- Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you subscribe.
Term of use: https://moniqtap.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://moniqtap.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00033785:ios.summary: Picrew is a platform where you can create characters, portraits, and icons for free! With 10,000+ Image Makers, you can customize avatars that look like you or dress them up in various outfits. The images you create can be downloaded for fr
bluejetty:00033785:ios.description:
Picrew is a platform where you can create characters, portraits, and icons for free! With 10,000+ Image Makers, you can customize avatars that look like you or dress them up in various outfits. The images you create can be downloaded for free or shared on social media.
Picrew features Image Makers from creators worldwide, offering styles ranging from cute and cool to stylish and even spooky. With so many options, you're sure to find your favorite!
Picrew allows you to "create Image Makers" and "play with Image Makers." However, the app currently supports only the "play" function. If you want to create Image Makers, please visit the web version of Picrew at picrew.me.
https://picrew.me/
【Who Will Enjoy Picrew?】
・Enjoy creating avatars
・Enjoy playing dress-up games
・Like drawing or viewing portraits
・Like drawing or viewing illustrations
・Love tabletop role-playing games (TRPGs)
・Are interested in fashion, styling, or makeup
・Want to create their favorite characters
・Want to create handsome or beautiful characters
・Want to create avatars for free
・Want to create icons for free
・Want to create caricatures for free
・Want to play dress-up games for free
・Want to create characters for TRPGs for free
・Want to kill time
【Features】
・"Dress-up Maker" and "Random Maker"
The Dress-up Maker lets you create your favorite images by selecting parts yourself. The Random Maker generates images by chance—perfect for quick fun or fortune-telling-like experiences.
・Social Media Integration 
Easily share the images you create on platforms like Facebook, X, and LINE.
・Search
Look up Image Makers by keyword or by selecting categories.
・Tag
Search Image Makers using tags set by the creators.
・Bookmark
Save your favorite Image Makers for easy access anytime.
・Report
If you find an Image Maker that violates the terms or guidelines, you can report it to the Picrew team.
・Block
You can hide Image Makers you don't wish to see.
・Save Function (Premium Plan only)
Save your in-progress images and return to them anytime.
【Paid Features】
▼Ad-Free Plan
Remove in-app ads for a smoother and more comfortable Picrew experience!
Price: 300 JPY/month
▼Premium Plan
Enjoy Picrew even more—with no ads, more bookmarks, and access to the save feature!
Price: 600 JPY/month or 6,000 JPY/year
--Automatic Renewal--
Payments are processed through your Apple ID. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of the current period, and the subscription fee will be charged. If you do not wish to continue, please disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage your subscription in Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions.
・Important Notes
Cancellations and refunds for the current month are not available. If you wish to cancel, disable auto-renewal to prevent renewal in the following month.
Picrew Terms of Use:https://support.picrew.me/en/terms
Privacy Policy:https://picrew.me/privacy/
【Usage Guidelines】
Images created with Picrew Image Makers can only be used within the scope set by the creator and Picrew. Usage permissions vary by Image Maker, including personal use, non-commercial use, commercial use, and modifications. Some creators also include specific requests in the description.
Before using an Image Maker, please check the permitted usage and follow any guidelines provided by the creator.
【Ensuring a Safe Experience】
To maintain a safe and enjoyable platform, we implement the following measures:
・Constant service monitoring to remove inappropriate Image Makers.
・A reporting system where we review reported Image Makers. If a violation is confirmed, we take actions such as warnings or suspensions.
【Support & Feedback】
If you encounter any issues, please contact us via the inquiry form. We apologize for any inconvenience.
We welcome feedback to improve Picrew—feel free to share your thoughts!
https://support.picrew.me/en/contact
Company:https://tetrachroma.co.jp
X: @picrew_tc (twitter.com/picrew_tc)

bluejetty:00145572:ios.description:
Home Tasker is your smart companion for organizing, scheduling, and staying on top of all your home chores. With powerful automation, intelligent task management, and a clean interface, Home Tasker turns cleaning into a simple, motivating, and stress-free part of your routine.
A Smarter Way to Manage Your Home
Plan, schedule, and track all your chores in real time. Use flexible templates or let Home Tasker automatically generate a cleaning routine tailored to your home, lifestyle, and preferences.

Get started instantly with preset cleaning tasks for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and more. Create custom rooms with personalized checklists for complete control over your home routine.
AI Room Scan
Scan any room with AI to receive intelligent suggestions for tasks and checklists based on the room’s condition — no manual setup needed.
Recurring Rotation System
Rotate chores between family members or cleaning staff automatically. Choose daily, weekly, monthly, or custom rotation cycles to keep responsibilities fair and consistent.

Dynamic Checklists
Check off tasks as you clean and enjoy real-time progress updates that keep you engaged from start to finish.
Vacation Mode
Activate Vacation Mode for any member who is away. Their tasks will pause or reassign automatically, keeping your schedule balanced without extra work.
Daily Reminders

Works Across All Your Devices
Use Home Tasker anywhere with seamless syncing on:
iPhone
iPad
Apple Watch

Designed for a Better Life
• Better productivity

• More structure and consistency
• Positive habit-building through achievements and progress tracking

bluejetty:00147355:ios.name: Opsgenie
bluejetty:00147355:ios.summary: Opsgenie is a modern incident management platform for operating always-on services, empowering Dev & Ops teams to plan for service disruptions and stay in control during incidents. The Opsgenie Application for iOS delivers the power of the
bluejetty:00147355:ios.description:
Opsgenie is a modern incident management platform for operating always-on services, empowering Dev & Ops teams to plan for service disruptions and stay in control during incidents. The Opsgenie Application for iOS delivers the power of the solution to your mobile devices. You can receive push notifications when alerts and incidents arise, take action directly from the application, understand the status of all known issues and manage your on-call responsibilities.
Opsgenie for iOS is free for all Opsgenie customers and requires a subscription to Opsgenie service. Your Opsgenie administrator will send an invite via email for you to create an account. Once your account is created, you can log in to Opsgenie service from the iOS app with your Opsgenie username and password.
You can view additional documentation at http://www.opsgenie.com/docs/dashboard/ios-app
Features:
* Customizable dashboards for responding to alerts and incidents faster
* Ability to create alerts and incidents with ease
* Easy access and response to alerts and incidents (Acknowledge, Close, Escalate to Next, Take Ownership, Snooze and many more)
* Ability to execute custom actions on alerts and incidents (i.e ping, restart server, …)
* Opsgenie-hosted audio & video conferencing (Incident Command Center) to effectively collaborate during incidents
* Service Catalogs to identify and manage service units
* Ability to track each service’s status via dedicated status pages
* Ability to define & add responders and/or stakeholders to incidents
* Ability to select multiple alerts/incidents and execute an action for all
* Alert/Incident list pages supporting native swipe gestures for actions
* Ability to save and reuse the searches previously defined in order to filter alerts and incidents
* Who Is On-Call page which enables viewing all schedules and active rotations of the moment
* User Directory that enables accessing all users and their contact information
* Ability to easily contact users via phone call, SMS, email, and Skype
* Ability to mute/unmute notifications
* Ability to enable/disable notification preferences, notification rules and contact methods

bluejetty:00035406:ios.name: Stone Identifier - Rock Finder
bluejetty:00035406:ios.summary: Have you encountered a rock and you don’t know what it is? Maybe you want to learn more about it, minerals or any crystal? Rock Seeker is the ultimate app to help you identify and study more about thousands of rocks from all over the world.
bluejetty:00035406:ios.description:
Have you encountered a rock and you don’t know what it is? Maybe you want to learn more about it, minerals or any crystal? Rock Seeker is the ultimate app to help you identify and study more about thousands of rocks from all over the world. 
How does it work?
Rock Seeker identifies the rock in your camera shot or photo with the utmost accuracy. Our app has a comprehensive, easy to browse interface that helps you study the rock, understand its physical and chemical properties too. It’s also possible to add the rock to your rock collection.
You can see possible location of every rock you found or just browsing with convenient map showing deposits nearby.
Learn more about rocks fast and easy
Rock Seeker makes it very easy to analyze and study any rock you own, but you can also explore trendy stone or discover cool facts about them. It’s always exciting to learn about rocks and all kinds of cool stones, and with Rock Seeker you can do that fast and easy. Immerse yourself into the world of extraordinary rocks and educate yourself about them.
Features:
Analyze and study thousands of rock types
Search it on the map and find deposits nearby
Very accurate rock identification engine
Create your own rock collection
Subscription pricing and terms:
RockSeeker offers the following auto-renewing subscriptions to provide you with unlimited access to identification and database within RockSeeker Platinum while you maintain an active subscription: Weekly with a 3-day trial at $4.99; Weekly at $4.99; Monthly with a 3-day trial at 9.99; Monthly at $9.99; Yearly with 3-day trial at 29.99, Yearly at $29.99. For other currencies, the price corresponds to the same price tier on the App Store Pricing Matrix.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the application, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Privacy Policy: https://docs.appsx.lv/policies/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00083907:ios.description:
Ready for a new way to travel? Book your next adventure effortlessly with Busbud, the app designed to make your journey as smooth as possible. Whether it’s a quick hop to the next city or a carefully planned vacation, finding the best bus, train, carpool and ferry routes and tickets has never been easier.
Join millions of travelers who trust Busbud for its intuitive design and hassle-free experience. With a few taps, you can compare options, book tickets, and start your journey—all from your phone. It’s the ultimate travel companion that puts convenience in your pocket.
EXPLORE THE FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE
• Effortless e-ticket scanning for smooth boarding on your commute or travels.
• Sort by earliest, latest, cheapest, or fastest trip
• Save your travel preferences and payment info for faster future bookings.
• Get notifications for schedule changes or travel updates.
• Check boarding requirements and luggage limits ahead of time.
WHY TRAVEL WITH BUSBUD?
Find the Best Deals Instantly 
Save time and money by accessing the most affordable routes from 2,200+ global and local carriers, all in one place. Enjoy budget-friendly options and exclusive discounts only available through the app.  
Quick and Easy Booking 
Skip the lines and forget about paper tickets. Our streamlined booking process and e-tickets make boarding a breeze. Your next trip is just a few taps away.  
Your Trip, Your Choice 
Filter trips by time, price, or amenities to suit your needs. Whether you need Wi-Fi for work on your daily commute or extra legroom for a long-distance journey, Busbud offers options that fit your lifestyle. 
Manage Everything in One Place 
Keep track of your bookings, boarding passes, and trip details right from your phone. Changing plans? Modify or cancel your booking in seconds.
TRUSTED BY TRAVELERS AND COMMUTERS WORLDWIDE
With access to over 2 million routes in 80+ countries and over 2,200 carriers worldwide, Busbud is your gateway to a world of possibilities. Whether you're planning a quick local commute or a cross-country adventure, our app is praised for its reliability, consistent service, and well-established partnerships with top transportation providers. 
With a wide range of trusted carriers, you can choose the best option for any journey including: 
Top Bus Operators: 
Greyhound, FlixBus, ALSA, National Express, Megabus, ADO, RedCoach, Trailways, OurBus, Intercape, Eldo Coaches, Eagle Liner, Intercity Xpress, Citiliner Plus, Delta Coaches, JetSet Express, New York Trailways, Go Buses, Rider Express, Rede Expressos, Budgetliner, Pine Hill Trailways, Jefferson Lines, Salt Lake Express, Northwestern Stage Lines, Barons Bus and more. 
Top Train Operators: 
Amtrak, Via Rail, Eurostar, Renfe, Italo, Deutsche Bahn, Trenitalia and more. 
WHY WE'RE DIFFERENT
Book with Confidence 
Plans change? No worries. Enjoy flexible booking options and responsive customer support ready to assist you anytime. Your satisfaction is our top priority.
Sustainable Travel Choices 
Choose a greener way to travel. By opting for buses or trains, you're making a positive impact on the environment. Join us in reducing CO₂ emissions and promoting sustainable travel.
Experience the Journey 
Relax and enjoy the view from your window seat. Our travelers often share how much they appreciate the journey itself—whether it's catching up on sleep, working on-the-go, or simply enjoying the scenery.
GET STARTED TODAY!
Download Busbud and redefine the way you travel. It's fast, simple, and designed for you.
Busbud. Travel, with a smile.
Contact
Plans changed? No problem. Simply contact our customer service team via chat or email, and we'll take care of the rest.

bluejetty:00071313:ios.description:
CrossStitcher is the only cross stitching magazine that combines fresh contemporary ideas with lifestyle inspiration and creative techniques to help you make the most of your cross stitch hobby. Our pool of talented designers brings you a variety of trend-led projects alongside all the technical advice you’ll need to get started. You’ll find clever ideas for making your designs into gifts, accessories and homestyle items, while our expert-led Savvy Stitcher feature demonstrates a variety of new techniques for you to try. Whether your style is vintage, contemporary or quirky, you'll find something to get you stitching straight away - so grab a hoop, thread your needle and start stitching today! Be the stitcher you dream of being. We show you how!
---------------------------------------------- 
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues. 
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest issue. 
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product. 
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period. 
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased. 
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account. 
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved. 
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store 
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags. 
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com 
--------------------

http://www.pocketmags.com/privacy.aspx

bluejetty:00068225:ios.description:
The HYU-CONNECT app is designed to work with HYUNDAI NextGen DVRs, NVRs and IP cameras which support Cloud P2P function. It allows you to live view your cameras remotely. All you need to do is creating an account and adding device into the account, then you can enjoy the real-time video from cameras on a global scale. It also allows you to play back recorded video to search every milestone of your life. When motion detection alarm of your device triggered, you can get an instant message notification from HYU-CONNECT app.
Key Features：
1. Real-time monitoring
2. Video playback
3. Motion detection alarm notification
-----------------------------------------------------
La aplicación HYU-CONNECT está diseñada para trabajar con DVRs, NVR y cámaras IP de HYUNDAI NextGen que soportan la función Cloud P2P. Le permite ver sus cámaras de forma remota. Todo lo que necesitas hacer es crear una cuenta y agregar dispositivos a la cuenta, y luego disfrutar del video en tiempo real de las cámaras desde cualquier lugar del mundo. También le permite reproducir videos grabados para buscar culquier suceso en su instalacion de camaras. Cuando se activa la alarma de detección de movimiento de su dispositivo, puede obtener una notificación de mensaje instantáneo PUSH desde la aplicación HYU-CONNECT.
Características principales:
1. Monitoreo en tiempo real
2. Reproducción de video
3. Notificación de alarma de detección de movimiento via PUSH

bluejetty:00163621:ios.description:
When you want pizza, you really want pizza. Luckily, our app is the quickest and easiest way to order one with a whole host of exclusive features. Want to know more? Course you do…
ORDER PIZZA
Scroll through our easy-order menu and treat yourself to an all-time classic or discover something new! You can even Create Your Own customised creation, give it a name and save it for next time. 
DELIVERY OR TAKEAWAY
Whether you want to collect from your local store or have your pizza delivered to your door, our app’s got you covered. With stores up and down the country, you’re sure to find a Domino’s Pizza near you. 
EXCLUSIVE PIZZA DEALS
If deals are your thing, you’ve come to the right place (almost). Download our app and you’ll find dozens of exclusive pizza deals to suit any budget (and any occasion). You can even add your vouchers to bag discounts on your order!
GROUP ORDERING
If you need to order pizza for the whole fam, you can set up a group order to make ordering for the gang a doddle. Just send them an invite, let them choose what they want and it’ll get added to the order! 
PRE-ORDERING
If you know you want pizza later, but you’re ready to order now…no worries. Get your order in early, let us know when you want it, and we’ll do the rest. Oh, and if you know you want the same as last time, you can just choose it from your order history! 
PAYMENT
Oh, and when it comes to settling up, you can pay pretty much however you like…using card, PayPal or with just a few taps thanks to Apple Pay. Plus, you can keep an eye on your pizza’s progress with our trusty pizza tracker.
So, if you haven’t downloaded our app yet, you’re missing out on everything you love about Domino’s and so much more. 
Hit the link to download now and see it with your own eyes!

bluejetty:00187187:ios.description:
Introducing Your Ultimate Indian Stock Market Companion!
Make smarter trading and investing decisions with our all-in-one Indian Stock Market Screener App, built especially for active traders and long-term investors.
• Pre-Defined Technical Screeners – Instantly find stocks based on powerful chart patterns and technical setups.
• Top Trending Stocks – Track movers by price, volume & 52-week highs in real time.
• Daily FII / DII Activity – Know where big money is flowing every single day.
• Corporate Actions Tracker – Never miss dividends, bonus issues, stock splits & buybacks.
• Fundamental Research on Any Stock – Search any company and get key financial insights instantly.
Whether you're a day trader, swing trader, or long-term investor, this app gives you the edge you need—fast, accurate, and made for the Indian markets.
•Trade Smart. Invest Confidently. Stay Ahead.
Download now and transform the way you track the stock market!
Stock Screener is an application that lets users screen or finds stocks using various criteria. Criteria can be industry or sector, market cap, share price, and many other such screening criteria.
This is one of the best stock scanner app for iOS, but you need to have a basic understanding of how the stock market works in order to utilize this technical analysis app. 
Silent features of the APP:
• Many type of unique screeners (EOD) like Jackpot1,Jackpot2, Weekly High, 3 Months High,Bullish candle, Breakout etc for both Bullish and Bearish.
• Live predefined stocks screening.
• Trending Stocks
• Daily FII/DII Activities
• Charts
• Corporate Actions (Bonus, Split, Buyback, Dividend)
• Customized Live Stock screening with Technical and Fundamental Analysis. Also both type of Stock Screening and special screener like Jackpot, Intraday, Short-term etc.
• All most all technical data at single page like SMA,Vol SMA, Pivot Points (Daily, Weekly and Monthly).
• High low close prices for 1day,1week, 1month, 3 months, 6 months etc.
• Sector-specific stocks.
• Interactive live chart.
• Stocks performance like 1 day, 1week, 1 month,3 month, 6 months etc.
Features screening or finding stocks based on:
• Industry or Sector
• Dividends
• Share Price
• Market Cap
• Analyst Ratings
• Growth
• Profitability
• Earnings

bluejetty:00023326:ios.description:
atv uygulaması ile Türkiye’nin en çok izlenen TV kanalı her an her yerde!
atv izleyicileri için hazırlanan özel tasarımla, canlı yayına, sevdiğin dizilere, uygulamaya özel videolara ve herkesten önce izleyebileceğin dizi fragmanlarına kolayca ulaşabilirsin!
En sevilen programları atv uygulamasında kolayca izle. En sevilen gündüz kuşağı programları hafta içi her gün atv’de! Müge Anlı ile Tatlı Sert, Esra Erol’da ve Mutfak Bahane izlemek günün her anında atv uygulamasıyla mümkün.
**
atv mobil uygulaması sayesinde günün tüm gelişmelerini yakalamak ise çok kolay. Kahvaltı Haberleri, Gün Ortası, atv Ana Haber ve atv’de Hafta Sonu programlarıyla günün nabzını yakalayabilirsiniz. Hemen atv uygulaması indir merak edilen haberleri anında izle.
**
Senin dizin hangisi? Bir Gece Masalı Salı akşamları atv ekranına geliyor. Çarşamba akşamı Kuruluş Osman rüzgarının estiği atv’de, Perşembe günleri ise Başka Bir Gün var. Cuma akşamları Zembilli izleyicisiyle buluşurken Cumartesi gününün yıldızı ise Can Borcu. Pazar günleri ise Kardelenler atv ekranlarında. Tüm atv dizilerini mobil uygulamadan izle, takip et ve detaylara hakim olma şansını kaçırma!
**
Nihat Hatipoğlu sohbetleri ile atv izleyicisinin karşısına çıkmaya devam ediyor. Dini program kategorisinde Nihat Hatipoğlu ile Kur’an ve Sünnet, Nihat Hatipoğlu ile Dosta Doğru ve Nihat Hatipoğlu Sorularınızı Cevaplıyor programları her an uygulamadan takip edilebiliyor.
**
‘Kim Milyoner Olmak İster?’ yarışması da atv mobil uygulamasından izlenebiliyor. Ayrıca ‘Milyoner başvuru formu’ da atv mobil uygulamasında yer alıyor.
Sevdiğin dizi mi başlıyor?
Yayın akışından izlemek istediğin dizi programın yanındaki ‘alarm’a tıkla. Dizin veya programın başladığında haberin olsun!
Keyifli seyirler!

apple-macos:6824046368.name: IdunCut: Video Editor
apple-macos:6824046368.description:
IdunCut is a simple video editor for Reels, Shorts, vlogs and YouTube videos.
Cut it your way
• Pick videos and photos from Recents, Favourites, your albums or Files. They land on the timeline in the order you picked them.
• Drag the edges to trim, and split right at the playhead.
• Add more clips, audio, text and captions straight from the timeline.
• Speed, volume, crop, color and replace are one tap away.
• Scrubbing and playback stay smooth, even with 4K and HEVC.
• Undo and redo.
